2）问题生成：先由 10 名具备 ML/文本挖掘背景的博士/硕士生在 LabelStudio 上人工标注约 300 条 QA（Boolean 31.2%/Factoid 40.5%/Other 28.3%），作为少样本示例；在 10 篇文档子样本上比较 Llama 3.2 90B、Llama 4 Scout、DeepSeek，最终选定 Llama 4 Scout（temperature 0.7，唯一问题数 145、类型分布均衡）；按输入预算对文档分段，经 LangChain 送入模型，生成 131,494 条 QA（Factoid 61.9%/Boolean 20.7%/Other 17.4%），97.6% 问题串互异，答案长度中位数分别为 1/8/34 token，并记录生成置信度。
3）质量控制：3 名评估者对同一 200 条样本（133 Factoid/44 Boolean/23 Other，共 600 次评分）按清晰度、答案正确性、是否需要段落、类型正确性四项评定；另在 20 条试点上比较四个 LLM 裁判与人类的一致率与成本，选取 DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731（一致率 91.0%，约 $0.325/千条），对全部 131,494 条按七维度（清晰度、答案正确性、上下文相关性、类型正确性、忠实性、推理有效性、答案完整性）1–5 打分，仅保留答案正确性=5 的 98,677 条（75.0%）。
4）基准评测：5 个模型（DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、GLM-5.3、GPT-5.6 Luna、GPT-6 Luna、Muse Glimmer 30B）在零样本下做"无段落"与"带段落"两条件对比，按类型分别用 Boolean 平衡准确率、Factoid token F1、Other ROUGE-L 评估，每类采样 616 条、共 1,848 题。

Result: 语料：11,064 篇文档，68.8% 达相关阈值，OSM 地理过滤剔除了大量"主题高度匹配但位于邻国"的条目，说明地理过滤不可或缺；词云显示语料以寺庙、神祇与经典为核心。质量：人工评估中 89.83% 问题表述清晰，答案 61.33% 完全正确、22.83% 部分正确、15.83% 错误，68.83% 标注为"必须依赖段落"；裁判筛选保留率 75.0%，其中 Other 类保留率最低（51.3%），且 Other 类低置信度生成占比最高（4.04%），与"解释型问题最难"一致；裁判七维度中"推理有效性"普遍偏低（Factoid 2.16 / Boolean 2.20 / Other 2.78）。模型评测：所有模型在带段落时三项指标全面提升——Factoid token F1 由 0.177–0.297 升至 0.725–0.766，Other ROUGE-L 由 0.166–0.216 升至 0.459–0.596，Boolean 平衡准确率由 0.62–0.81 升至 0.93–0.98；其中最弱的 Muse Glimmer 30B 在带段落时反而取得最佳 Other ROUGE-L（0.60），表明"是否提供上下文"比"模型强弱"影响更大；解释型问题即便有上下文仍最难（ROUGE-L ≤0.60），且 ROUGE-L 本身会低估改写型正确答案。

Conclusion:  BharatSynthQA 提供了首个大规模、以段落接地方式组织的印度寺庙及关联宗教遗产 QA 资源，包含 98,677 条裁判通过的问答（按类型分层切分）与约 300 条人工金标准，验证了"权威种子→主题爬取→地理过滤→LLM 少样本生成→LLM 裁判过滤"这一构建细分领域接地数据集的可行路径，并量化证明当前 LLM 对该领域属"参数中缺失、阅读能补"的状态；其双重定位（闭卷文化知识探针 + 阅读理解/RAG 基准）与训练用途（教育、旅游、朝圣、数字遗产保护）明确。作者同时坦承局限：内容以印度教寺庙为主、其他传统与地区覆盖不足；全部来源于英文维基百科，缺少印度本土语言与非百科来源；数据由单一 LLM 生成并由单一 LLM 裁判过滤，缺乏带 IAA 的人工审计与多裁判交叉验证；生成集偏 Factoid（61.9%）；评测直接提供金标准段落而非真实检索，尚未包含 11,064 篇全文库中以弱相关文档作干扰项的端到端 RAG 设定。后续方向包括扩大种子来源与配比、单篇来源对数量上限、引入多种族/语言来源、多裁判与人工审计、定向生成 Boolean 与解释型问题以平衡分布，以及构建带干扰项的检索式评测。

Abstract: India's temples and other places of worship are among its richest repositories of cultural heritage, bringing together religious tradition, history, architecture, and art. Due to the widespread curiosity, people increasingly turn to Artificial Intelligence (AI) assistants for information about them. Current models are rarely trained or evaluated on this domain. We present BharatSynthQA, a passage grounded question answering (QA) dataset focused on Indian temples, which also covers other religious sites connected to them. Our pipeline crawls Wikipedia from topics seeded by authentic heritage sources, filters articles for topical relevance, and locations in India. Further it generates Boolean, factoid, and explanatory QA pairs with a fewshot prompted LLM. An LLM judge filters the pairs on answer correctness, retaining 98,677 of 131,494 generated pairs. Additionally, 300 human-annotated pairs are released separately as a reference set. Human evaluation of the subsample of this dataset showed 89.83% of the questions were formed correctly. Benchmarking five current LLMs shows that factoid token F1 is only 0.18-0.30 without the source passage but 0.73-0.77 with it, indicating that this domain is poorly captured in model knowledge. The dataset is available at this https URL to support research on culturally grounded QA and retrieval-augmented generation for Indian heritage.

*Fenghai Li,Bingxuan Li,Jiawen Zhang,Yifan Shen,Jiateng Liu,Yutong Zhang,Yue Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 EmoHarness：一个"AI4AI"框架，把冻结的小型多模态模型（student）包在一个可演化的 harness（提示词、配置、验证代码的集合）中，通过元 harness 演进来提升其情绪理解能力。在 5,507 条 MME-Emotion 数据上，相对单次纯视频调用提升任务宏平均 Recognition 7.6–13.4 个百分点，但其中绝大部分增益来自加入转写与韵律描述等音频衍生证据（+5.38 至 +10.71 pp），而 Builder 演化出的编辑相对人工 scaffold 最多只带来 +0.95 pp 且无任何差异通过 Holm 校正；harness 生成的"情绪上下文"迁移到 IntentQA 上有小幅增益，同样不显著。结论是：真正起作用的是"提供并组织音频证据"，而非自演化编辑本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型多模态模型在文字、语音与视觉线索冲突时容易误判情绪。已有工作多通过指令微调或强化学习改权重，本文想问：能否在不更新 student 权重的前提下，让另一个更强的 LLM 帮助 student 更有效地利用转写、韵律与视觉观察这些跨模态证据？具体动机是（1）跨模态冲突是情绪识别的主要错误来源；（2）现有程序/提示优化工作未针对小型模型的特定情绪混淆与冲突模式；（3）需要区分"增益到底来自加了音频证据，还是来自推理程序（harness）的结构与演化"。

Method: EmoHarness 把冻结的 student 置于 harness（提示词、settings YAML、受限验证 Python 代码的集合）内执行。人工编写的初始 harness（Shared scaffold）用四次 student 调用构成证据索引化流程：Observe（2fps 抽帧，抽取面部/身体/场景/时序线索，编号 v1,v2…）、Propose（列出候选标签+置信度+支持/反驳证据 ID）、Review（复排并被确定性代码校验）、Explain（写解释，不能改标签），外加固定输出控制器（多标签最多 3 个标签，优先"有效支持数>反驳数"的候选，不足时按排名补齐以保证总有答案），单阶段畸形输出可重试一次，总调用上限 6 次。音频由 Whisper large-v3 生成带词时间戳转写，openSMILE eGeMAPSv02 特征相对参考统计被 verbalize 成 "high pitch" 等非情绪标签描述，与转写句一起编号为 a1,a2…。Meta-Harness Evolving（MHE）继承 Meta-Harness 的 proposer：Builder 离线读取 student 在构造集上的失败（按 gold–prediction 混淆与跨模态冲突聚类）、执行轨迹与历史提案，每代最多提 4 个候选编辑（prompt/settings/受限验证代码）；经文件作用域、schema、可加载性、静态代码检查与提案 reviewer 过滤后，在独立验证集上按 Eq.3 四重门控决定晋升：验证 Recognition 更高、回归率 ρ≤δ=0.05、平均调用数 ≤B=4.5、推理代理分数 Q̂v 不低于在位者 ε=0.02 以内；共 T=4 代后冻结，Builder 从不接触评测样本。实验用 4 个 student（Qwen3-VL-8B/4B、Qwen3.5-4B、Gemma-4-E4B，vLLM 本地部署）与 2 个 Builder（GPT-5.6 Luna、GPT-6.1 Sol），条件为 Video、Audio、Shared、MHE；构造型 399、验证 394 条，评测 5,507 条（已见 3 类 + 未见 5 类），指标为本地计算的 task-macro Recognition（含 recall 式多标签评分）配任务分层配对 bootstrap 与 Holm 校正；下游 IntentQA 用 harness 为每视频生成一次情绪上下文并复用于 2,134 个问题。

Abstract: Small multimodal models can misjudge emotion when words, voice, and visual cues conflict. ### [44] [Lost in Rounding: bf16 Recurrent State Makes Hybrid Reasoning Models Think Longer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12127)
*Yuchuan Weng,Xin Chen,Chi Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对六个开源混合推理模型（注意力 + Mamba-2 / Gated DeltaNet）做了受控的配对实验，发现把循环状态缓存以 bf16 + round-to-nearest(RTN) 存储时，6 个模型中有 5 个"想得更久"：输出长度几何平均上升 1.07×–1.27×，32K token 上限命中率显著增加，准确率下滑（Qwen3.5-9B 由 85.6% 降至 70.8%，cap 118→223；LiveCodeBench 上 pass@1 掉 12.6 与 13.4 分）。128K 预算重跑表明该失败有两种形态：更长但能完成的推理（Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2，31 条额外 cap 中 30 条可完成，代价主要是 token）与永不终止的精确重复循环（Qwen3.5-9B，85% 的未完成运行是 exact loop）。关键机制结论是：问题源于舍入偏置而非分辨率不足——同位宽 bf16 随机舍入(SR)可消除 4/5 受影响模型的效应，用整数哈希随机源时 Qwen3.5-9B 与 FP32 的 cap 数与准确率完全一致（113 vs 118，85.6% vs 85.6%）且显存与解码速度等同 bf16 RTN。头级定位显示 Nemotron-Nano-v2 谱系中仅对"中等衰减带"（25% 头）做 SR 即基本消除效应，而 teacher-forced KL 会误排头组（KL 最高的 q0 单独 SR 完全无效），该结论无法迁移到 Nemotron-3 与 Qwen3.5-9B。作者建议评测必须同时报告状态 dtype、cap 率与输出长度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合推理模型在解码时把循环混合器（Mamba-2、Gated DeltaNet）的状态缓存在解码步之间，每步都把 FP32 计算结果重新舍入写回，因此任何舍入偏置都会在长推理链上相干累积。已有工作只覆盖了 FP16/INT8/FP8：NVIDIA 报告 FP16 RTN 使 Mamba-2/GDN 混合模型啰嗦最多 +37%，并以 SR 修复；Nazari 等报告 INT8 同样问题。但 bf16（同样是 16 位、同样是推理引擎暴露的格式）证据混杂且互相矛盾：vLLM 的修复说明 bf16 舍入在一个 Nemotron 模型上表现为 runaway generation 并把默认改为 FP32；LeapQuant 报告 bf16 使 Qwen3.5-9B 的 AIME 分数从 87.9% 掉到 72.1%，却称 SR"帮助不大"；DAMP 认为 FP16 优于 bf16 是因为分辨率更细；SGLang 仅对 FP16 Mamba 缓存提供 SR，bf16 SR 的 PR 因缺准确率结果被关闭。因此需要：（1）在统一设置下对多个开源混合模型做 bf16 RTN 与 FP32 的配对测量；（2）区分"更长但完成"与"永不终止"两类失败（既有"两臂都完成"的准确率对比会掩盖后者）；（3）判定根因是舍入偏置还是位宽分辨率不足；（4）给出可在生产中落地的、低成本的修复路径与精度分配准则。

Method: **模型与数据**：六个开源混合推理模型——Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 与母模型 12B-v2（Mamba-2，同一谱系）、Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B（Mamba-2 MoE）、Qwen3.5-9B（GDN）、Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Thinking（GDN）、Falcon-H1R-7B（每层并行注意力+Mamba-2）。权重与激活恒为 bf16，仅切换循环状态 dtype。数据为 590 道竞赛数学题（MATH-500 + AIME 2024/2025 + HMMT Feb 2025，各 30），两个模型另加 175 道 LiveCodeBench v6 增量题；输出上限 32,768 token。

**服务栈**：SGLang 0.5.21，8×RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell，通过 `--mamba-ssm-dtype` 在 float32/bfloat16 间切换；多为 8 路数据并行（Qwen3-Next 为 TP4×DP2）。FP32 状态使缓存翻倍、并发请求减半，故在 Nemotron-3 上做并发匹配控制（43 请求）排除混淆，Qwen3.5-9B 上引擎并发上限（122）从未触发。

**SR 实现**：patch SGLang 的 Triton selective-state-update（Mamba-2）与 packed GDN decode kernel，在 FP32 状态值下加 16 位随机比特再截断（等价于以等于小数位置的概率向上舍入），存储位宽与 bf16 RTN 完全一致、并发上限相同；随机源为 Triton 计数器式 Philox（每次 CUDA-graph replay 重播种）或整数哈希 lowbias32；支持 per-head mask，使部分头用 SR、其余用 RTN。关闭 SR 时 patch 后 kernel 与原版逐位一致；prefill 写状态仍为 RTN。

**指标与统计**：长度比 = 配对逐题长度比的几何平均（对数比做 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验）；capped = 命中 token 上限；准确率 = math-verify 抽取最后一个 \boxed{}（被截断的运行同样判分），配对用精确 McNemar；"excess removed" 指标 F_log = (logL_bf16 − logL_arm)/(logL_bf16 − logL_fp32)，配对 bootstrap 4,000 次给 95% CI。

**128K 预算实验**：把任一臂在 32K 被截断的题目（Qwen3.5-9B 268 条；Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 32 条）在 128K 用同样采样参数从头重采（而非续写），区分"更长但能完成"与"不终止"，并按"尾部固定周期重复≥2 周期且≥192 token"判定精确重复循环。

**头级定位**：按 weights-only decay rate r = e^{A_log}·softplus(b_Δ) 把 Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 的 3456 个 Mamba 头分为 8 个八分位（q0 最慢，每档 432 头），在 120 条推理轨迹上度量"把某八分位保持 FP32 所消除的 4K token 之后 bf16 teacher-forced KL 份额"，据此排序；再做闭环的 SR on head subsets：q1+q2（衰减带 r∈[0.57u, 4.1u)，25% 头）、q0（KL 最高）、q0+q3（等头数对照）、q0+q1（KL top-2）、864 随机头、"全部除 q1+q2"等。另用 toy model（安静 leaky integrator h←round(e^{-r}h+ε)，20,000 轨迹）解释有效衰减：r≲u 时 RTN 完全冻结衰减，u<r≲4u 时失真（1.5u 处有效速率 0.17×），>4u 近乎无偏，SR 在任意速率无偏。

**预注册**：关键检验在跑实验前先写入工作 notebook（未外部时间戳，标准见附录 A），表中列出全部预注册检验及其成败；其余分析显式标注为探索性。

Result: **1）bf16 RTN 普遍拉长推理（表1，590 题配对）**：Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 长度 ×1.197（p=7e-19，cap 1→31，89.3→88.8 ns）；12B-v2 ×1.188（0→17，90.0→90.5）；Nemotron-3-30B-A3B ×1.081（36→81，92.5→87.3，p=3e-7）；Qwen3.5-9B ×1.265（118→223，85.6→70.8，p=2e-14）；Qwen3-Next ×1.070（16→24，p=0.10 ns）；Falcon-H1R-7B ×1.008（ns，无效应，原因未知）。贪心解码同样成立（×1.211 / ×1.172），跨种子稳定（9B 第二种子 ×1.231，cap 0→32）。Nemotron-9B 的增长集中在难题（MATH-500 ×1.15，AIME24/25、HMMT ×1.48/×1.40/×1.68）；FP16 RTN 总体近中性（×1.017）但 HMMT 上 ×1.25。Nemotron-3 并发匹配控制后效应不变（×1.098，p=4e-6）。准确率损失几乎全部落在 bf16 侧被截断的题上（Qwen3.5-9B 为 112/112）；"两臂都完成"子集准确率不变（99.7%/99.7%）但属选择效应、近天花板。

**2）更长 vs 不终止（128K 重跑）**：Qwen3.5-9B 松弛准确率差距由 14.7pp 缩到 6.9pp（93.6% vs 86.6%，p=7e-7）但未闭合；128K 仍未完成 FP32 44 条 vs bf16 93 条（p=6e-8），其中 85%（79/93）是精确重复循环；bf16 独有的 150 条 32K cap 中 108 条在 128K 完成、42 条不完成。32K 下 exact loop 已由 72 升至 113。对比：Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 的 31 条 bf16-only cap 有 30 条在 128K 完成，长度 ×2.29 但准确率相同（89.7% vs 89.8%）——该模型代价主要是额外 token。

**3）SR 修复与代价（表3）**：全头 bf16 SR 在 4/5 受影响模型上把长度/cap/准确率恢复到 FP32 水平——9B-v2 F_log=1.05、cap 0、89.7%；12B 0.98、cap 0、90.3%；Qwen3.5-9B 0.87、cap 111、87.6%；Qwen3-Next 0.99、cap 15、96.1%。Nemotron-3 是例外：F_log=0.38，消除了 45 条额外 cap 中的 40 条但残留约 ×1.05 的整体偏移，原因未知。整数哈希 SR 使 Qwen3.5-9B 完全对齐 FP32（cap 113 vs 118，准确率均 85.6%），端到端 10,393 tok/s 对比同日 RTN 10,163 tok/s，匹配 batch 下解码为 RTN 的 102–113%（无减速），Mamba-2 模型为 96–101%。Triton 默认 10 轮 Philox 使 GDN kernel 慢至 RTN 的 30–60%（Qwen3-Next 36–85%，大 batch 更差），微基准 batch 240 时 kernel 时间为 ×20；4 轮 Philox 或 lowbias32 降至 ×1.01（batch 64 为 ×1.68/×1.19）。哈希随机源的每步无偏性、步间自相关（lag 1–4 ≤4.5e-5，限 2.5e-4）、256 步和方差（1.002 倍独立抽样值）均已单独校验。

**4）代码任务（LiveCodeBench v6，175 题×2 样本）**：Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 长度 ×1.37 [1.29,1.46]、cap 36→162（65 vs 2 题，p<1e-8）、pass@1 58.3→45.7（−12.6pp），SR 恢复到 59.4；Qwen3.5-9B ×1.09、cap 169→233、pass@1 46.3→32.9（−13.4pp），SR 恢复到 45.4。仅看完成样本的 pass@1 反而 bf16 更高（85.1% vs 65.0%；98.3% vs 89.5%），再次暴露选择效应；额外 cap 不能由循环解释。

**5）头定位（Nemotron-Nano-v2）**：teacher-forced KL 份额 q0 49%、q1 37%、q2 15%，但闭环排序相反——SR on q1+q2（25% 头）F_log=1.03、cap 1，几乎完全消除；SR on q0 无效（−0.12）；等头数对照 q0+q3 无效（−0.05）；864 随机头无效（0.06）；"全部除 q1+q2"无效（0.07）；KL top-2 的 q0+q1 仅恢复 0.59（差 0.44 [0.26,0.64]）；q2 单独 0.43 优于 q0 的 −0.12（差 0.55 [0.34,0.80]）。头组联合效果大于各部分之和（探索性）。迁移性：12B 母模型同带 SR F_log=0.84；Nemotron-3 与 Qwen3.5-9B 三项预注册检验全部失败，效应分散在各头（Qwen3.5-9B 768 头中该带仅 174 头，带内 0.35、带外 594 头 0.67、带 vs 随机 0.10）。探索性地，教师强制下 "Alternatively" 的上升顺序与闭环一致，而其他三个标记不一致。

**6）预注册检验结果**：19 项预注册中多数通过；失败项包括 Nemotron-3 的全头 SR 与带 SR（0.38、−0.27）、Qwen3.5-9B 的三项带定位检验、以及"16K 上限能放大精度差距"的模拟检验（Nemotron +2.2pp 通过，Qwen3.5 −3.7pp 失败）。

Conclusion: **核心结论**：bf16 + RTN 的循环状态缓存是混合推理模型"想太久"的一个被忽视的系统性成因，其机理是每步重舍入造成的偏置相干累积（bf16 仅 8 位有效位，相对半间距 u=2^-9），而非位宽分辨率不足——同位宽无偏的 SR 即可在 4/5 模型上完全恢复 FP32 水平，且不增加显存、用整数哈希随机源时解码速度无损。这同时反驳了"FP16 优于 bf16 只因分辨率更细"的解释，也解释了为何按误差幅度衡量的方法（LeapQuant 的 SR 只降误差 3×）会低估 SR 的行为收益：真正起作用的是偏置而非误差量级。

**次级结论**：该失败在数学与代码任务上同时存在；其形态随模型而变——Nemotron-Nano-v2 谱系以"更长但能完成"为主（额外 token 成本），Qwen3.5-9B 则额外包含大量永不终止的精确重复循环，这类损失被"两臂都完成"的准确率对比与"截断浪费分解"完全掩盖；128K 预算可消除约一半差距但不能消除不终止问题。精度分配不应依赖 teacher-forced KL：在 Nemotron-Nano-v2 中 KL 最高的慢衰减头单独 SR 完全无效，真正起作用的是中等衰减带（约 25% 头，且需成组而非零散覆盖），且该规律只是该谱系的性质，在 Nemotron-3 与 Qwen3.5-9B 中失效，需逐模型用闭环生成验证。

**实践建议**：（1）每次评测都报告实际解析出的循环状态 dtype 与舍入模式（不同引擎默认不同：vLLM 0.33 对无 `mamba_ssm_dtype` 的 Qwen3.5 配置用模型 dtype 即 bf16，SGLang 0.5.21 回落到 FP32，微调删字段会静默改变）；（2）准确率必须与 cap 率、输出长度一并报告；（3）不要把"两臂都完成"的准确率当作"无能力损失"，应加大预算重跑被截断题并统计精确循环；（4）状态精度变更应以闭环生成长度验证，而非只看 KL；（5）生产上优先 FP32 状态，其次是 16 位 + SR（bf16 SR 在 SGLang 中尚不可用，需自行 patch；Nemotron-3 需单独验证）。

**局限**：单一引擎与 GPU 型号、单一引擎版本，多数实验臂单种子（9B 每臂两种子、Nemotron-3 两个 FP32 种子、Qwen3.5-9B 两次 bf16 RTN）；SR 只作用于 decode，prefill 仍为 RTN；FP32 臂并发上限与 bf16 臂不同（已在 Nemotron-3 匹配、Qwen3.5-9B 未触发）；128K 分析仅两模型；头定位的对照实验只在 9B 上做；Falcon-H1R-7B 的零效应与 Nemotron-3 的残留偏移均未获解释；先验工作检索仅覆盖 arXiv 与 SGLang/vLLM 仓库。

Abstract: Hybrid reasoning models interleave attention with recurrent mixers such as Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet, whose state is cached between decoding steps. Prior work showed that storing this state in FP16 or INT8 with round-to-nearest (RTN) makes Mamba-2 and GDN hybrids more verbose, and that stochastic rounding (SR) fixes it. We study the other 16-bit format that serving engines expose, bf16, on six open hybrid reasoning models and 590 competition-math problems. With bf16 RTN state, five of six models reason longer (geometric-mean length 1.07x to 1.27x; also under greedy decoding in the two models tested) and hit the 32K token cap more often. On Qwen3.5-9B, cap hits rise from 118 to 223 and accuracy falls from 85.6% to 70.8%. On LiveCodeBench, both models tested also reason longer and lose 12.6 and 13.4 points of pass@1. Rerunning the capped items with a 128K budget halves the accuracy gap but does not close it (93.6% vs. 86.6%): bf16 runs that never finish are twice as common, and 85% of them are exact repetition loops. On Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2, by contrast, 30 of 31 extra caps finish at 128K, so the cost there is mostly extra tokens (exploratory). Same-width bf16 SR removes the length increase in four of five affected models, restores Qwen3.5-9B to 87.6% and brings code length and pass@1 near FP32 levels, so the failure is mostly rounding bias, not missing resolution. With an integer-hash random generator, SR on Qwen3.5-9B matches FP32 on cap hits and accuracy (113 vs. 118; 85.6% for both) at the memory and decoding speed of bf16 RTN. In the Nemotron-Nano-v2 lineage, SR on 25% of heads (an intermediate-decay band) removes the effect, while random heads and the top teacher-forced-KL octiles do not; in Nemotron-3 and Qwen3.5-9B the effect is spread across heads. We recommend that evaluations of hybrid models report the state dtype, cap rate and output length alongside accuracy.

</details>


### [45] [TrajLift: Lifting Memory Recall Trajectories with Latency-Modulated Heat Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12197)
*Jiawen Kang,Jinchao Li,Mingyu Cui,Junan Li,Xixin Wu,Helen Meng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TrajLift 是一个谱图框架，把阿尔茨海默病相关的言语记忆回忆过程建模为「语义层级图上的带时间轨迹」，核心机制是「延迟调制热扩散」：用热核 e^{-τL} 将每个被回忆词提升为多尺度层级结构表示，并用相邻词之间的反应时调制扩散时间 τ，从而在单一算子中联合编码层级结构与连续时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 言语记忆测验（CVLT、HKLLT）中的回忆顺序、犹豫、语义类别组织对阿尔茨海默病有诊断价值，但计算建模几乎空白。核心难点是「时间与结构诊断性纠缠」：同一反应时的诊断意义取决于其所处的层级上下文（簇内停顿 vs. 跨簇切换停顿）。已有范式与该设定不匹配：动态图模型（TGN/TGAT）建模拓扑演化，而语义层级对所有被试是静态的；轨迹类图模型（TrajGAT 等）把时间当作离散步骤或忽略连续延迟；层次池化（DiffPool/SAGPool）层级是隐式学习的。文本编码器（BERT/RoBERTa）与手工特征则把回忆序列退化为扁平字符串或聚合统计量，丢失了「结构化认知地图导航」的本质。此外，现有方法缺少「连续延迟如何在其所发生的结构语境中被解释」的机制。

Method: 问题设定：加权无向层级图 G=(V,W)，边权由超度量距离 d_ultra（即最近公共祖先层级）经单调递减函数 w 给出；时序轨迹 σ=((v_k,t_k))，延迟 δ_k=t_{k+1}-t_k，K 可变。表示学习：①多尺度结构提升——对单位指示向量 x_k=e_{v_k} 施加图热核 H_τ=e^{-τL} 得到 z_k(τ)，归一化拉普拉斯 L=I−D^{-1/2}WD^{-1/2} 的谱因边权随层级递减而呈带状聚集，故扩散时间 τ 连续控制所解析的层级分辨率；实例化为 micro/meso/macro 三尺度（τ_base=softplus(β_s)，初值 τ=−ln(α_s)/λ_max，α=0.85/0.25/0.002，对应保留率）。②时间编码——延迟经 φ(δ)=log(1+δ)（20 秒截尾）压缩后调制扩散时间 τ̃=τ_base(1+γ_s φ(δ))，γ_s 由训练集延迟 90 分位数与目标变化比 r=3 初始化；定义扩散残差 Δz=z_mod−z_base，与调制提升拼接并做 layer norm，得每尺度 2N 维。形式分析：Lemma 1 给出 z(τ+Δτ)=H_τ x−Δτ·L H_τ x+O(Δτ²)，即结构项与延迟一阶项可分离；Proposition 2 给出残差的带通谱响应 r_s(λ)=λ e^{−τ_base λ}，在 λ*=1/τ_base 处取峰，各尺度峰值分别落在高频簇内模态、中频、粗频跨域模态（HKLLT 中 1/τ 约为 8.2/0.96/0.21），且 90% 延迟下 τ̃≤3τ_base 保证不跨入相邻尺度带区。③读出——门控恒等残差融合（micro 为恒等通路，meso/macro 逐级门控注入），投影后用 2 层 LSTM 聚合变长轨迹，线性分类器 + 交叉熵。附录 A 给出平衡两层/多层（相邻层权比 ρ≫C，谱隙 γ=n(ρ−1)/((n−1)ρ+n(C−1))）下特征值分带与热核三阶段行为的完整证明。

Result: 合成 ST-XOR 基准（每变体 2000 条平衡轨迹，2→64/32→256/4→32→256 三种层级，Coherent/Chaotic 两类在边类型边缘分布与平均延迟上完全相同，构成 XOR 陷阱）：TrajLift 在三变体上分别达 98.00/99.22/98.67%，而 LSTM+/Transformer+ 最高仅 67.78%（宽/深变体近随机 49–53%）；TGN、Graphormer+ 靠记忆簇成员（73–76%）但在宽变体崩溃至 49–55%；TGAT、TrajGAT+、GAT+/R-GCN+ 混合基线在两层变体 >82% 却在三层变体全部跌至 47–50%（感受野无法感知超簇关系）。消融显示：仅含 macro 尺度的子集即达 99.67%，说明关键是存在能解析承载信号层级的尺度而非尺度数量；不平衡层级（簇大小 CV 至 0.97）仍约 99%；时间戳噪声下当两类分布重叠约 24% 仍保持 95% 准确率，d'<1 才接近随机。临床数据：HKLLT（402 人中分析 387 人，NC=233/NCD=154，16 词三层语义层级）Trial 4（10 分钟延迟）与 Trial 5（30 分钟延迟）：TrajLift 准确率 77.52%/80.38%，宏 F1 76.22%/79.67%，敏感度 69.35%/78.92%，优于全部基线（Recall count LR 74.96/75.90、低层特征 LR 74.79/75.90、BERT 72.05/74.19、RoBERTa 75.56/73.76、LSTM+ 73.85/73.46、Transformer+ 75.00/73.50、TGN 69.02/70.47、TGAT 67.53/68.95、TrajGAT+ 74.62/75.13、Graphormer+ 74.57/75.56、GAT+/R-GCN+ 混合 74.49–75.77）。在 HKLLT-5 上配对准确率增益相对四个强基线中三个显著（Nadeau–Bengio 校正 95% CI，15 折中胜 13–15 折），超手工基线 4.5 个百分点；HKLLT-4 上差异不显著（仍 9–11/15 折占优）。组间效应量解释该差异：平均延迟的 Cohen's |d| 从 T4 的 0.32 升至 T5 的 0.64，而回忆数（1.44 vs 1.50）与语义聚类（0.74 vs 0.93）变化有限；测试时延迟置零/置均值使准确率下降 3.93/7.18（T4）与 6.84/17.26（T5），与延迟效应量一致，说明优势随时间信息量增大而扩大。分析显示学习到的扩散时间分离明显（micro τ=0.19 保留高频，macro τ=4.14 仅留低频），余弦相似度保持超度量层级结构，嵌入距离随延迟单调增加，预测对时序打乱的 KL 散度随打乱比例上升，说明模型依赖时序顺序而非仅边缘延迟统计。

Conclusion: TrajLift 用「延迟调制热扩散」把言语回忆表示提升为兼具多尺度层级结构与连续时序的单一谱算子，形式上证明结构与时间的一阶可分离性及跨层级的时间谱选择性；在需要结构—时间交互的深层级合成任务上几乎完美且基线全部失败；在真实临床 HKLLT 数据上优于传统临床指标与多种计算基线，优势随延迟信息量增加而扩大，说明其增益来自对每个停顿的层级上下文的联合建模而非聚合统计。该框架可推广到其他「固定层级上发生的有序事件」场景（如内容分类法上的点击流、知识图谱导航）。局限：理论假设平衡层级划分（经验上不平衡影响不大）；ST-XOR 每变体仅在单一层级放置交互，无法检验多尺度组合必要性；临床样本量小、标签为综合性 NCD 而非特定 AD、单一本地人群存在分布偏移；模型定位为辅助筛查工具而非独立诊断，需多中心外部验证；数据属受保护健康信息不可公开，仅合成基准与代码开源（github.com/kjw11/TrajLift）。

Abstract: Verbal memory retrieval carries rich diagnostic information for Alzheimer's disease through the order, hesitation, and categorical organization of recalled words, yet computational modeling of this retrieval process remains largely unexplored. A key challenge is that timing and hierarchical structure are diagnostically entangled: the diagnostic meaning of retrieval timing depends on its hierarchical context. We propose TrajLift, a spectral framework that models verbal recall as timed trajectories on a hierarchical graph. Our central mechanism is latency-modulated heat diffusion on the semantic hierarchy, a unified operator that lifts each recalled word into a representation of both multi-scale hierarchical structure and continuous retrieval timing. Formal analysis shows that the resulting representation is first-order separable into structural and temporal components with spectral selectivity across hierarchical levels. On synthetic benchmarks requiring structure-time interaction, TrajLift stays near-perfect on deep hierarchies where all baselines fail. On real-world clinical data, we show that TrajLift outperforms diverse baselines by jointly modeling timing and semantic structure, with gains that grow as retrieval timing becomes more informative.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有投机解码（Medusa、EAGLE-3、DFlash、DSpark）都只在目标自身词表里草拟，因此候选树的一个节点恒等于一个目标 token；提升路径只有"更多节点/更深更宽的树/更多头/更高命中率"。作者指出这一"单位为常数"的假设是错的：BPE 的预分词器先按空白切分再学合并，因此任何多词字符串都不可能成为单个 token（Qwen3-4B 中 "United States of America" 为 4 token，且不存在含相邻对的词表条目）。由此作者在早期自研的词级草稿器上观测到 landing 达 0.711 却每次仅入账 1.049 个目标 token——限制来自"单位"而非接受率。与 SuperBPE/AdaptiVocab/ZeTT 等改写目标分词器的路线不同，本文不触碰目标：多词词表仅存在于草稿头内，验证前全部展开回目标 token。作者还强调词表"生育率"（fertility）差异放大该缺口（Qwen3-4B：英文 1.38 token/词，印地语 5.00，泰卢固语 11.73，印地语系均值 8.68；153 个印地文 token 仅占 151,669 的 0.17%）。

Abstract: Speculative decoders raise throughput by banking more target tokens per forward pass, and Medusa, EAGLE-3, DFlash and DSpark all do it the same way: more candidates that survive verification. All of them draft in the target's own vocabulary, so one node of the candidate tree is one target token, and the tokenizer makes that unit look like a constant. It is not. BPE's pretokenizer splits on whitespace before merges are learned, so no multi-word string can ever become a single token: in Qwen3-4B, "United States of America" is four tokens and no adjacent pair of them exists as one entry, so a phrase is out of reach of any method drafting in the target's vocabulary. We change the unit. A small MLP head reads the frozen target's hidden state and predicts a one- to three-word phrase as one entry in a separate draft vocabulary; greedy longest-match expansion maps it back into the target's own tokens, and N candidates are verified in one forward pass behind a prefix-tree mask, so the change is orthogonal to tree depth and width. The target and its tokenizer stay frozen and a candidate is accepted only while it matches the target's own argmax, so the served output is identical to greedy decoding up to floating-point tie-breaking. On one A5000 at batch 1, against HuggingFace generate(), a 21.94M head (0.545% of Qwen3-4B) reaches 2.391x on GSM8K, 2.444x on MATH-500 and 1.544x on MT-Bench. Because the head's output layer is one row of 257 parameters per entry, the draft vocabulary size is the parameter budget: an 8,000-entry head is 3.434M parameters, 0.0854% of the target and 64x smaller than EAGLE-3's drafter, and keeps 92.3% of the larger head's GSM8K tokens per pass. With EAGLE-3 run on same prompts and baseline, our 21.94M head is ahead of tree-16 on both maths sets and behind tree-60 on every set.

### [47] [Text Grouping Changes Completion-Time Comparisons in Long-Form Simultaneous Speech Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12501)
*Hieu Minh Truong,Dung D. Le*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文证明：在同语料、同 TTS 的条件下，仅仅改变"文本更新如何分组送入语音合成"就会显著改变两个翻译器之间的完成时间差。4 秒分组使 StreamAtt 相对基线的完成领先在 XTTS-v2 上从 106.6 秒扩大到 229.1 秒（η=−122.5 秒，95% CI [−180.0,−69.9]），在 Piper 上却从 169.5 秒缩小到 146.5 秒（η=+23.0 秒，CI [7.4,41.0]）；相反方向在独立的 20 篇讲稿上复现。机制在于分组缩短了音频时长，但各后端的"播放空闲"变化方向不同。作者由此主张：语音翻译的时序评测必须同时报告文本分组规则、端点释放规则、真实请求规模、音频时长、播放空闲与首播延迟，仅报告 TTS 模型名称是不充分的；同时强调这些时序差异不能被解读为翻译质量提升（自动识别与对齐只是间接证据）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同语料、同 TTS 模型并不等于两个翻译器的合成输入可比：一个翻译器可能输出大量短更新，另一个输出少量长更新；系统既可逐条合成也可先分组再合成。分组同时改变文本上下文与请求边界，即使目标词不变，合成音频的时长也会变化。作者的核心问题不是"分组能否缩短某个系统的播放"，而是"分组是否改变两个翻译器之间的完成时间差（completion gap）"——因为在语音翻译评测中，报告 TTS 模型而不说明文本如何进入合成，等于把时序比较中关键的一部分留作未定义。

Method: 把翻译与合成解耦：每场讲稿、每种历史策略保存"新增提交文本 + 其可用时刻"流 (x_i, a_i)，在组内保持文本与时间戳不变，只重放不同分组规则，从而把"分组干预"与"翻译流变化"分离。翻译器为同一 StreamAtt 检查点的注意力音频历史策略 A 与固定音频历史基线 F（FBK-fairseq 实现）。语料为 10 篇 MuST-C 英德讲稿（探索面板，共 6315.6 秒）+ 另选 20 篇（确认面板）。分组规则包括即时派发 (w=0)、2 秒/4 秒定时器（以最旧待处理更新起算，终点不重置，翻译结束提前释放）、标点触发+2 秒上限、8 词+2 秒上限；分组后再按输入上限切分为多个请求。合成后端为 XTTS-v2（GPU H100，Ana Florence 语音）与 Piper 1.4.2（CPU，de_DE-thorsten-high），二者前端/语音/硬件不同，非等硬件比较。播放为串行、正常速度、主分析不裁剪；就绪时间含前端处理、推理与传输，排除加载/预热/日志/落盘。计时模型为 C_j=max(r_j, C_{j−1})+d_j，D=Σd_j，I=Σmax(0, r_j−C_{j−1})，L=D+I−S（相对源结束的完成偏移）；完成差 δ_s(w)=L(A,w)−L(F,w)，变化 η_s(w)=δ_s(w)−δ_s(0)，每后端单独统计、各讲稿等权，10,000 次配对讲稿自助法给描述性 95% 区间。另做内容与词时诊断（Whisper-large-v3-turbo 与 Qwen3-ASR 独立转写、Qwen3-ForcedAligner 对齐、Silero VAD 语音活动），以及 CosyVoice 3 持续会话分组喂文本实验（20 个配对块、40 次会话，状态跨喂入保持、块间重置），并对 XTTS 三个种子、Piper 三次实现、请求边缘静音裁剪、句子级释放/零服务时间重放做敏感性分析。

Result: 探索面板：XTTS-v2 下 StreamAtt 平均领先由 106.58 秒增至 229.08 秒（η(4)=−122.50，CI [−180.03,−69.92]，9/10 篇效应为负）；Piper 下领先由 169.46 秒降至 146.46 秒（η(4)=+23.01，CI [7.36,40.99]，7/10 篇为正）。确认面板 20 篇复现相反方向：XTTS η(4)=−106.29（CI [−148.74,−67.53]，17/20 为负），Piper η(4)=+34.11（CI [17.52,55.17]，19/20 为正）；两个面板中 StreamAtt 的平均优势顺序均未反转。时长–空闲分解解释差异：XTTS 下 StreamAtt 节省 357.00 秒音频而仅增加 22.03 秒空闲，故提前完成；Piper 下 StreamAtt 虽多省 73.71 秒（基线 50.63 秒），却多出 60.75 秒空闲（基线 14.66 秒），基线在终点处获益更多，故领先被压缩；talk 805 的 XTTS 从 2 秒改 4 秒恰好省 33.408 秒音频并增加等量空闲，完成时间不变。分组使首播平均延迟约 5 秒（XTTS）/4 秒（Piper）。分组后 Piper 全部 20 个波形变短但仅在 8 个 StreamAtt、7 个基线讲稿上提前完成。CosyVoice 3 持续会话中配对波形完全相同，分组反而使完成平均推迟 1.49 秒（StreamAtt 块）与 2.19 秒（基线块），20 块中 19 块更晚结束，仅 1 块提前 0.038 秒；此时时长不变，端点差异全部来自空闲。内容侧：两种识别器均显示分组后总编辑率下降（XTTS-StreamAtt 归一化 Whisper 23.05%→14.87%；Piper 7.65%→6.60%），但 XTTS 删除错配上升（StreamAtt 612→1313），且检测到的非语音仅解释 38.75%–43.43% 的时长缩减，无法判定缩短来自更少重复、更快语速还是内容缺失；基线意图文本长 37.4%，但不构成覆盖率或准确率证据。词时对齐显示 4 秒分组显著降低可识别词的中位附加延迟（StreamAtt −173.56 秒、基线 −105.36 秒，p90 分别 −314.88/−203.06），但公共词子集仅覆盖 58.96%/53.24% 意图词，7.52% 时间戳单元无效。稳健性：XTTS 三种子 η(4) 位于 [−127.6,−116.8]；Piper 三次实现均值 +23.01/+23.71/+23.99 均为正；去除请求边缘静音后效应幅度减小但符号不变（XTTS −96.37~−87.58，Piper +16.94~+19.72）；标点规则与 2 秒定时器差异为 +8.47 秒（XTTS）/−1.91 秒（Piper）。

Conclusion: 文本进入合成的方式本身就是时序评测的一个未说明变量：固定翻译更新下，分组规则可在不同 TTS 后端上把同一对翻译器的完成差距推向相反方向，且在独立语料面板上复现。因此评测应同时报告分组与端点释放规则、实际请求规模、音频时长、播放空闲、首播延迟与最终完成时间。同时必须区分"早完成"与"译得好"：自动识别与强制对齐只能描述输出，不能确立翻译准确度、可懂度或内容完整性；音频变短可能来自重复减少、语速加快甚至内容缺失。作者明确列出限制（仅英德、单检查点两策略、单语音、跨后端不可归因架构、无人工听评、确认面板不证明跨语言/领域/语音泛化、部分对比为事后选择的探索性分析、XTTS 对齐时间戳规则事后修改未校准），并给出伦理说明与 AI 工具使用声明。

Abstract: Does grouping translation updates before speech synthesis change the measured completion gap between two translators? We compare StreamAtt with its fixed-audio-history baseline on ten English-German talks. For each translation, we keep the intended text and its availability times fixed and vary how updates are grouped for synthesis. Four-second grouping increases StreamAtt's mean completion lead from 106.6 to 229.1 seconds with XTTS-v2, but reduces it from 169.5 to 146.5 seconds with Piper. Both produce shorter audio; different changes in playback idle account for the opposite effects. These directions recur on a separately selected twenty-talk panel. In continuing CosyVoice 3 sessions, grouping instead leaves paired audio unchanged and delays completion on nineteen of twenty blocks. A speech-timing comparison therefore needs to specify how text enters synthesis, not just which synthesizer is used. Recognition and automatic word timing describe the outputs, but do not establish translation accuracy or intelligibility.

*Yizhuo Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AgentOPSD 是一种无需 critic 的长程智能体信用分配方法：把技能条件化的"特权自教师"与学生策略之间的 token 级对数概率差，在回合（turn）边界处聚合为回合级证据 e_k，再在 log-odds 空间做递归贝叶斯信念更新，得到每回合对"最终成功概率"的边际修正 ΔB_k；用带结果符号的 q_k = sign(A_seq)·ΔB_k 经轨迹内标准化后形成有界乘子，把 GRPO 的单一序列级优势重塑为回合级优势 Â_k = A_seq[(1−λ)+λw_k]，从而在不额外采样、不训练价值网络的前提下实现细粒度信用分配。ALFWorld 上以 Qwen2.5-3B/7B 为骨干，7B 达到 89.1% 成功率，超过 GRPO（81.2%）与各自蒸馏基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在带可验证奖励（RLVR）的长程多轮智能体交互中，GRPO 仅由终止奖励产生一个序列级优势并均匀广播到所有 token/turn，无法区分"决定成败的关键决策"与冗余、误导性动作，且随轮数增加偏差累积加剧。另一条路线——特权自蒸馏（OPSD 类）——虽然提供了更密集的 token 级监督，但没有回答"一组局部师生差异应如何转化为序列上的信用"：一是粒度错配（token 级信号与"多 token 共同构成一个动作、环境仅在回合末反馈"不对齐），二是缺乏记忆（已有 step 级方法各自独立打分，未利用历史）。论文的核心主张是：一回合的信用不应等于其局部信号本身，而应等于该信号对"轨迹最终成功概率"这一累积信念的修正幅度——即把自蒸馏 gap 视作新到达的证据，做递归贝叶斯更新（Åström; Kaelbling 等），在 log-odds 空间中让证据随历史衰减并被状态敏感度 B(1−B) 门控，从而刻画"该回合把信念推动了多少"。

Privileged self-distillation supplies denser supervision, but it leaves unanswered how a set of local teacher-student discrepancies should be converted into credit along a sequence.   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TTP 需要同时选择巡回路线与装载方案，租金率 R 是连接两部分的关键参数：当 R=0 时，目标函数退化为 Z(π,S)=P(S)，路径不影响目标，实例本质变为 0-1 背包问题。作者在开发新的 TTP 方法时发现，分类 A 类中基于 dsj1000 的实例多次运行返回完全相同的值 144,426（即背包部分最优利润），且文件给出 R=0.00。随后作者扫描全部 9,720 个文件，统计该问题的分布，并考察零租金对已发表结果与算法排序的影响。此前没有研究指出这一现象的来源、涉及的全部实例、对已发表结果的影响，也未提出修正方案。

Conclusion: 基准中 4 个实例因租金的两位小数存储格式而成为零租金退化实例，其中一个污染了最常用的 60 个分类实例比较集；原始租金无法从已公开数据恢复，但可通过生成器同一规则在完全指定的参考解上定义新租金加以修正，且修正后实例重新具备 TTP 性质。四条后续建议：(1) 与已发表结果比较的研究应同时报告原文件（R=0.00，最优值 144,426）与修正文件上的结果，并声明所用版本；(2) 不与已发表值比较的研究应使用修正文件并说明版本；(3) 解读小租金实例的结果时需谨慎（分类实例中 4 个相对舍入半宽>5%）；(4) 未来的实例生成器应以足够有效数字存储双精度租金，并同时发布参考解与校验容差，使参考解目标值必须在容差内为零，从而可被逐文件自动检查。

Abstract: The traveling thief problem (TTP) asks a thief to choose a tour and a packing together, and the benchmark of 9,720 instances of Polyakovskiy et al. (2014) is the standard test set for comparing TTP heuristics. We show that four of these instances are not TTP instances at all. Their files give a renting rate of 0.00, so the tour has no effect on the objective and each instance reduces to a 0-1 knapsack problem. One of them belongs to the 60 categorized instances on which new methods are usually compared, and on it five of nine published methods report exactly the same value. The cause is the format of the files, which keep the renting rate with two decimals, while the rule of the generator gives a rate close to 0.003 on these instances. The same rounding may shift the rate of 949 other instances by more than 1%. Since the tour and the packing used by the generator were not published, the original rates cannot be recovered. We therefore define new rates with the same rule, applied to a fully specified reference solution that we publish, and we show with a published heuristic that the corrected instances behave as TTP instances again. We also give reference results on the corrected instances and recommendations for future studies. Finally, we present ttplib, a new open-source Python library that loads any of the 9,720 instances, including the corrected ones, without downloading the whole benchmark.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 罗马化尼泊尔语（尼泊尔语拉丁字母写法）在数字通信中极为常见（某社交媒体语料中超过半数评论为转写或混合形式，某健康聊天机器人 61.0% 的查询用罗马化尼泊尔语），但它没有标准正字法、同一词有多种拼写、常混用英语词，且资源极少；已有研究表明模型处理罗马化输入明显弱于天城文（如某分诊场景 F1 低 9.5 点）。在生成场景中输出必须使用用户所输入的脚本，因此"直接适配模型"（而非输入端转写/归一化）才是可行路径，2–3B 小模型配合参数高效微调可在单张 16GB GPU 上完成。但选择与评估这些模型并不简单：候选模型在分词器、架构、规模、预训练数据上同时不同；fertility（每词子词数）作为选择依据与下游性能的关系在不同研究中不一致；逐 token 困惑度无法跨分词器比较；模型在参考文本上的似然未必反映其生成文本的性质；单次训练会掩盖随机种子带来的波动。最接近的前期基准（Rimal & Rimal）只比较了三个 7–8B 模型、每次仅一次运行并使用逐 token 困惑度，未测量 fertility，未考察小模型与种子层面的不确定性。本文据此提出 RQ1–RQ4：三个 2–3B 家族在同一 PEFT 配方下的适配效果与种子稳定性、fertility 能否指示最优模型、参考似然与生成重叠是否一致、零样本行为与增益对提示的敏感性。

### [51] [The Narrative Gap: Can LLMs Help Us Navigate Diverse Narratives Across Languages?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12750)

TL;DR: 本文提出 NarrativeBench：一个面向多语言「叙事导航」的信息检索评测基准，包含 23 个争议性议题、23 种出版语言下的 1,333 篇新闻文章、180 个叙事组、460 条基于 Reddit 的查询（230 中性 / 230 确认性），翻译为 24 种查询语言共 11,038 个查询-语言版本；在 14 个模型（15 种配置）× 4,800 个案例上共评测 72,000 条回答。结果显示当前 LLM 普遍不具备所需能力：叙事包含（NI）平均 F1 仅 19.9%，叙事排除（NE）49.3%，遗漏叙事识别（MNI）召回 56.8%；多语证据下的叙事覆盖基线 44.3%、显式要求多样性后 49.2%（最强配置仍有约 1/4 叙事缺失）；查询语言与英语的差距平均 8.74 个百分点，目标叙事语言差距 7.51 个百分点；低资源来源语言（提格雷尼亚语、尼泊尔语、亚美尼亚语）的遗漏率比英语高 55–60 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 正在成为新的信息中介层，但既有的信息检索系统与 LLM 往往复制甚至放大回音室、过滤气泡与语言不平等：已有研究显示模型会强化用户既有立场、偏好查询语言来源、在证据冲突时难以推理。本文的问题意识是：面对同一事件在不同语言与地区存在不同因果与道德解读的现实，用户需要的不只是翻译，而是「导航多元叙事」的能力；论文因此把「多语言多元信息检索」形式化为「叙事导航」问题，并指出缺乏对所需能力的清晰定义，导致模型改进无法被度量。

叙事被操作化为「某议题在特定语言中、由锚定于特定地理区域的来源所表达的解释」，便于审计与度量；作者承认同一地区/语言内部也存在叙事差异，该操作化是必要但非充分条件。

三项具体缺口：①用户无法可靠地指定或排除某一种叙事（选择控制权缺失，形成「控制的幻觉」）；②即使显式要求多样性，模型仍大量遗漏可用叙事；③不同服务、不同查询语言与不同框架下可获得的信息不对等，威胁跨语言跨地区共同讨论议题所需的共同基础（common ground）。

Method: 采用 Evidence-Centered Benchmark Design（Liu et al.）框架，先定义能力、再设计任务与度量。

（1）能力体系：三个基础能力——叙事包含 NI（请求某叙事时只引该叙事）、叙事排除 NE（排除某叙事、覆盖其余）、遗漏叙事识别 MNI（给定单一叙事的既有回答，补全被遗漏叙事）；三个高阶能力——HC-1 呈现多元叙事（BP 基线提示 vs DP 多样性提示）、HC-2 在确认性查询下保持覆盖、HC-3 跨语言的信息对等（查询语言轴 + 叙事语言轴）。

（2）数据构建：四阶段采集（选定争议议题→确定相关地区与利益方→制定地区化检索词→用 Google Advanced Search / Yandex / Baidu 收集文章与 URL），筛除不可读正文与不可识别来源，得到 43 个国家/地区/区域组织、1,333 篇文章、180 个叙事组；文章按「来源视角 × 出版语言」归组。用 multilingual-e5-base 多语嵌入做诊断：同组文章平均余弦相似度差 0.047（95% bootstrap CI [0.044, 0.051]，置换检验 p<0.001），同语言内同视角仍更相似（0.012）。

（3）查询：Reddit 真实提问 283 条 + 针对覆盖不足议题的 177 条改写（经忠实度复核）；两名独立标注者对 100 条英文查询评「是否会问 AI」均值 4.09/4.89（5 分制，无人评为不可能）；230 中性 / 230 确认性。Google Translate 生成 24 语言版本，COMETKiwi-DA 均值 0.853–0.879，人工审查 132 条评分：90.8% 保真、89.0% 可信；翻译质量与基准得分无可检测关联（r=-0.019，p=0.596）。

（4）度量与协议：每个案例为「文档上下文 + 查询 + 任务指令」，每个入选叙事给 3 篇文章（上下文 9–45 篇，中位 24）；模型须用查询语言作答并以 [Dxxxx] 引用文档 ID（ID 不泄露来源地区/语言）。以引用判定叙事是否出现，计算叙事精确率/召回/F1（NI、NE 用 F1；MNI、BP、DP 用召回）。HC-1 用 ΔDP−BP；HC-2 用中性 vs 确认性的平均绝对差并在附录用回归（含主题/查询语言/提示条件、聚类稳健标准误）给出符号方向；HC-3 用 Δℓ=Mℓ−Men，并对非英语语言等权平均；另设来源语言遗漏率（上下文含该语言但零引用即计遗漏）与语言校验（Lingua + fastText，语言不符记 0 分）。14 模型 15 配置共 72,000 条回答。

（5）稳健性/对照分析：引用选择对照（无文档/全部/按引用数随机，1,720 例）、输入长度（11k–122k token）回归、推理档位与输出上限对比、知识截止后证据分析、WildChat/ShareChat 真实对话查询、引用支持度人工审计（κ=0.708，加权 κ=0.866）。

Result: 基础能力全面不足：NI 平均 F1 19.9%（SE 0.6）低于 NE 49.3%，且在全部 15 种配置中 NI 均低于 NE；最佳 NI 为 Gemini 3.8 Flash 52.5%，最佳 MNI 召回 82.8%，最佳 NE 为 Gemini 2.5 Pro 74.2%。

高阶能力：HC-1 基线召回 44.3%、多样性提示 49.2%，最强配置 Gemini 2.5 Pro 达 70.6%/74.9%，即显式要求多样性后仍约四分之一可用叙事未被引用。HC-2 中性 vs 确认性 BP/DP 召回平均绝对差 3.23 个百分点（Qwen3.5 9B IT 0.32 → Gemini 3.8 Flash 10.09），任务间 NI 3.41 > BP 3.32 > DP 3.30 > NE 2.72 > MNI 2.43；附录回归显示方向不一致（部分模型确认性查询召回更高，Kimi K2.6 为 −3.2pp），并给出实例：回答在引用更多叙事的同时背书查询前提（孟加拉语格陵兰案例 83.3% vs 50.0%）。

HC-3 语言不平等：查询语言差距平均 8.74pp（3.59 Kimi K2.6 至 13.84 GPT-OSS 20B 低推理），目标叙事语言差距 7.51pp（2.76 Qwen3.5 0.8B IT 至 10.72 Gemini 3.8 Flash）；DP 条件下提格雷尼亚语、尼泊尔语、亚美尼亚语来源遗漏率比英语高 59.8、57.9、54.6pp；来源语言遗漏率在查询语言匹配时为 41.3%，不匹配时 50.4%（23 个来源语言中 22 个均更低），印证语言偏好塑造可见叙事。

其他发现：Kimi K2.6 服务以「高风险」拒绝 4,800 个请求中的 552 个，拒答集中在敏感议题，说明服务侧策略本身决定信息可达性；提高推理档位对 NI 有益（28.11%→39.37%）却使 NE/MNI/BP/DP 下降 7.38–15.94pp（部分回答触及输出上限甚至为空）；模型引用选择仅在 NI 上优于随机，在 NE/MNI/BP/DP 低于随机，提示引用机制对覆盖存在系统性偏差；输入长度、翻译质量、知识截止时间对得分均无可检测影响。

Conclusion: 当前 LLM 无法可靠支持多语言多元信息检索：用户既无法控制呈现何种叙事，也无法在对话中找回被遗漏的视角，显式要求多样性仅带来有限增益，从而制造「控制的幻觉」。论文主张：(1) 将信息检索能力（包含/排除/找回叙事，以及跨语言、跨框架的稳健性）设为显式训练与评测目标，并要求改进在各能力与各语言间同时成立；(2) 认识到响应策略（安全拒答）与模型行为共同塑造信息可达性，跨服务、跨供应商的可比访问是构建共同基础的前提；(3) 政策与采购标准应要求披露跨语言、跨议题的叙事访问差距，并共享开放模型与评测资源；(4) 叙事对等是民主讨论所需共同基础的前提。

局限与未来方向：叙事按「地区×语言」归组掩盖了组内分歧；语料仅覆盖可检索的文本新闻，缺多模态与低可达信息流；争议报道含宣传与错误信息，需将多叙事访问与来源可信度核验结合；以引用代表叙事呈现，引用支持度仅抽样人工审计，尚未覆盖响应保真度与信息损失测量；高阶能力的真实影响需人类被试研究（选择性注意可能抵消覆盖提升）；当前仅评测固定查询与单次修订，缺多轮对话与信息消费（组织、细节、节奏）评估；此外可推广至科学研究与政策制定中的跨学科叙事导航。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate how people seek and consume information, including accounts that differ across languages and regions, especially on contested topics. Supporting diverse information seeking requires models to help users navigate competing narratives across languages and information streams. We define six capabilities necessary for diverse multilingual information seeking: three foundational capabilities for narrative inclusion, narrative exclusion, and missing narrative identification; and three higher-level capabilities for presenting diverse narratives, preserving narrative coverage under confirmatory queries, and maintaining information parity across languages. To guide the development of those information seeking capabilities, we introduce \textsc{NarrativeBench}, a benchmark comprising 1,333 news articles in 23 publication languages across 23 contested topics and 460 Reddit-grounded queries. Evaluating 14 LLMs across 24 query languages, we find that current models lack the capabilities needed to reliably navigate diverse narratives, limiting users' control over the perspectives they receive and leaving substantial gaps in exposure to competing accounts even when diversity is explicitly requested. Information access also differs across query framings and languages, risking echo chambers, linguistic filter bubbles, and information disparities that weaken the common ground needed for democratic discourse. \textsc{NarrativeBench} provides a foundation for developing information systems that give users across languages and regions agency to navigate diverse narratives.

</details>


### [52] [PORT: Preference Optimization via Robust Token-Level Reweighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12763)
*Ding Zhu,Xiukun Wei,Tian Xie,Zhihui Zhu,Xueru Zhang,Mohammad Mahdi Khalili*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PORT（Preference Optimization via Robust Token-level reweighting）是一种面向含噪偏好数据的细粒度偏好优化方法：它基于批次内 token log-prob 的经验 CDF 差异 Δ_CDF = F_l,t − F_w,t 构造 token 级权重 w_t = γ·exp(−ρ·Δ_CDF)，直接乘在 token 级 log-ratio 上，从而仅用前向传播即可抑制被污染 token，零额外反向传播开销、无需外部奖励模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 偏好优化（DPO、IPO 等）对偏好标注质量高度敏感，而实际标注常含 20%–40% 的错误（标注分歧、模糊配对、随机错误）。现有鲁棒方法均停留在序列级：cDPO/ROPO 对整条响应做统一标签平滑，Dr.DPO/wDPO 只给每个偏好对一个标量权重，fDPO/SamS 属于数据过滤（依赖外部奖励模型且可能整对丢弃），TIS-DPO 虽为 token 级但依赖外部奖励模型带来奖励误泛化与额外开销。而序列级建模隐含假设整条响应所有 token 等可靠，违背了「被拒回答仍含正确推理步、优选回答也可能含局部错误」的现实。因此需要在无外部监督的前提下实现 token 级自适应的噪声缓解。

Method: 理论部分：定义噪声下的梯度偏置 B = 𝔖̃ − 𝔖 与加权梯度偏置 B_w = Δ𝔖_w + R_b（噪声偏置项 + 重加权引入的干净梯度失真项）；用 Jensen 不等式与 Pinsker 不等式分别上界 ‖Δ𝔖_w‖ ≤ βK·E[η(z)w(z,t)‖∇δ_t‖]、‖R_b‖ ≤ C√(2D_KL(p_w‖p))，得到可解的正则化问题 min_w E[w·η·‖∇δ_t‖] + (1/λ)D_KL(p_w‖p)，由拉格朗日乘子得到闭式最优权重 w*(z,t) ∝ exp(−λ·η(z)‖∇δ_t‖)（定理1）。命题1给出充分条件（协方差条件），在 α-uncertain 噪声下 α<1 时成立（标注者比模型更不确定），ε-mislabeled 噪声下需 ε > E[σ(−βΣδ_t)]，即训练后期模型已能区分干净对时才成立。实践部分：由于 η(z) 与 ‖∇δ_t‖ 不可观测且代价高，验证 Δ_CDF 与梯度范数存在正相关（Pearson r=0.4526, n=8752），故以批次内所有非 padding token 的 log-prob 池构成参考集 ℛ 计算经验 CDF，用 Δ_CDF 替换梯度范数代理，得 w_t = γ exp(−ρ Δ_CDF)，并直接作用于加权 token 级目标 ℒ̃_w = E[f(β Σ_t w_t·δ_t)]，权重视为常数（不回传梯度），不加归一化约束。序列级方法可视为 w_t ≡ w_seq 的特例。

Result: AlpacaFarm（翻转率 0.3）：LLaMA2-7B 上 PORT 取得 Gold RM 3.82、GPT Win Rate 67.6%，较最强序列级基线 β-DPO 提升 +0.40 RM / +4.4% WR；Qwen3-4B 上 RM 2.98、WR 53.6%，整体与 SamS 互有优劣但 RM 最优（优势小于 7B，归因于 7B 更易记忆噪声标签）。Anthropic HH 无害性划分训练 + PKU-Beaver 评测：PORT 的 SR 0.55、GPT WR 67.6% 均为最高（次优 β-DPO 0.51/64.3%）。噪声强度消融（p=0.2/0.3/0.4）：PORT SR 0.56/0.55/0.53，DPO 0.45/0.42/0.38，与最好基线差距由 0.03 扩大到 0.06。噪声类型消融（p=0.4）：ε-mislabeled 下 SR 0.53 / WR 65.9%（超 Dr.DPO +0.05 / +4.1%），α-uncertain 下 SR 0.49 / WR 62.5%。批次大小敏感性（B=1/4/16，Qwen2.5-0.5B）：WR 39.1%→42.8%→44.3%，说明小批量尚可但需若干对以稳定秩估计。超参网格搜索最优 ρ=0.3、γ=1.5。训练动力学分析显示 PORT 使高分离度（可靠）对损失下降更快、低分离度（易翻转）对被有效边缘化。

Conclusion: PORT 将序列级噪声鲁棒性推进到 token 级：无需外部奖励模型、零额外反向传播开销，仅用前向统计即可对被污染 token 降权；理论上通过最小化梯度偏置上界导出闭式最优权重并给出严格改进的充分条件，实践上以 CDF 差异作为梯度范数的轻量代理，在 AlpacaFarm、Anthropic HH、PKU-Beaver 上一致优于序列级与过滤类基线。局限：依赖批次级统计，极小批量下可靠性下降；理论保证仅在特定充分条件下成立且难以在实践中验证；未来可扩展至多轮对话与自适应超参调度。

Abstract: Preference optimization has become a central approach for aligning large language models with human values, but its effectiveness depends heavily on the quality of preference annotations. In practice, preference data is often noisy due to annotation errors and ambiguity. Existing robust preference optimization methods primarily operate at the sequence level, implicitly treating entire responses as uniformly correct or incorrect. However, rejected responses may still contain informative reasoning steps, while preferred responses can include subtle errors. In this work, we propose \textbf{P}reference \textbf{O}ptimization via \textbf{R}obust \textbf{T}oken-level reweighting \textbf{(PORT)}, a fine-grained framework for robust alignment under noisy preferences. PORT performs token-level reweighting using the empirical cumulative distribution function (CDF) of token log-probabilities, yielding an efficient forward-pass-only proxy to gradient-norm penalization that selectively suppresses corrupted tokens without additional backward-pass computation. We provide theoretical analysis showing that PORT reduces the gradient bias from noisy preference labels by minimizing an upper bound on the bias term. Extensive experiments across diverse noise settings demonstrate that PORT consistently improves robustness and outperforms existing sequence-level baselines. The code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [53] [HiVe-Mem: Interleaving Horizontal Memory Expansion and Vertical Evidence Composition for Multimodal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12872)
*Haozhen Zhang,Bohan Liu,Jianzhu Bao,Qingyuan Liu,Haodong Yue,Xiao Li,Zi Pong Lim,Wenya Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: HiVe-Mem 是一个面向多模态智能体的记忆框架，通过「水平记忆扩展」（以文本/视觉锚点构建跨片段亲和图，在语义检索种子之外补充邻居记忆）与「垂直证据组合」（用 RL 训练的轻量选择器为每条被检索记忆按查询自适应地组合摘要、描述、grounded 视觉视图、原图、原交互文本等异构证据）两条互补路径，同时提升长程图文交互历史的召回覆盖与证据利用率，在三个多模态记忆基准上以约 90% 更低的 token 消耗取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态智能体在长期交互中会积累图文混合的长历史，但现有记忆系统存在两大缺陷：(1) 记忆检索多依赖压缩记忆上的语义相似度或以实体-关系为中心的结构化记忆，缺少显式符号关系的相关片段（共享实体、场景、事件的局部线索）难以被召回，导致相关证据分散在多次交互中被遗漏；(2) 每条被检索记忆只暴露预定义的单一表示（紧凑文本摘要或整幅原图），要么信息不足要么过度冗余，无法针对不同查询与不同记忆适配证据粒度，从而浪费 token 并限制记忆利用。作者因此提出核心问题：多模态记忆系统能否在推理时灵活识别并利用异构交互历史中的相关信息。

Method: 三阶段框架。(1) 片段中心的多模态记忆构建：将历史按约 256 token 的连续「交互片段」切分（不打断对话边界），由 VLM 一次生成紧凑摘要 s、文本锚点 T（实体/事件/主题）与视觉锚点 V（物体/场景/活动/属性）；每个记忆片段保留多种证据：原始交互文本 r、摘要 s、图像描述 c、原图 o、grounded 视觉视图 g（VLM 定位目标物体坐标后裁剪区域，视觉 token 较原图降 20–40%）。(2) 水平记忆扩展：构建无向亲和图，片段亲和度由锚点重叠 A_ij=(T_i∩T_j)∪(T_i∩V_j)∪(V_i∩T_j) 定义，权重 w_ij 为匹配锚点的 IDF 之和（抑制高频线索、突出特异性线索），并按度数上限 K_edge 贪心保留稀疏边；检索时先用摘要语义相似度取 K_ret=5 条种子，收集其一跳邻居作扩展候选，按 S_exp=Σ IDF(a)·sim(q,a) 排序取 K_exp=2 条，最终 Top-7。(3) 垂直证据组合：以 [E(q);E(s_i)] 为输入的 2048→256×3 轻量 MLP 一次前向输出各证据形式的选择概率，以 0.5 阈值二值化，为每条记忆独立决定暴露哪些证据；采用 PPO 进行强化学习训练，奖励 R = R_ans(F1) − λ·C̃(z)，成本项用滑动窗口分位数（Q5/Q95）裁剪归一化并按奖励标准差比例 α 对齐尺度；λ 越大越偏好紧凑证据，形成质量-成本可调的运行点。

Result: 在 Mem-Gallery、WorldMemArena(Lifelong 子集)、H2HMem 三个基准（6:2:2 划分，排除对抗设置）与 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct、GPT-5-mini 两个基座上，HiVe-Mem 平均取得最优 F1/LJ：Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 下 32.32/57.96，GPT-5-mini 下 35.94/64.69；Qwen 上三个基准 LJ 全部最佳，GPT-5-mini 上 F1/LJ 全部最佳，且选择器未重训直接迁移。平均 token 消耗仅 0.658M/0.748M，相对最高效的多模态基线（MemVerse 7.812M、MIRIX 7.350M）降低 91.6% 与 89.8%。消融显示：去水平扩展 57.96→56.51，去视觉锚点→57.30，去 IDF 加权→56.55；去垂直组合（仅摘要）降幅最大至 44.47，去原始文本→49.68，去原图→51.02，去 grounded 视图→57.19，去摘要→56.86，去描述→56.12。分析表明：λ 增大时原始历史选择率大幅下降、原图选择少但 token 占比高；按查询类型，文本主导查询几乎不选视觉证据，视觉主导查询原图选择率仅 35.2%（GPT-5-mini 下 30.2%/25.4%），说明证据组合细粒度优于按模态路由；超参上 K_edge=4 最优、K_ret:K_exp=5:2 最佳（4:3 相近，过度扩张有害）；TTFT 仅 1.03 秒，开销轻微。

Conclusion: HiVe-Mem 通过同时改进「检索哪些记忆」与「每条记忆暴露哪些证据」，让固定式记忆管线变为可按查询与预算自适应调节的多模态记忆架构，在三个基准、两个基座上以显著更低的推理开销取得一致提升，且证据选择策略可跨模型直接迁移而无需重训。局限与展望：证据形式目前仅为代表性集合，可引入结构化视觉描述或任务特定表示；选择器为轻量 MLP，可探索其他架构；仅验证两个基座，需在更多模型族与规模上评估。

Abstract: As multimodal agents accumulate increasingly long interaction histories, effectively retrieving and utilizing past information becomes critical for long-term interaction. Existing memory systems typically rely on semantic retrieval over compressed memories and expose predefined representations, which may miss relevant memories and overlook heterogeneous evidence needs across queries. We introduce \textbf{\hivemem}, a multimodal memory framework that interleaves \textbf{\textsc{H}}or\textbf{\textsc{i}}zontal Memory Expansion with \textbf{\textsc{Ve}}rtical Evidence Composition. For horizontal memory expansion, \hivemem organizes memory episodes into a relational graph using textual and visual anchors, expanding semantically retrieved seeds with related neighbors to recover complementary information. For vertical evidence composition, each retrieved memory retains multiple evidence forms, including compact summaries, captions, grounded visual views, raw images, and interaction history. A lightweight trainable selector independently composes an evidence subset for each retrieved memory, enabling query-adaptive utilization of heterogeneous multimodal information. This two-dimensional design jointly broadens memory coverage and adapts the evidence contributed by individual memories. Experiments across three multimodal memory benchmarks show that \hivemem consistently improves task performance across base models while reducing token consumption by about 90\% compared with the most efficient competing multimodal baselines.

</details>


### [54] [A local language model layered with rule-based and neural detectors for clinical text de-identification: an open-source toolkit and evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12709)
*Valentin Burkin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文评估开源 .NET 工具包 DeidSharp：在本地运行的 26B 混合专家 LLM（Gemma 4 26B-A4B，Ollama）之上叠加确定性规则检测器与临床 NER（Presidio + RoBERTa i2b2），在 PhysioNet 护理记录、MIMIC-IV-Note 半合成出院小结及 ASQ-PHI 合成查询上，与 deid、Philter、Stanford/Penn 去标识器、OpenAI Privacy Filter、GLiNER 五个开源基线在预注册协议下对比。结果显示：在护理记录上召回优先栈召回 98.9%（比 Stanford/Penn 高 2.8 个百分点），但精确率低 9.3 点；精确优先栈（不含 NER）召回 96.5% 与 Stanford/Penn 持平，精确率高 19.6 点（83.2%）。在出院小结上两栈领先 Stanford/Penn 超过 20 点，但优势几乎全部来自生成的"无类型姓名"。deid 在其自家语料上未被显著超越，Philter 在出院小结上召回更高但精确率低 23 点。LLM 是主要检测器，NER 仅补充地名；LLM 自我核查时丢弃了约四分之一的真实 PHI。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床自由文本中含有 HIPAA Safe Harbor 定义的受保护健康信息（PHI），共享用于研究或模型训练前必须去除，但人工去标识无法规模化。既往方法存在两个持续问题：(1) 训练型模型的泛化能力不稳定，例如在 i2b2 上训练的 transformer 在 PhysioNet 护理记录中仅识别出 39% 的姓名，而基于词典的工具可达 97%，作者因此建议本地验证；(2) 最强的通用语言模型多为托管服务，将病历发送出站常被数据使用协议和机构政策禁止。此外，既往研究很少在同一批留出临床笔记上用单一评分器同时比较规则工具、训练模型与 LLM 层，配对不确定性、事先声明的假设以及失败配置的记录都很少。已有最接近的工作（Zhou 等）将同一 RoBERTa 模型与本地 LLM 配对，但本研究的独特之处在于：完全本地部署（数据不出院）、fail-closed 设计的分层检测器、预先固定的协议与预注册的四条比较陈述、可重建的半合成出院小结语料，以及公开记录所有（含失败的）开发测量日志。

Method: 工具包：DeidSharp（MIT 许可，.NET 10），并行运行可插拔检测器——已知标识符（记录已有字段，本研究无）、确定性模式规则（日期、电话、病历号、邮箱、URL 等，带校验位）、临床 NER 侧车（Presidio + obi/deid_roberta_i2b2 RoBERTa，本地容器 CPU 运行，禁用 spaCy NER 与 URL/驾照识别器）、LLM 检测器（Ollama 承载 Gemma 4 26B-A4B，4-bit 量化，温度 0，关闭 thinking，2000 字符分块重叠 200，JSON schema 约束输出 {text,type} 列表，只接受原文整词匹配，规则过滤允许保留的年龄<90/单独年份/三位以下数字）。检测器只返回位置与类别，绝不返回覆盖文本（避免日志泄露）；所有 span 取并集替换，任何检测器出错则整次运行失败（fail-closed）。可选"第二意见"：把候选 span 交给 LLM 复核，但仅能否决非地点/非机构类 span，且不得否决已知标识符/模式/LLM 检测器报告的 span。语料：PhysioNet 护理记录（2,434 篇，889 gold spans 于报告半）、自建半合成 MIMIC-IV-Note 出院小结（1,000 患者，29,023 spans，按上下文规则回填占位符并生成每条笔记的虚构身份，未匹配规则的 41% 报为"无类型姓名"）、ASQ-PHI（1,051 条 GPT-4o 生成的合成查询，2,976 spans）。按患者固定哈希划分调参半/报告半；五种配置在调参半固定：召回优先、均衡、均衡单次调用、精确优先（无 NER）、无 LLM。基线：deid（三种配置）、Philter 1.0.3、Stanford/Penn 去标识器（token 分类管线，无规则"hide in plain sight"组件）、OpenAI Privacy Filter（约束解码）、GLiNER multi-PII（阈值 0.5）。指标：span 召回（任一预测重叠即算命中）、精确率、字符召回、非 PHI 文本移除比例、词级 F1、严格边界匹配（i2b2 可比）。统计：1000 次患者级（查询级）百分位 bootstrap，配对差值区间；四个预注册陈述（A：召回优先栈找到更多 PHI；B：精确优先栈召回损失≤2 点且精确率更高）以 Git 标签 d6-protocol 事先提交，ASQ-PHI 与其他基线比较为探索性。硬件：单台 NVIDIA RTX 5080 16GB 工作站，NER 侧车跑 CPU。

Result: 护理记录报告半（889 gold spans）：召回优先栈召回 98.88%（漏 10 个），精确率 54.31%；均衡栈 98.20%/70.53%；单次调用 97.53%/72.03%；精确优先 96.51%（漏 31）/83.18%；无 LLM 栈 88.30%/43.02%。基线：deid（含列表）97.30%/72.57%，Stanford/Penn 96.06%/63.56%，Philter 91.45%/6.71%，GLiNER 76.83%/11.08%，OpenAI PF 32.85%/59.16%。出院小结（29,023 spans）：召回优先 95.28%（漏 1,371）/95.94%；均衡 94.91%/96.70%；精确优先 94.00%/99.29%；无 LLM 91.57%/94.76%；Stanford/Penn 73.79%/98.33%；Philter 99.41%/72.45%；deid 92.08%；GLiNER 61.70%；OpenAI PF 28.80%。优势主要来自无类型姓名（占 gold 44%）：Stanford/Penn 仅找到 40.7%，两栈为 89.2% 与 86.6%；在有类型标签上三者均超 99%。ASQ-PHI：各栈 99.6%–99.7% 召回，与 Stanford/Penn 无显著差异，精确率略优。四条预注册陈述全部成立（护理 A：+2.81 点，1.38–4.37；护理 B：召回 +0.45（−1.45–2.54）、精确率 +19.62；出院 A：+21.49（20.53–22.44）；出院 B：召回 +20.21、精确率 +0.96）。探索性分析：在 deid 自家语料上没有任何配置显著超越 deid（召回优先 +1.57，区间下界为 0.00）；Philter 在出院小结上多找到 span（−4.1 与 −5.4 点召回差）但精确率低 23–27 点且多删除 3–4 倍文本。消融：LLM 单独 95.6% 召回/87.6% 精确率，NER 单独 87.0%/58.3%，并集 98.7%；模式规则在 LLM 旁几乎无召回增益。LLM 自我核查丢弃 24.6 点召回（−29.5 至 −19.8）仅换 +3.3 点精确率；限制为只否决 NER 的非地点 span 时为 −0.24 点召回换 +11.9 点精确率。性能：LLM 每篇护理记录 0.4 秒、出院小结 7.5 秒；全流程 24 分钟 / 24 分钟 / 2 小时 14 分钟。敏感性分析（不计超范围 gold）不改变任何结论。

Conclusion: 在预注册协议下，本地 LLM 叠加确定性检测器与临床 NER 的分层架构可提供"召回优先"与"精确优先"两个操作点：在两个报告半上召回优先栈找到的 PHI 多于最强的开源临床去标识模型（精确优先栈在一个语料上与之持平但精确率更高），优势主要来自训练模型常漏掉的姓名，且数据完全不出本地站点。在 deid 的主场语料上，本方法与之持平而非超越——规则型工具在其专用语料上依然稳健，Philter 则以低得多的精确率换更高 span 覆盖。三个方法学启示：(1) 提示中的虚构示例与模型族系更多决定精确率而非召回，零样本提示召回相当；同一族内更大总参数同时提升两者；(2) 模型不适合作为自身发现的裁判——要求其列举 PHI 时它能找到，要求其验证同样候选时却丢弃四分之一真实 PHI，核查仅在被限制为另一检测器的 span 且排除地点时才有效；(3) 人口普查地名库在无 LLM 时约值 3 点召回，但在 LLM 旁只多 2–3 个 span 且大幅损害精确率。局限：语料来自单一医院且使用替身而非原始 PHI，出院小结为半合成且 44% gold 为基于 100 例抽样的"无类型姓名"标签；报告半在开发期曾被多次测量，协议为自我认证且撰写时已知早期结果；召回判定宽松（任一重叠即算命中）；仅测试一个 LLM 与一个服务器版本；未评测已知标识符检测器与泄漏守卫；Stanford/Penn 去标识器的后继版本未纳入。结论强调任何配置都不能替代本地验证与治理。

Abstract: Objectives: To measure whether a locally hosted large language model (LLM), stacked with deterministic and clinical named-entity recognition (NER) detectors, finds more protected health information (PHI) than open tools, and at what precision. Materials and Methods: DeidSharp, an open-source .NET toolkit, combines the findings of pluggable detectors (patterns, a clinical NER model, a local 26B mixture-of-experts LLM) and fails closed on any detector error. Configurations fixed on tuning halves were compared, under a prespecified protocol, with deid, Philter, the Stanford/Penn de-identifier, OpenAI Privacy Filter and GLiNER on reporting halves of PhysioNet's nursing notes (889 spans) and semi-synthetic MIMIC-IV-Note discharge summaries (29,023 spans), and on synthetic ASQ-PHI queries, with paired patient-level bootstrap intervals. Results: In the nursing notes, against Stanford/Penn, the recall-first stack found 98.9% of PHI (+2.8, 95% CI 1.4 to 4.4) at 9.3 points lower precision; the precision-first stack, without NER, found 96.5%, matching Stanford/Penn, at 19.6 points higher precision (83.2%). In the discharge summaries, both stacks led Stanford/Penn by more than 20 points (recall-first 95.3%, +21.5, 20.5 to 22.4), almost entirely on generated untyped names; on typed labels all three exceeded 99%. All four prespecified comparisons held. No configuration beat deid significantly on its home corpus; Philter found more discharge-summary spans than the recall-first stack at 23 points lower precision. Discussion: The LLM was the main detector and NER added place names; asked to verify its own findings, the LLM discarded a quarter of true PHI. Conclusion: A local LLM layered with deterministic detectors offers recall-first and precision-first operating points without sending text off-site.

</details>


### [55] [WorkflowArena: Benchmarking Executable Workflow Orchestration in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12856)
*Zheng Jiang,Fang Niu,Bo Peng,Houde Qian,Wenyi Li,Deyao Hong,Mingju Gao,Yizhe Chi,Youjie Zheng,Kaisen Yang,Calvin Xiao,Lifeng Sun,Huan-ang Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: WorkflowArena 是一个面向长程任务的多智能体「工作流编排」基准：145 个任务、8 个专业领域、17 种任务形式，隐藏验证器评分；代理自主决定是否委派，所有委派经可记录接口，且编排耗时计入统一 4 小时预算。实验显示最优配置（Claude Opus 5.5 + Claude Code, max）平均仅解决 36.95% 任务，无配置在所有领域领先；Claude 系在 Claude Code 中委派少而团队大，GPT 系在 Codex 中委派频而单元小；固定执行模型后，Opus 编写的工作流能提升所有弱执行模型（静态模式平均 +6.41 分），而 Astra 的工作流几乎无迁移收益，说明编排质量是独立于单体能力的可测性能来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程任务的瓶颈正从"单个智能体能做什么"转向"工作如何被组织"。近期 agent harness（如 Claude Code 动态工作流、DynaFlow）允许模型在运行时自行编写可执行工作流来协调 worker，使系统结构由开发者决定变为由模型决定，这种组织质量成为一项独立能力。现有基准存在三类缺口：端到端 agent 基准（SWE-bench、GAIA、TheAgentCompany 等）把 agent 当作单一单元，其内部工作划分不可见；多智能体基准（MetaGPT、MultiAgentBench、ParallACT 等）的协作结构由基准设计者预先规定，测的是对既定协议的遵循；工作流生成/评估基准（WorFBench、OrchBench 等）多在离线或仿真中打分结构，其决策从未落在真实产物上。因此需要一个能同时满足：组织 consequential（任务本身依赖分解与集成）、自主（不预设角色/拓扑）、集成敏感（正确但未对齐的组件不得满分）、组织成本计入、且组织过程可观测的评测协议。

Method: （1）任务形式化：τ=(s0, g, U, E, B, V)，V 为独立验证器，奖励 r=V(sT,hT)∈[0,1]，与 worker 数量或工作流形态无关（单智能体顺序执行也算合法工作流）。（2）任务构建：源自开源仓库、Lean/mathlib4 形式化库、CAPRI/CASP/DREAM 挑战数据、公司财报、并购协议、中文刑事判决、影视素材与施工图纸，或以完全指定依赖的授权情景（流程执行、多实体会计）替代；筛选标准为工作量可切分、单元间存在依赖/共享约束、评分基于集成后的产物；验证器经参考解与"应失败提交"（组件正确但未整合、结果正确但流程非法）双向测试。（3）评测协议：统一 4 小时（14400 秒）墙钟预算，主智能体与 worker 共享，编排开销与执行开销竞争同一预算；禁用原生子智能体机制，所有委派统一经 Workflow/WorkflowList/WorkflowOutput/WorkflowStop/WorkflowControl 五个接口记录；worker 为同模型同 harness 同 effort 的全新上下文实例（共享工作区，故上下文分配成为被评行为）；主智能体可根据公开反馈修订工作流；容器化执行（Docker、CPU/内存限额、准入控制器、broker 统一重试与并发控制）。（4）指标：Overall Resolved（8 领域解决率等权平均，领域内有明确验收标准）与 Overall Score（连续分，等权平均领域分），二者 Spearman 相关 0.90 但域内差异大；另计 token（区分未缓存输入/缓存读/缓存写/输出）与按 API 价格快照估算的推理成本；委托分析用"每任务 Workflow 调用数"与"每 Workflow 的 worker 调用数"。（5）实验：9 个模型 × 25 个 model–effort 配置（Opus/Sonnet/Astra/Sol 各 5 档努力，Luna/Kimi/GLM/DeepSeek/Doubao 单独设置），全部 145 任务；内容与 3D 交付物由 Gemini-3.8-Flash 按 rubric 评分，其余域用程序化验证器；再在 32 个高难子集上做固定执行者的迁移实验（Astra/Opus 作为工作流来源，Kimi/Luna/Doubao/DeepSeek 作为执行者，分 static 冻结程序与 dynamic 可修订两种模式，来源模型全程不得编辑工作区）；最后以 3 个 3D 构建任务做工作流形态案例分析。

Result: （1）任务性能：Opus@max 总体解决率 36.95% 居首，Opus@high 34.11%，Sonnet@max 33.21%，Astra@xhigh 30.80%；尾部为 GLM 4.43%、DeepSeek 6.08%。MATH 接近饱和（最高 95.83%），SWE 最高仅 29.41%，LAW 最高 9.09%、FIN 18.75%。无配置在所有领域领先：Opus@max 领先 SWE/SCI/MATH，Sonnet@max 领先 LAW/CDN，OPS 由 Astra@high 与 Doubao 并列 27.78%。努力档位对 Claude 系影响大（Opus 22.02→36.95，Sonnet 16.88→33.21），对 GPT 系影响小（Astra 27.34→30.80，Sol 25.63→29.50）且非单调（Sol low 高于 medium/high）。(2) 资源：token 前沿全由 Opus 构成，Opus@high 以 7.36M tokens/任务达 34.11%；Sonnet@max 用 3.2× token 仅换 +7.95 分，Sol@xhigh 用 1.9× token 仅换 +1.91 分。换算成本后前沿变为混合（Luna→低档 Sonnet→多个 Sol→Opus）：Sol@low 27.59 分/$3.61，Opus@high 34.11 分/$6.66，Astra@xhigh 30.80 分/$29.26（比 Opus@high 低 3.31 分而贵 4.4×）。(3) 委派模式：high 档下 Opus/Sonnet 平均 0.86/0.76 次 Workflow/任务、每 Workflow 5.55/6.14 个 worker；Astra/Sol 为 2.09/1.94 次、1.72/1.69 个 worker。单次调用的执行占比 Opus 70%/Sonnet 68% vs Astra/Sol 约 32%；≥9 worker 的组占 Opus 24%/Sonnet 30%，而 Astra/Sol 约 99% 的 Workflow 不超过 4 个 worker。努力提升对 GPT 系主要放大调用频次（Astra +67%、Sol +79%），对 Claude 系主要改变组规模且调用频次在 xhigh 达峰。领域进一步调节形态（LAW 中 Opus/Sonnet 每 Workflow 14.29/8.45 个 worker，调用频次反而更低；Kimi/Luna 在 MATH 中调用极多但组极小；OPS 所有模型委派均小）。(4) 迁移实验：Opus 生成的静态工作流使 4 个执行模型平均 +6.41 分、动态 +6.27 分，Kimi 35.75→46.61、DeepSeek 18.37→25.24、Luna/Doubao 最佳来自 Opus 静态工作流（30.37/28.04）；Astra 工作流静态平均 −2.53、动态 +1.34，且拉低 Kimi 与 DeepSeek——尽管 Astra 自身远强于这些执行者，说明强单体能力不自动产生可迁移的编排能力。(5) 3D 案例：Opus 常用"7 个 builder 并行+装配+迭代修复"，Astra 倾向"先建共享地基再交由单一 worker 装配"或"3 个区域 builder+独立装配 worker"（引入接口对齐问题），以及"先做 7 次图纸分析再建整体"或"审计与建造并行"。(6) 连续分与解决率分歧显著：MATH 差 11.23 分，LAW 差 67.76 分；Opus@high 在 SWE 得 96.98 分但只解决 17.65%，LAW 平均分 70.7 而解决率仅 2.9%；Sonnet@max 按解决率排第 4 而按连续分排第 15。

Conclusion: 当前智能体能编排多智能体工作流完成长程任务，但远不可靠：最强配置平均仅解决 36.95%，且无任何配置在全部领域领先。系统间委派风格存在系统性差异（Claude Code 低频大组 vs Codex 高频小组），且任务领域进一步调节委派形态，说明"调用次数"本身不足以刻画协作规模。固定执行者后，Opus 编写的工作流能普遍提升更弱模型，而更强的 Astra 编写的工作流迁移收益甚微，表明编排质量是独立于单体任务完成能力的、可测量的性能来源。基准通过同时记录交付物与产生它的工作流，为后续研究异构编排者/执行者、动态预算与交互式执行奠定基础。局限：每配置每任务仅跑一次、无方差估计；每模型仅单一 harness（模型与 harness 效应无法完全解耦，非 GPT 模型在 Claude Code 上仅提供部分对照）；内容/3D 由 Gemini-3.8-Flash 评分但未测与人类评分一致性；迁移实验仅用 32 任务子集与两个来源模型，且来源模型同时撰写 worker 指令，增益中混杂了任务知识传递的贡献。

Abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems rather than as a standalone model operating within a single context. Recent agent harnesses allow the model to instantiate worker agents and to author the executable workflow that coordinates them, shifting the design of system structure from developers to the model at run time. The quality of this organization therefore constitutes a distinct capability, yet existing benchmarks either measure end-to-end task completion or evaluate coordination under structures specified in advance. We formalize this capability as workflow orchestration and introduce WorkflowArena, a benchmark of 145 long-horizon tasks spanning 8 professional domains, from software engineering and formal mathematics to legal analysis and 3D production. Each task specifies an initial workspace and an integrated deliverable composed of interdependent components, which is assessed by a hidden verifier. Agents determine autonomously whether and how to delegate, and all delegation is recorded, enabling joint evaluation of deliverable quality and the organization of the underlying work. Experiments with nine models show that no single configuration performs best across all domains and that systems exhibit distinct delegation strategies: at high effort, Claude models in Claude Code invoke workflows less frequently but with larger worker groups, whereas GPT models in Codex delegate more frequently in smaller units. When the executing model is held fixed on a challenging subset of tasks, workflows authored by Claude Opus 5.5 substantially improve weaker executors, indicating that workflow organization is itself a measurable determinant of task performance.

</details>


### [56] [Rethinking Supervision Targets for Multimodal LLM Unlearning: Less Private Information, Reduced Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09939)
*Leijiang Gu,Zhen Zeng,Feng Li,Le Zhang,Zenglin Shi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can memorize and reproduce sensitive information from their training data, posing significant privacy risks. Their ability to encode knowledge across both textual and visual modalities further complicates the selective removal of such private information. Many existing methods guide model unlearning by training the model toward constructed labels or output distributions, which we refer to as supervision targets. However, these methods often suffer from a trade-off between forgetting effectiveness and model utility. We identify supervision target limitations as a key factor in this trade-off and empirically show that targets containing more private information lead to insufficient forgetting, while larger distribution shifts from the original output distribution are associated with greater utility degradation. Motivated by these findings, we propose FFN-Perturbed Self-Distillation (FPD), which starts from the teacher's original output distribution as a zero-shift reference and selectively perturbs FFN activations associated with private information across textual and visual modalities. By precisely reducing private information from the teacher's original output distribution, FPD constructs supervision targets with less private information and reduced distribution shift. Extensive experiments on S-MLLMUn Bench demonstrate that FPD achieves a better forgetting-utility trade-off than existing methods.

### [57] [Retrofitting Unbounded Context onto Stock Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10141)
*Mark Oskin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: A language model that never had to forget would keep every document it has read and every turn it has spoken, and answer from any of it. This paper shows that two stock models can do that on unmodified weights by manipulating their geometry. Rotary attention turns each pair of key dimensions, a plane, at its own rate. The slow planes turn once in thousands of tokens and carry the address a query matches when it reads a far key; the fast planes turn once in a few tokens, and the order of the tokens inside a span is already written into its keys and values by the time the span leaves the near window. At distance the position blurs, and what attention reads is a bag rather than a sequence. A far span is read by its words: under competition it is read only if it is visible at the query of the question's own handle word, and a read through a description rather than a word fails at distance in every model measured, a 70B included. These facts allow a trick. What sits in the far part of attention does not have to be the history as it was; it can be installed ahead of the prediction. The design keeps a near window of 8K tokens at their true positions and changes what lies beyond it with the prompt: every far key and value goes to the host exact, a word index finds the units the request's rare words name, a far window of slots inside the trained range holds them while the request is encoded, and a rare word the model generates fetches its units mid-generation with one exact re-encode. Implemented in this http URL on Mistral-7B and Llama-3.1-8B, the design reads planted single needles at 99 to 100 of 100 and three-key discrimination at 88 to 100 of 100 from 32K to one million tokens, scores 70.8 on RULER against 69.9 for dense attention on Llama-3.1-8B at 128K and 67.8 against 75.5 on Mistral-7B at 32K, and at 128K prefills at 1.85 times and decodes at 1.65 to 1.68 times stock speed.

### [58] [ASCENT: Scale-Complementary External State for Frozen Long-Context Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10175)
*Xingjian Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: External state should become more valuable as a reader becomes more capable, yet long-context evaluations measure memory utility at a single model scale. This paper formulates scale complementarity: the absolute gain from external state increases when reader capacity and a compact state budget are jointly scaled. ASCENT realizes this principle with a target-blind causal writer, nested typed state, and a bounded query-conditioned readout; every language model remains frozen. Under log loss, the value of a nested refinement equals its target-relevant conditional information; a full factorial makes the reader-by-state interaction identifiable. Official 16K BABILong experiments show Qwen2.5 accuracy gains of 10.50, 78.88, and 82.63 percentage points at 0.5B, 1.5B, and 3B parameters, with both adjacent directional contrasts significant after family-wise correction. At 7B, Foundation accuracy rises to 33.25% while four-slot ASCENT answers every question, which caps the gain at 66.75 points; the 3B-to-7B accuracy increment is -15.88 points [-20.55, -11.20]. The accuracy-side claim is therefore established from 0.5B to 3B; the 7B conclusion rests on the non-saturated negative-log-likelihood factorial. A three-model by three-state factorial yields co-scaled negative log-likelihood gains of 0.388, 2.099, and 7.406 nats at 1.5B, 3B, and 7B; all interaction and gain contrasts retain positive simultaneous lower bounds. Five public 7B-8B readers obtain 66.75-85.63 point gains, and ASCENT exceeds task-trained retrieval checkpoints at the two larger shared scales. Controls, baselines, systems accounting, matched-hardware reproduction, and a cross-architecture sensitivity analysis accompany the experiments. The results establish scale-complementary external state under the evaluated benchmarks, metrics, and state schema.

### [59] [Beyond the Prompt: Leveraging Pre-Decoding States for Jailbreak Detection in dLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10258)
*Adam Hazimeh,Amel Abdelraheem,Ke Wang,Mariam Salman,Ljiljana Dolamic,Gérôme Bovet,Pascal Frossard*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a strong alternative to autoregressive models, generating responses by iteratively refining masked tokens in parallel rather than decoding sequentially. While enabling more efficient and flexible inference, dLLMs remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, including recent attacks that exploit properties unique to dLLMs such as bidirectional conditioning and parallel masked-token refinement. In this work, we show that these same properties also expose a safety-relevant detection surface absent from standard autoregressive decoding: even when a jailbreak is difficult to identify from prompt representations alone, it can still be detected from hidden states over masked response positions before any tokens are generated. By training linear classifiers on prompt and pre-decoding response representations, we empirically show that neither view strictly dominates, with each detecting attacks that the other misses. We introduce $\texttt{ReFuse}$ (Representation Fusion), an inference-time detector that fuses the sigmoid harmfulness scores of the two classifiers. Without modifying model weights or the decoding procedure, $\texttt{ReFuse}$ reduces average ASR across multiple jailbreaks from 63.29% for the undefended model and 11.27% for a prompt-only classifier to 3.31%, while keeping average benign refusal on standard utility benchmarks below 1% on LLaDA-8B. Together, these results establish $\texttt{ReFuse}$ as a lightweight jailbreak detector for dLLMs that improves safety beyond prompt-only detection.

### [60] [onóna: Twin Embeddings with Tied Unembeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10556)
*Cheng Luo,Xinnan Dai,Zhongzhu Zhou,Zefan Cai,Ruijie Zhu,Tianyu Zhang,Junjie Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Weight tying reduces the parameter cost of language models, but the usual tied output head is limited to a single softmax. We introduce onóna, a two-table parameterization that increases output expressiveness while preserving input-output weight sharing. The Transformer takes the average of two embedding tables as input, and the output head combines the softmax distributions defined by those same tables. A gate conditioned only on the current input token determines the mixture weight. Its values can be precomputed for inference, and the Transformer body remains unchanged. We evaluate onóna across Dense, Gated DeltaNet hybrid, mixture-of-experts, and Attention Residual architectures at 142M, 330M, and 1B scales. Under matched token budgets, onóna lowers final validation loss and external perplexity in 11 of 12 comparisons and raises the average accuracy over eight downstream tasks in 10 of 12. The one exception on loss is the 1B MoE model. The cost is one extra embedding table and one extra vocabulary projection.

### [61] [On the Geometric Bottlenecks of Cross-Lingual Knowledge Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10646)
*Aastha A K Verma,Anwoy Chatterjee,Sparsh Jain,Tanmoy Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Transformer-based autoregressive multilingual language models (LMs) are often assumed to store factual knowledge in an interlingua: a language-agnostic latent space. If this assumption holds, a parameter update applied in a source language during knowledge editing should inherently propagate to its semantic equivalents in target languages. However, empirical benchmarks show that cross-lingual propagation of edits often degrades substantially, a degradation that prior work treats largely as an algorithmic symptom rather than a structural bottleneck. In this work, we investigate whether representational anisotropy creates a structural bottleneck for source-only associative-memory editing, and perform a geometric dissection of the cross-lingual propagation gap. Using associative memory-based "locate-then-edit" methods, including ROME, MEMIT, and AlphaEdit, as analytical frameworks, we derive a closed-form decomposition of this gap into key-space propagation, parallel residual mismatch, and orthogonal residual mismatch. Our empirical findings show that cross-lingual propagation is primarily bottlenecked by a large orthogonal residual component, indicating that source-language edits often fail to span the target-language update directions required for successful transfer. Furthermore, we show that post-hoc correction using only source-language residual statistics encounters a large residual-prediction barrier. Finally, we perform a structural realignment via a targeted contrastive alignment objective and find that it substantially improves key-space propagation and partially improves cross-lingual edit transfer, while leaving value-space mismatch as a remaining bottleneck.

### [62] [Can small transformers learn the language of Coxeter groups?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10936)
*J. Elisenda Grigsby,Yiyao Huang,Arushi Katyal,Ryan Lin,Pranav Ramakrishnan,Weiya Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: The field of mechanistic interpretability is well-suited to collaborative projects between mathematicians and AI researchers. This work describes one such project. We trained a small transformer to learn the language of the Coxeter group affine A2, best known as the symmetries of the tiling of the Euclidean plane by equilateral triangles. We then formulated and proved a word-theoretic conjecture about affine A2 after observing the attention patterns of the trained model.

### [63] [SWEET: Mitigating Spurious Feature Reliance in LLM Reasoning via Weight Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10974)
*Zhizhang Fu,Lucas Zhao,Michalis Korakakis,Mengru Ding,Lukasz Szpruch,Yue Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Reasoning in large language models can be disrupted by simple input perturbations (e.g. adding irrelevant distractors), suggesting reliance on spurious correlations. Identifying and suppressing the spurious features involved in long chain-of-thought reasoning remains challenging. We introduce Spurious-feature WEight EdiTing (SWEET), a training-free method that combines counterfactual interventions with mechanistic interpretability to identify and suppress spurious-features. SWEET extracts token- and sequence-level behavioral directions from activation contrasts between original problems and their counterfactual variants - capturing local and global patterns of spurious reasoning. It then localizes the responsible MLP neurons and attention heads and suppresses their contributions along these directions through weight edits. Using only 20 original-counterfactual pairs for direction extraction, SWEET improves accuracy by an average of 11.8 percentage points on perturbed inputs and 2 points on original inputs across five open-weight reasoning models and five reasoning benchmarks. It also reduces the relative gap between original and perturbed accuracies from 17.6% to 2.5%. Analyses identify two recurring forms of spurious reasoning, i.e. over-integrating irrelevant conditions and overthinking, and provide mechanistic evidence that SWEET improves reasoning robustness by suppressing both behavioral directions.

### [64] [MoTo: Mixture of Tokenizers Towards Fair Multilingual Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11027)
*Gül Sena Altıntaş,Colin Raffel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Large language models rely on a single tokenizer that is chosen at training time and fixed thereafter. Most tokenizers are trained on English-dominant corpora, making them under-serve morphologically rich and non-Latin-script languages, where they can produce fragmented representations, longer sequence lengths, and reduced information density during training. We propose Mixture of Tokenizers MoTo, a modular tokenization framework that trains dedicated per-language BPE tokenizers and composes them into a unified superset vocabulary, where tokens shared across languages are deduplicated into a common ID space. Each tokenizer maintains its own normalization policy, pre-tokenization rules, and vocabulary budget. Despite allocating significantly fewer entries to English, MoTo retains English performance while delivering consistent gains across 18 out of 21 typologically diverse languages spanning six scripts, with improvements most pronounced on morphologically complex and non-Latin-script languages that are systematically underserved by English-dominant tokenizer design. Our results suggest that modular subword tokenization is a practical and extensible alternative to monolithic tokenization for multilingual parity.

### [65] [What Travels Across Languages? Reading, Transfer and Erasure of Cross-Lingual Concept Subspaces in Bangla Idioms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11386)
*Syed Rifat Raiyan,Yousuf Ibne Kamal Niloy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Cross-lingual concept analysis requires distinguishing the information that a subspace retains from the classifiers and erasers that transfer through it. We study these operations in six frozen encoders using 10,359 Bangla (Bengali) idiom senses, eight input conditions, and figurative-class and sentiment labels. Class-mean directions provide the most consistent evidence of shared coarse meaning: in post hoc analyses, they outperform random-subspace, permuted-label and covariance-matched nulls in all 12 model-label tests under balanced accuracy. A prospective internal re-split supports idiom-alone sharing in 10 of 12 tests, spanning five encoders. The original confirmatory logistic-regression family rejects both planned nulls in 4 of 12 tests, where English directions gain only a few accuracy points above the majority-class floor (3.0-7.3). Classifier transfer depends on the input map and regularization: English-trained class-mean readouts beat both zero-shot nulls in 8 of 12 discovery tests, and stronger source-selected penalties improve transfer through logistic and LEACE directions. These readouts use Bangla-validation-selected layers and unlabeled target preprocessing. Input controls show greater coarse-class sharing for explicit glosses than for idiom counterparts. Reading, however, does not imply effective erasure: English-fitted LEACE removes less than one percentage point of Bangla figurative-class accuracy, compared with 4-11 points for Bangla-fitted LEACE; INLP shows a similar asymmetry. Pattern-filter analysis, covariance-weighted input maps and a binary Gaussian overlap bound explain how these operations can diverge. The analogous multiclass ordering is an empirical diagnostic, observed in 11 of 12 cells. The results support an estimator-sensitive account of cross-lingual concept sharing and motivate evaluating reading, classifier transfer, erasure and overlap separately.

### [66] [ChemInsight: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating and Diagnosing Chemistry Understanding and Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11794)
*Changyu Hu,Yiming Zou,Xin Tang,Yiru Pan,Zicheng Huang,Deng Zhao,Qing Cui,Zhenduo Zhang,Wang Ren,Xiao Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: We introduce ChemInsight, a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models (LLMs) on chemistry tasks that require multi-step reasoning and structured chemical understanding. We propose a two-dimensional scoring system (scope and depth) to assess both task coverage and reasoning completeness. ChemInsight consists of 203 challenging chemistry questions organized into 50 bundles, which support the two-dimensional scoring evaluation scheme. We evaluate ten representative LLMs using ChemInsight and observe consistently low performance across models, with scope scores below 30% and depth scores below 11%, substantially lower than human expert performance. We then proceed to ask (1) What factor limits the advancement of current LLMs in chemistry? (2) To what extent are statistically driven language-model training methods effective at modeling chemistry symbolic language such as SMILES? And (3) Can LLM performance in chemistry be improved through intensive training on large, domain-specific corpora?

### [67] [Prune, Don't Merge: Expert Compression of Mixture-of-Experts LLMs on Multilingual Production Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12240)
*Tomas Rasymas,Povilas Kvedaras*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Mixture-of-Experts language models are cheap to run per token but expensive to hold in GPU memory, which drives the cost of serving them in production. One-shot expert compression shrinks them after a single calibration pass. Its two current state-of-the-art methods are REAP for expert pruning, which deletes the least salient experts, and REAM for expert merging, which merges them into the most salient ones. Both have been evaluated only on academic benchmarks. We compare the two on five multilingual production tasks of a web-hosting company, from classification to the generation of marketing HTML email templates, with two 30B-parameter models (Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 and the hybrid Mamba-attention Nemotron-3.5-Lightning) at 25% and 50% of experts removed and the same calibration data. Pruning wins: on the same rows, REAP is significantly better in 16 of 20 comparisons and REAM in 2. At 25%, REAP keeps 93.6% of Qwen3-30B's generative quality and REAM 62.5%, although on benchmarks the two are within a point for the same model. The damage concentrates in the output contract rather than the content: 89.8-95.2% of each significant loss on email templates comes from hard-gate failures such as invalid JSON, broken mobile layouts and runaway generation, and most failed non-English domain descriptions copy the prompt's English opening phrase. Cross-perplexity and logit divergence, two diagnostics from the REAP paper, also track production quality, as does the rate of repetition loops; n-gram diversity does not. We close with practical guidance for compressing MoE models for production.

### [68] [How Far Does Second-Order Linear Response Predict Quantization Mismatch? Pre-Registered Measurements on Five Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12634)
*Dezhen Lu,Zixiang Ni*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Serving systems choose a weight format for each model and deployment. A low-cost screen predicts the resulting KL divergence from the unquantized model's Fisher information using $\tfrac12\Delta^\top F\Delta$, the expansion underlying Hessian-aware and second-order post-training quantizers. We assess the reliability of this screen in GPU batches with channel-wise int8, per-tensor fp8 and group-wise int4 on Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-4B, OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-30B-A3B. Relative predictions hold across a 16-fold range of perturbation scales, int4 group sizes and rounding modes, while absolute predictions are heavy-tailed. A trimmed average brings 10 of 12 cells on Qwen3-4B and OLMo-2 within 15% of measured KL. The MoE model exhibits nonquadratic response at small perturbations, with int8 KL scaling as $\alpha^{0.63}$. Computing per-sequence gradients in bf16 can cause fourfold prediction errors. We trace these errors to arithmetic in the lower half of the backward pass and eliminate them by using fp32 there. Batch-invariant kernels run at 0.55 times the throughput, while changes in reduction order introduce a floor of 0.17-0.22 nats per sequence. We build a screener with one streamed fp32 Fisher pass, trimmed tensor-block predictions with a band, a flag for aligned tensors and per-layer format allocation. On the unseen Mistral-7B-v0.3 family, all six predictions fall within the band, all three KL budgets are met, and vLLM throughput is predicted within 0.4%.

### [69] [Is Persona Generalization Predictable?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12864)
*Olina Mukherjee,Arnav Goel,Aditi Raghunathan,Jacob Mitchell Springer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Persona generalization occurs when fine-tuning a language model in one domain induces behavioral changes in others -- for example, the broadly unsafe behavior observed in emergent misalignment. We discover a surprising "on-the-line" phenomenon in persona generalization: in-domain and out-of-domain persona rates across various fine-tuning hyperparameters follow an approximately probit-linear relationship, and the specific probit-linear relationship is surprisingly shared even across model families and model sizes, including Qwen and Llama. Training choices that leave the set of trainable parameters unchanged, such as learning rate, weight decay, and training duration, largely move models along the same line, reducing transfer mainly by weakening in-domain learning. Changing which layers are fine-tuned, however, can change the slope. For unsafe behavior, fine-tuning only later layers yields shallower slopes, retaining strong in-domain learning while reducing out-of-domain misalignment. This "on-the-line" phenomenon unifies unexpected, isolated observations of persona generalization within a quantitative framework for predicting and controlling behavioral transfer.

### [70] [MultiTurnRoute: A Platform for Building and Evaluating Multi-Turn LLM Routers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10848)
*Jiaqi Xue,Mengxin Zheng,Heng Huang,Qian Lou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: In a multi-turn conversation, the choice of language model at one turn can affect which model should answer the next. The selected model's reply shapes the context for the next query, and its cached prompt prefix can reduce the cost of using that model again. We introduce MultiTurnRoute, a platform for building and evaluating multi-turn LLM routers. A shared interface gives built-in and user-defined routers the current query, dialogue history, and an estimate of each model's reusable prefix length. Our routing algorithm, Chain-of-Route (CoR), uses a learned gate over recent and recurrent dialogue history to predict response quality and estimates cost from each model's reusable prefix. MultiTurnRoute Arena ranks routers on recorded conversations and compares session quality and cost in interactive runs where a simulated user responds to each reply. On a benchmark drawn from WildChat and LMSYS-Chat-1M with per-turn quality annotations for five LLMs, CoR reduces the normalized cost required to match the strongest model's quality by up to 20.3% relative to the strongest routing baseline, while matching or improving peak response quality.

### [71] [BIBIMBAP: A Benchmark for Instructional BIM-Based Automated Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09933)
*Clemens Kujat,Bharathi Kannan Nithyanantham,Stefan Telgmann,Tobias Sesterhenn,Joern Ploennigs,Stefan Lüdtke,Christian Bartelt*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Large Language Models (LLMs) are emerging as natural-language interfaces for Building Information Modeling (BIM), successfully achieving information retrieval, but no benchmark exists to evaluate their ability to edit Industry Foundation Classes (IFC). We introduce BIBIMBAP, a Text-to-BIM benchmark with 100 curated tasks covering Create-Read-Update-Delete (CRUD) operations across spatial, geometric, topological, numeric, and conceptual categories. Each task includes a natural-language prompt, an IFC model, expected structured outputs, and test scripts for automated evaluation. Baseline results show limited performance (best: 50.2%) and frequent failures in constraint preservation and spatial reasoning, with some correct outputs achieved despite flawed reasoning.
