### [548] [DM-Call: Decision-Model-Guided Function Calling with Cumulative Verification Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10977)
*Minhyeong Yu,Wonduk Seo,Seunghyun Lee*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: DM-Call 提出一个"决策模型引导"的函数调用框架：将生成器（G）与独立的决策模型（D）解耦，对"函数选择"和"参数正确性"分别做概率化验证，叠加本地 schema 校验；被拒绝的候选及其验证信号（概率、二值判定、schema 错误）会被累积保存，通过"数值概率 + 口语化正确性标签"的混合反馈形式引导生成器迭代修正，全程不执行外部工具。在 BFCL（3,035 例单轮）与 API-Bank（156 例 first-call）上，配合 4 个生成器（gpt-5-nano、gpt-5.4-mini、claude-sonnet-5.5、gemma-4-31b-it）与 2 个决策模型（Jev、PPLX Decider 27B），DM-Call 在 BFCL 上取得四个生成器全部最高准确率（gpt-5-nano 提升 +10.5 个百分点），API-Bank 提升有限但成本可控；消融表明累积反馈优于仅保留最新反馈，Hybrid 反馈优于纯数值/纯文本，r*=3 为精度—延迟的肘部最优解（均值 4.0s vs Direct 2.6s、MAD-FC 10.5s）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 函数调用要求 LLM 准确选择函数并生成与用户意图一致的参数，但"语法合法"的调用仍可能在语义上出错（选错函数、参数错配），且一旦执行会触发非预期的外部动作。已有方案存在三点局限：(1) 仅靠 schema 校验/语法约束无法判断函数选择与参数是否贴合用户意图；(2) 通用自精炼（Self-Refine）、多智能体辩论、评审式精炼（PF-FC）会额外增加推理开销，且未显式区分"函数选错"与"参数生成错"两类错误；(3) 只依赖最新一次反馈的精炼策略会丢弃早期尝试中的有用验证信号。

Method: 任务定义为：给定用户请求 x 与函数集合 ℱ（及 schema），输出动作 c=(f,a) 或空调用 ∅，正确性由 benchmark 参考（函数名 + 可接受参数值，或应不调用）判定；错误分三类：应调用而不调用/不应调用而调用、选错函数、参数错误或缺失。方法要点：(1) 生成器 G 与决策模型 D 分离，在第 t 轮 c_t = G(H_t, x, ℱ)，同时决策模型提出两个是非问题并返回 yes 概率 p_f^(t)（函数选择是否匹配请求；对空调用则判断"不调用"是否恰当）与 p_a^(t)（必填参数是否齐备、被请求支持、归属正确参数）。空调用跳过参数验证（p_a=⊥）；若初始 c_0 可解析且为空调用则直接返回并标记为未验证；不可解析输出不被当作空调用。(2) 接受规则 A_t = S(c_t) ∧ V(p_f) [∧ V(p_a)]，其中 S 为可读性/函数名存在/必填参数类型齐全的 schema 校验，V(p) 为 p≠⊥ 且 p≥0.5；schema 校验失败的可读候选仍送入决策模型判断，以便反馈同时携带 schema 错误与判定结果。(3) 累积修复：被拒候选与其反馈 d_i=(Φ(p_f), Φ(p_a), V(p_f), V(p_a), S(c_i)) 按时间顺序组成历史 H_t 注入生成器，生成器只看当前候选做验证；返回首个被接受的候选，若在修复预算 r 内无一通过则回退到初始候选 c_0。(4) 混合反馈 Φ(p)=(p, L_{k(p)})，k(p)=min(⌊5p⌋+1, 5)，五档标签 very likely incorrect / likely incorrect / uncertain / likely correct / very likely correct，概率分箱宽 0.2；反馈仅影响生成器提示，判定仍用数值概率。实验：BFCL 3,035 条单轮 Python 用例（用官方 AST 指标，剔除 16 条 live-relevance）、API-Bank 156 条 first-call 用例（固定 53 个 API 目录，函数名 + 类型归一化参数精确匹配，不执行 API）；修复预算 r*=3，阈值 0.5；基线为 Direct、Self-Refine、MAD-FC、PF-FC。

Result: 主结果（3 次运行均值）：BFCL 上 DM-Call 在全部 4 个生成器均取得最高准确率——gpt-5-nano 64.12→74.63（+10.5）、gpt-5.4-mini 61.32→64.32、claude-sonnet-5.5 88.25→88.56、gemma-4-31b-it 86.67→86.91；API-Bank 上提升有限（如 gpt-5-nano 61.32→64.32、gpt-5.4-mini 80.13→80.13、claude 86.97→87.39、gemma 81.41→81.62），个别基线在个别生成器上更优。成本上 DM-Call 低于 Self-Refine/MAD-FC/PF-FC（gpt-5-nano：0.525 vs 0.762/1.493/5.903 USD）。消融（gpt-5-nano + Jev, r=3）：所有变体较 Direct 提升 8.9–10.2 点；仅验函数 73.12、仅验参数 73.61（参数准确率最高 82.64）、仅保留最新反馈 73.05（较默认 74.32 低 1.3 点），完整版最高 74.32（标准差低至 ±0.22）。反馈表示：Hybrid 在两个决策模型下平均分最高（Jev 83.16，PPLX 82.95）；对修复频繁的 gpt-5-nano（修复率 24%/21%）Hybrid 比 Numeric 高 0.3–0.4 点、比 Text 高 0.5–0.6 点，其余生成器差异 <0.1 点。修复预算：r 从 3 增至 10 仅提升 1.8 点但 p95 延迟由 9.7s 升至 24.3s；r=3 时均值延迟 4.0s（Direct 2.6s、PF-FC 6.1s、MAD-FC 10.5s），肘部准则给出 r*=3，r=5 仅 +0.9 点却多 16% 请求与 42% p95 延迟。案例研究展示了函数纠正、参数取值修正、空调用决策与多步修复（如 CheckToken→DeleteAccount→GetUserToken 最终通过验证）等轨迹。

Conclusion: DM-Call 将"函数选择"与"参数正确性"的独立决策模型验证，与基于累积 Hybrid 反馈的迭代精炼结合起来，在不执行外部工具的前提下同时提升了函数调用准确率与成本效益，尤其对较弱生成器与高修复率场景收益明显；累积历史比仅用最新反馈更有效，混合反馈优于纯数值或纯文本反馈，r=3 是精度—延迟的良好折中点。局限方面，API-Bank 上增益有限且部分基线更优，方法在多轮/复杂工具链场景的效果有待进一步验证。

Abstract: Reliable function calling requires Large Language Models (LLMs) to select appropriate functions and generate arguments consistent with user intent. However, syntactically valid calls may still be semantically incorrect due to inappropriate function selection or mismatched arguments. In this paper, we propose Decision-Model-Guided Function Calling (DM-Call), a framework that combines local schema validation with separate decision-model verification of function selection and argument correctness. For rejected candidates, DM-Call accumulates verification probabilities, binary judgments, and schema errors across attempts. A hybrid feedback representation further combines numerical probabilities with verbal correctness labels to guide iterative refinement without executing external tools. Extensive evaluation across BFCL and API-Bank (first-call) demonstrates DM-Call boosts function-calling accuracy versus direct generation, at modest additional cost.

</details>


### [549] [Slim Foundation Models for Latency-Critical Recommendation Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11013)
*Danyal Aftab,Anas Zafar,Assadig Abakr,Steven Davy*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: SlimFM 提出一套面向延迟敏感 CTR 在线服务的轻量化 LLM 语义增强流水线：通过依赖感知结构化剪枝将 LLaMA3-8B 压缩 44% 至 4.5B，再用字段感知 LoRA 微调让剪枝模型在线产出判别性字段级语义嵌入，最后经语义引导融合模块注入传统 CTR 模型的特征交互。在 4 个数据集 × 6 个 CTR 骨干上，保持压缩前模型 99% 以上的准确率，同时相较现有 LLM 增强基线将推理延迟降低最多 3.4×（15.98–17.58 ms vs. KAR 54.6–55.1 ms、LLM-CF 46.5–47.5 ms），并使 LLM 前向计算从"离线缓存"转为"在线同请求路径服务"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CTR 预测是推荐/广告系统的核心环节。LLM 提供的语义与世界知识能显著改善冷启动和长尾场景的预测质量，但现代 CTR 骨干仅约 1–10M 参数，而 LLaMA3-8B 达 8B 以上，完整 LLM 在线推理在实时服务约束下不可行。既有 LLM 增强 CTR 方法（KAR、LLM-CF、CTRL、EASE）只能离线预计算并缓存 LLM 输出，其平均计算成本是标准 CTR 基线的 290 倍以上；这仅是把算力负担从在线转移到离线，且当物品或特征目录变化时必须重新生成缓存。作者因此追问：能否通过结构化剪枝结合参数高效微调，把骨干压缩到足以与 CTR 模型处于同一请求路径内在线服务，同时语义质量不显著退化。

Method: 三阶段流水线：(1) 结构化剪枝——沿 DepGraph/LLM-Pruner 构建 LLaMA3-8B 注意力与前馈参数的依赖图，将结构耦合参数分组为可剪单元，用下一 token 预测损失的 Taylor 展开（涉及 Hessian 的二阶项）估计组重要性，移除最低分组直至达到目标稀疏度，得到 4.5B 骨干。(2) 字段感知语义学习——设计字段识别任务，用列举 M 个候选字段名的结构化提示（如把 'Black Rose' 判为 MovieID）编码查询表示 h 与各候选字段嵌入，用 InfoNCE 式对比损失训练，仅更新注意力投影矩阵上的 LoRA 参数，剪枝骨干保持冻结。(3) 语义引导特征融合——对每个字段编码字段名并投影最后隐层得到 e_f，计算字段嵌入间成对余弦相似度 S^llm，经可学习变换 g_θ 得到任务自适应权重，重加权 CTR 模型的成对交互 C^llm_ij = S̃^llm_ij · I^ctr_ij，聚合为上下文预测流，与 CTR 交互流融合；训练期用 KL 散度对齐 CTR 与 LLM 两个嵌入空间的成对相似度分布，总损失为 L = L_BCE + λ_align·L_align；推理时直接部署剪枝骨干，无需预缓存。实验使用 Amazon Gift Cards / Video Games / Digital Music 与 MovieLens-1M 四个数据集，FM、DeepFM、FwFM、FmFM、FinalMLP、Wukong 六个 CTR 骨干，基线含 KAR、LLM-CF、CTRL、EASE（同用 LLaMA3-8B）以及 CELA、ClickPrompt；效率指标为参数量、MACs 与 50 次（10 次预热）单样本推理延迟。

Result: 效率：SlimFM 骨干 4504M 参数 / 275G MACs / 15.98–17.58 ms，显著低于 KAR（8032M、996G、54.62–55.08 ms）与 LLM-CF（7075M、829G、46.46–47.53 ms），参数少 1.8×，延迟较 KAR 快 3.1–3.4×、较 LLM-CF 快 2.7–2.9×，且延迟几乎与 CTR 骨干选择无关，说明 LLM 前向是瓶颈、剪枝是关键手段。精度：平均 AUC 相对基础 CTR 模型在 Gift Cards 提升 1.69%、Video Games 1.36%、Digital Music 1.39%、MovieLens-1M 0.13%；最佳组合包括 Wukong@Gift Cards AUC 0.6808（+4.63%）、FinalMLP@Gift Cards 0.6792（+4.19%）、FwFM@Video Games 0.6774（+5.41%）、DeepFM@Digital Music 0.7686（+4.03%）；在 24 个骨干×数据集组合中有 10 个取得 KAR/LLM-CF/CTRL/EASE 中的最高 AUC，且骨干缩小 44% 时 RelImp 全数据集保持为正。稀疏度权衡：8B→6B→4.5B→2B 的平均 AUC 恢复率为 99.88%、99.77%、99.62%，呈平滑单调退化、无明显断崖，4.5B 在压缩与精度间平衡最佳。

Conclusion: 依赖感知的结构化剪枝结合字段感知微调与语义引导融合，可将基于 LLM 的语义建模搬进延迟敏感的 CTR 在线请求路径，在保留全模型 99% 以上准确率的同时显著降低端到端推理延迟；论文据此主张结构化剪枝不仅是优化手段，更是 LLM 增强 CTR 实用化部署的必要机制。局限在于评测仅覆盖四个 CTR 数据集与单一 LLM 家族（LLaMA3-8B），向其他骨干、领域与 LLM 架构的泛化性仍待验证。

Abstract: Click-through rate (CTR) prediction is a core component of recommendation and advertising systems. Large language models (LLMs) offer rich semantic priors that improve prediction quality, particularly in cold-start and long-tail settings. Injecting a full-scale LLM into a CTR pipeline is, however, prohibitively expensive at inference time: existing LLM-enhanced CTR methods avoid this cost by caching LLM outputs offline rather than serving the LLM online. We propose a resource-efficient pipeline, SlimFM, that makes online LLM-based semantic modeling practical: (1) dependency-aware structured pruning compresses LLaMA3-8B by 44% to a 4.5B-parameter backbone; (2) LoRA-based field-aware fine-tuning trains the pruned model to produce discriminative field-level semantic embeddings from lightweight textual prompts; (3) a semantic-guided fusion module injects these embeddings into the feature interactions of a conventional CTR model. Across four datasets and six CTR backbones, SlimFM retains over 99% of uncompressed-model accuracy while reducing inference latency by up to 3.4x relative to existing LLM-enhanced baselines.

</details>


### [550] [TS-GEAR: Taobao Shangou GEnerative Ad Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12180)
*Guofeng Tong,Xu Zhang,Guangliang Yu,Haiqiang Wang,Guannan Cong,Xing Guo,Yang Zhou,Jingjing Duan,Shuang Li,Feng Shi,Hualei Liu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: TS-GEAR 是阿里巴巴淘宝闪购搜索广告线上部署的生成式召回框架，针对"地理可达性是硬约束"的同城即时零售场景提出三项设计：Geo-Semantic ID（geohash-6 分块作为地理前缀 + RQ-KMeans 内容语义后缀，前缀级约束解码把可达性变成生成目标而非事后过滤）、Query-Geo Target Attention（以实时 query 与位置双目标聚合行为历史）、GMPO（用去重组奖励与留一法边际优势改写 GRPO 优势，对齐集合级业务价值并抑制策略坍缩）。0.1B 轻量主干日服务超 1.5 亿次查询，线上 A/B 广告曝光 +3.8%、广告收入 +4.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 即时配送平台（DoorDash、Uber Eats、淘宝闪购）与传统电商的本质差异是：配送范围外的商家是"无效候选"而非"低排名候选"。将生成式检索（TIGER、OneRec、OneSug）迁移到该场景面临三大挑战：(1) 现有语义 ID 仅将地理作为软信号，可达性只能依赖不可微的事后硬过滤，浪费 beam 预算且无法端到端优化；(2) 用户偏好在地域与 query 双重维度上差异巨大，无地理与当前 query 条件的历史行为聚合会产生有偏兴趣估计；(3) 召回质量由候选集合的整体价值决定，而自回归训练逐序列独立打分，缺少抑制冗余近重复的集合级信号（近集预测 next-set prediction 目标与 token 级似然目标错配）。

Method: 整体为编码器—解码器架构，三阶段训练。第一阶段 Geo-Semantic ID 编码：地理前缀码采用 6 位 base-32 geohash（约 1.2km×0.6km 网格）切成 3 个两字符块（词表 1024，层级分辨率约 1250km→39km→1.2km），内容语义码由 Qwen3-Embedding 经领域对比学习微调后做 RQ-KMeans 三级残差量化（每级 256 簇），拼接成 6 token 的 GSID；用户 4 位 geohash 加 8 邻域共 9 个前缀构成可达集 N_u，约束解码仅前 2 个地理 token，释放 4 个自由 token。第三阶段对齐使用 GRPO 框架但重写优势：A_i = λ·zscore(SR) + (1−λ)·MA，SR 为单样本加权命中分（订单>点击>高 CTR，w_ord=5.0、w_clk=1.0、w_ctr=0.1），MA 为留一法边际优势 MA^(i)=GR(Y_g)−GR(Y_g\Y^(i))，GR 为去重并集上的加权覆盖；重复样本 MA=0 故被抑制，且仅新增覆盖的序列被强化，从而在无辅助多样性目标下防止策略坍缩，同时保留 KL 正则与重要性比率裁剪。第二阶段 Query-Geo Target Attention 编码器：token 级自注意力编码后按字段池化，以实时位置 p_u 为 query、行为发生地 p_i^u 与商家地理码 g_i 拼接为 key 走地理路径，以 query 嵌入为 query、商家语义 s_i 与历史 query q_i 为 key 走语义路径，两路由门控 α 动态加权聚合，再经 Query Fusion 门与 query 表示融合以兜底稀疏用户。解码器为 T5 式自回归（12 层，隐藏维 512，8 头，FFN 2048），含 User-Geo Gate：在解码地理 token 时按维度门控注入位置对齐嵌入 γ_t（软偏置而非硬约束），语义 token 阶段不注入；输出端按当前字段码本投影 softmax 后 beam search（宽 300）并去重。线上以 9 格查找强制 prefill、跳过前两个地理 token 并复用 KV cache，部署于 A10 GPU（延迟预算 70ms，TensorRT + 混合精度）。

Result: 工业数据集 TS-Delivery（0.1B 用户、4.8M 商家、0.5B 交互）：全指标最优；生产半径 20km 下 HR@50/150/300 相对最强基线 OneLoc 提升 36.3%/17.4%/11.5%（0.8080/0.8920/0.9336），10km 下 HR@50 提升 14.1%，5km 下仅 1.2%（小半径可达集饱和）。地理有效性 ValidRate@20km：TS-GEAR top-50 达 95.8%、150 为 93.9%、300 为 93.0%，而所有基线 ≤35.4%（OneLoc 分别为 35.4%/32.0%/29.3%）；全设置不低于 74.9%。公开数据集 Foursquare NYC/TKY 亦全部第一，相对 OneLoc 提升 3.1%–4.8%（NYC）与 3.9%–6.0%（TKY），因无配送半径与 query 占位符，结构性约束基本不激活，增益主要来自兴趣与 POI 地理联合建模。消融：去 geo prefix 使 10/20km 的 HR@50 回落至 0.7111/0.5947（约等于 OneLoc 基线）；去 User-Geo Gate 降 0.96–1.46 个百分点；去 Query-Geo Target Attention 降 2.08–2.60 个百分点（作用在兴趣表示而非可达性）；Query Fusion 在全量流量上影响 ≤0.05pp（仅对稀疏用户有效）。RL 分析：标准 GRPO 在 beam@100 下 clk/ctr 覆盖反而下降 0.6%/2.9%（单点击 query 占高达 70%，初始策略高度集中，重要性比相同使 z-score 优势归零、梯度消失而策略锁定在少数高奖励模态），仅 ord +3.3%；GMPO 相对预训练基线 clk/ctr/ord 提升 1.8%/0.7%/4.9%，相对 GRPO 提升 2.4%/3.7%/1.6%，其中 ctr 从 −2.9% 翻正为 +0.7%，表明 beam 内多样性恢复；GRPO 与 GMPO 在采样协议下几乎无法区分，说明仅用采样评估会高估线上 RL 收益。Scaling-law：HitRate 随容量（0.05B/0.1B/0.5B）近似线性上升，而地理有效性基本持平（由前缀约束主导），故在延迟约束下选 0.1B。线上 7 天 A/B、20% 流量：广告曝光 +3.8%、广告效率 +0.4%、广告收入 +4.2%（p<0.01），现已全量上线，日服务超 1.5 亿次查询。

Conclusion: TS-GEAR 证明在即时配送的搜索广告中，把地理硬约束内置到生成过程（结构化前缀 + 解码约束）比事后过滤与软性地理偏置更有效：不仅提升命中率（生产半径下 HR@50 相对提升 36.3%），更大幅提升地理有效性（95.8% vs 35.4%）；同时以 Query-Geo Target Attention 解决无地理/无 query 条件的行为聚合偏差，以 GMPO 用去重组奖励与留一边际优势在不引入辅助多样性目标的前提下对齐集合级价值并抑制 beam 坍缩。工程上通过前缀强制 prefill + KV cache 复用实现推理加速，已在淘宝闪购全量部署并取得广告曝光 +3.8%、广告收入 +4.2% 的线上收益。局限与后续：GMPO 奖励结构有待引入增量性与相关性奖励；需推进更大规模模型与相应推理加速；伦理上需注意位置隐私（粗粒度 geohash 仍可能被跨会话反推居住/工作地）与商家公平性（新商家与稀疏区域曝光被压缩）及运力集中问题，需配合曝光下限、广告负载上限与集中度监控。

Abstract: On-demand delivery platforms such as DoorDash and Uber Eats impose a constraint absent in traditional e-commerce: merchants beyond the user's delivery range are invalid candidates rather than merely low-ranked. Generative retrieval has recently shown strong potential in large-scale retrieval systems. Adapting it to this setting, however, poses three challenges. First, existing semantic IDs encode geography only as a soft signal, so reachability can only rely on a non-differentiable post-generation hard truncation. Second, user preferences vary substantially across both regions and queries, so aggregating historical behaviors without conditioning on geography and the current query yields biased interest estimates. Third, the retrieved candidate set is evaluated by its collective value, yet autoregressive training scores each sequence independently, with no set-level signal to discourage redundant near-duplicates. To address the challenges, we propose TS-GEAR, a unified generative retrieval framework for on-demand delivery: (1) Geo-Semantic ID splits merchant identifiers into geographic prefixes and semantic suffixes, making reachability a prediction target rather than a post-hoc filter; (2) Query-Geo Target Attention aggregates historical behaviors using the real-time query and location as dual targets, while encoding each behavior's own location into its attention key; (3) GMPO (Group Marginal Policy Optimization) rewrites advantages using a deduplicated group reward and marginal advantage within GRPO, avoiding auxiliary diversity objectives. Deployed online with a lightweight 0.1B backbone, TS-GEAR serves over 150 million queries per day in the search advertising pipeline of Taobao Shangou, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art generative retrieval methods on both HitRate and geographic validity, and achieving 3.8% gains in ad impressions and 4.2% in ad revenue.

</details>


### [551] [LEGIT: Live Eligibility Gating over Identifier Tries for Constrained Decoding of Heterogeneous Pages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10357)
*Felix Fang,Zheng Liu,Robert Saliba*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: A generative recommender names each candidate with a short token sequence, a Semantic ID, and recommends by generating those tokens. Some generative recommenders, including the Uber Eats search engine we are building, write a whole results page, stores with their menu items, in one decoding pass. Every Semantic ID on such a page must name a real store or item that is eligible for the search, such as a store that delivers to the user's location, and that is not already on the page. Each item must also belong to the store above it. A trie over the catalog keeps identifiers real, but eligibility and repetition change with every request and token, and the grammar-constrained decoder we tried could not enforce these changing rules exactly and quickly. We call this constraint LEGIT, for live eligibility gating over identifier tries. Numbering trie leaves depth first turns each rule into a range lookup over one store trie and one item trie, and every generated page passes an independent catalog check. On one NVIDIA B200 GPU with one or two requests per decode step, a direct implementation that walks the trie on the GPU makes each token about 5 times as slow as unconstrained decoding. Across 36 implementations, hardware counters and ablations are consistent with kernel launches and CPU-GPU waits as the source of this slowdown. Our fastest implementation walks the trie on the CPU while the GPU runs the model, needs no custom kernel, and cuts time per output token by 65.9 percent against the direct GPU implementation, to about 1.7 times the unconstrained cost. This implementation is also the fastest on a page layout that puts each item before its store.

### [552] [RoutingTrie: Metadata Routing for Constrained Generative Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11016)
*Darshan Fofadiya,Yang Liu,Shuying Sun,Kyumin Park,Juhana Kangaspunta*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Advances in large language models and semantic IDs (SIDs) have brought generative retrieval (GR) into industrial applications. These systems must return items that satisfy request metadata constraints as well as relevance requirements. A catalog trie ensures SID validity, but filtering metadata only after generation wastes computation on rejected candidates and may leave too few eligible results. We propose RoutingTrie to incorporate metadata constraints before beam selection. RoutingTrie maintains one shared SID trie and builds a compact index for each metadata field using Dense Bitset or Sparse List. We derive a storage cost formula to guide the choice between these index representations for different field distributions. During decoding, field probes determine whether requested values occur below candidate edges and produce a combined mask that guides beam selection. Experiments on ShopTrie, our configurable synthetic benchmark, demonstrate compact storage and efficient CPU and GPU probing across diverse metadata distributions. In a production replay, RoutingTrie raises Hit@100 from 67.5\% to 96.1\%, a gain of 28.6 percentage points, with only 1.1 ms latency increase. We will release the ShopTrie generator, benchmark scripts, and RoutingTrie CPU and Triton GPU implementations to support reproducibility.

### [553] [An Adaptive, Context-Aware, and Stacked Attention Network-Based Recommendation System to Capture Users' Temporal Preference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11278)
*Jung-Hsien Chiang,Chung-Yao Ma,Chi-Shiang Wang,Pei-Yi Hao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Recommendation systems have become more important since the widespread use of the Internet. The large amount of information means that it is difficult for users to discover they really need. However, users' preferences can change over time because of the age and the impact of social networks. Recommendation systems must capture users' preferences and recommend suitable items, which is a difficult challenge. This study proposes a novel recommendation system that adapts to the changing preferences of users. By learning and adapting to users' changing preferences better recommendations are provided. This study uses context factors as additional information to model users' preferences more precisely. For the proposed recommendation system, the context is based on users' interaction items within each defined time interval. This study proposes two novel attention mechanisms for the recommendation system. The contextual item attention module captures contextual information, changing pattern in users' preference and the importance of items. The multi-head attention module extends the diversity of users' preferences and adapts to changing preferences. The recommendation performance is improved using additional item's temporal information to model the contextual item's representation. Experiments compare the proposed algorithm with several state-of-the-art recommendation methods using three real-world datasets. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed context-aware recommendation model outperforms traditional methods and demonstrate the effectiveness with which contextual information is captured by the attention mechanism.

### [554] [Not All Branches Are Equal: Adaptive Semantic ID Construction for Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11549)
*Guy Hadad,Haggai Roitman,Bracha Shapira*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Generative recommendation models represent items as sequences of discrete tokens known as semantic IDs. Existing approaches derive these identifiers using residual or hierarchical vector quantization, assuming that tokens carry independent semantic meaning across quantization levels. Revisiting this assumption, we argue that semantic IDs should behave as hierarchical paths where each token's meaning is conditioned on its prefix. This highlights a mismatch between conventional fixed-codebook quantization and the hierarchical structure implicitly learned by generative recommenders. Motivated by this insight, we propose Adaptive Silhouette Tree (AST), a top-down divisive clustering method that constructs semantic IDs as paths within a tree structure. Unlike prior methods with fixed branching factors, AST dynamically determines the number of branches at each node by maximizing the silhouette coefficient, enabling finer partitions in dense regions and compact groupings in homogeneous ones. We further introduce constrained variants that enforce minimum probability mass during splitting to improve supervision for long-tail items. Extensive experiments on five Amazon Review datasets of varying sizes and domains show that AST significantly outperforms strong baselines. These results demonstrate that aligning semantic ID construction with the inherent hierarchical structure of generative recommenders leads to more effective recommendations.

### [555] [Dhara: Evidence-Oriented Retrieval for Indian Knowledge Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11197)
*Avinash Holenarasipur Nagendra,Anand Kaniyaar Sriranga Prasad,Rahul Vishwakarma,Trupti Gavit,Anish Amol Tipnis,Yashaswini Mandayam Rangayyan,Vinod Appajanna,Kousik Sarathy Sridharan,Mohan Raghavan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Relevant evidence in Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS) collections may be distributed across passages in different parts of a work, including verses, translations, and commentaries. Locating it requires matching natural-language questions and partially remembered verse fragments to source passages. We present Dhara, a retrieval engine combining hybrid search, chapter- and book-level Entity Notes (EN), Fuzzy Verse Retrieval (FVR), and neural reranking. Five comparisons on the 325 questions in Dhara Bench examine retrieval representations against BM25, EN's contribution, reranker quality and computation time, FVR, and Gemini. BGE-M3 single-vector retrieval exceeds BM25 in nDCG@10, Recall@20, and MRR@20 across all categories. Its scores are broadly comparable to ColBERTv2, with mean retrieval times of 0.108 s and 0.962 s under the same hardware configuration and a smaller memory footprint for chunk storage on disk. Adding EN to a direct branch with a matched candidate count improves nDCG@10 in all twelve categories with Qwen and ten with BGE; the combined ranking is capped at the same candidate count. Qwen improves nDCG@10, Precision@5, and MRR@20 over BGE in every category, at approximately 6.72 times the overall estimated serial computation time. FVR increases Verse-category nDCG@10 by approximately 20 percentage points with either reranker. Gemini is evaluated after source mapping and manual review with relevance annotations visible. The Qwen pipeline with EN and FVR has higher Recall@20 than Gemini in ten categories and stronger complete-evidence retrieval in Multi-hop questions, while Gemini retains early-relevance advantages in several categories. The results inform retrieval choices according to evidence requirements and resource budgets.

### [556] [CHO-Bench: How Do Context Hints Affect Ad Rankings in LLM Advertising?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11955)
*Shiqi Zhang,Yang Fei,Xiaokui Xiao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: LLM advertising selects advertisements based on user conversations, where user needs may extend beyond explicit product searches. ChatGPT Ads allows advertisers to provide natural-language context hints describing what they offer, who may find it useful, and when it may be useful, as additional information for ranking advertisements across diverse user conversations. However, how to effectively construct these hints remains unclear. We formulate Context Hint Optimization (CHO) as the problem of constructing context hints to improve an advertisement's ranking under a given budget. Drawing on established marketing frameworks, we develop seven context hint generation strategies covering What, Who, and When, along with a Unified strategy that combines all seven dimensions. We introduce CHO-Bench and conduct over 1.19 million paired evaluations across five datasets using embedding-based and LLM-based rankers. Our results show that context hints improve advertisement rankings under the evaluated offline rankers. While individual strategies achieve similar average gains and Unified offers no consistent advantage, strategy differences become more pronounced under specific generation-ranking configurations, with embedding-based and LLM-based rankers favoring different information dimensions. Increasing the hint budget further improves rankings with diminishing marginal gains. These findings establish an offline benchmark for studying ad-side ranking optimization in LLM advertising and highlight opportunities for model-specific hint selection and budget-aware generation and aggregation.

### [557] [Edge-Deployable LLMs for Classification and Value-of-Information Ranking of Disaster-Related Tweets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10158)
*Christopher D. Molek,K. Brent Venable,Niranjan Suri,Stephen Russell*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Humanitarian-aid and disaster relief decisions often rely on noisy, incomplete, and uncertain information from social media. Although substantial research has focused on automating the classification of such data, limited work has examined whether individual posts contain sufficient information to support decisions to act. In this study, we use large language models (LLMs) to (1) classify social media content and (2) assess its Value-of-Information (VoI) in terms of operational actionability. We evaluate seven LLMs for the classification of 77,484 tweets across 10 humanitarian-aid categories and identify the Qwen3 (8B parameters) model as the top-performing classifier, achieving the highest F1 scores in all but one category. In a second task, the classified categories serve as contextual inputs for assessing VoI with respect to responder actionability across six well established metrics for each tweet. We observed that the Gemma 3 (4B parameters) model outperformed the other models on this task, achieving the highest recall across the majority of categories. This work demonstrates that relatively small, edge-deployable LLMs can prioritize actionable information in resource-constrained environments. By integrating VoI assessment, our framework advances the automated elicitation of high-utility knowledge from unstructured social media streams for disaster-response decision-making and highlights a pathway toward tactical edge applications using LLMs that fit on a single 8 GB GPU.

### [558] [SepLRM: A Foundation Model Paradigm for Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10356)
*Di Chen,Xijun Xiao,Qin Ren,Weijiang Lai,Zhijian Pan,Zhentao Pan,Pengfei Nie,Cheng Yuan,Zixuan Tan,Xuyang Liu,Tao Wang,Yunwen Huang,Hao Fang,Yichao Wang,Hao Zhang,Siyuan Wu,Hao Chen,Han Diao,Mingyu Yang,Yongkang Feng,Beihong Jin,Jinfeng Yang,Deping Xie,Peng Xu,Zheng Chai,Yuchao Zheng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Large recommendation models (LRMs) improve recommendation performance by scaling behavior sequence length, model capacity, and training compute. However, the return on investment (ROI) of continued scaling deteriorates as marginal gains diminish and long-sequence encoding costs rise, especially when this computation is repeatedly executed by distinct models for diverse recommendation stages and business scenarios. To address this issue, we propose SepLRM, a recommendation foundation model (RFM) paradigm that identifies reusable sequence encoding and reorganizes multiple end-to-end (E2E) LRMs into one RFM and multiple independently optimized vertical models (VMs). The RFM adopts an encoder-decoder architecture and exports its final-layer encoder state as the shared key-value (KV) cache that is independent of downstream task-offered candidates. Unlike candidate-specific logits or aggregated user embeddings, the KV cache preserves fine-grained behavioral information. Separation at this native KV interface also allows each VM to construct candidate-conditioned queries while retaining the same query-KV interaction as its E2E counterpart, enabling high-fidelity capability transfer. To ensure both transfer effectiveness and system efficiency, we co-design cache compression, the training and serving workflows, and LG-Store, a distributed storage system for KV caches. Experiments on three large-scale datasets show that SepLRM achieves state-of-the-art offline performance with a transfer rate of approximately 100%. It also demonstrates strong transferability across model iterations, recommendation stages, and business scenarios. Deployment in two large-scale industrial scenarios substantially improves the ROI of sequence scaling and delivers consistent gains in online A/B tests at ByteDance.

### [559] [Yuanbao-Reranker: Document-Grounded Synthesis and Preference Distillation for Text Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10405)
*Hongyuan Xu,Dezhi Ye,Jiahao Cao,Jie Liu,Haijin Liang,Haibo Shi,Jin Ma*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: High-precision text reranking is a critical component in modern search, recommendation, and agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems. We present Yuanbao-Reranker, a family of general-purpose dense rerankers spanning 0.6B, 4B, and 8B parameter scales built upon the Qwen3 backbone. To construct diverse and reliable ranking supervision at scale, we pair answer-first and query-type-guided document-grounded synthesis with a three-stage curation funnel that verifies positive support, eliminates semantic redundancy, and enforces balanced source-by-length quotas. For each curated pair, we screen real retrieval pools with a teacher score margin to filter out potential false negatives and sample Hard, Medium, and Moderate negative tiers, yielding 2.75M $1{:}3$ ranking groups. We train the models by jointly optimizing pointwise relevance cross-entropy and a bounded minimum-gap hinge objective over both positive--negative and negative--negative pairs. This formulation transfers fine-grained teacher preferences across candidate tiers without over-constraining well-separated predictions, supporting both cross-scale and same-scale distillation followed by layerwise adaptive model merging. Across five comprehensive benchmarks spanning Chinese (CMTEB-R), multilingual (MMTEB-R), English (BEIR), long-document (MLDR), and code (MTEB-Code) retrieval, Yuanbao-Reranker consistently leads every parameter tier: the 0.6B variant reaches 70.96 Avg. to surpass 1B--4B active-parameter baselines, the 4B variant reaches 73.63 Avg. to outperform the 8B teacher (72.68), and the 8B variant achieves a state-of-the-art 74.21 Avg., with substantial gains generalizing across distinct first-stage retrievers.

### [560] [When Greedy Is Sorting: Exact and Certified Ideal Rankings for Novelty Metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10576)
*Kehan Liu,Zhaoyun Chen,Xianquan Yan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: The ideal ranking that normalizes novelty metrics is NP-hard to compute in general, so widely used $\alpha$-nDCG evaluators approximate its denominator with a greedy rule that rescans every remaining document at each rank. We identify a regime in which this ideal ranking is exact and cheap for both $\alpha$-DCG and intent-aware expected reciprocal rank (ERR-IA). When each document is positively judged for at most one intent, each metric reduces to the classical allocation of a fixed budget across chains of decreasing marginal gains. A metric-specific virtual-score transformation followed by a multiway merge, which we call ChainMerge, returns the globally optimal top-$K$ ranking in $O(G+K\log G)$ time from $G$ preordered intent groups, or in $O(n+K\log G)$ time from $n$ globally preordered candidates, instead of the $\Theta(nK)$ of the greedy rule. When intent judgments overlap, exact $\alpha$-DCG optimization is NP-hard under the standard logarithmic discount and $\alpha=0.5$, even when every document has three intents and every intent occurs in two documents. For arbitrary overlap, a polynomial-size LP over nested ranking prefixes upper-bounds the ideal score and certifies the optimality gap of any feasible ranking. In the official TREC Web 2009-2012 judgments, 64.8% of positive documents serve a single intent, yet only 20 of 198 complete queries do so throughout. Beyond this exact regime, the LP certifies 189 of the 198 greedy denominators as globally optimal, and the resulting score intervals preserve the winner in all eight matched comparison groups. On 65,238 MIND-small candidates, ChainMerge returns identical optimal objectives 17-1,011 times faster than the greedy rule. For $\alpha$-DCG, these results trace the hardness of the ideal ranking to intent overlap.

### [561] [Formalizing Patient-Set Semantics for OMOP CDM-Based Clinical Trial Feasibility Assessment:A Neuro-Symbolic Methodology for Traceable Site-Feasibility Patient Counts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10681)
*Sohyeon Jeon*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: This study examines the interpretation and execution of natural-language eligibility criteria for clinical trial site-feasibility patient-count estimation using the OMOP Common Data Model (CDM). It treats each count as the size of a patient set produced under explicitly declared choices about clinical concepts, temporal conditions, exclusions, proxies, and available data. The study presents NS-CoT, a neuro-symbolic pipeline that uses an LLM to interpret and structure criteria, followed by symbolic processing and deterministic SQL compilation. Intermediate representations and execution records document how criteria are translated into patient sets and counts. Evaluation uses synthetic OMOP CDM data, controlled benchmarks, and a multi-site simulation. Comparisons with a direct-SQL baseline examine execution success, count agreement, patient-set agreement, and preservation of reference-defined site-feasibility labels and rankings. Performance varies across evaluation settings. Layer-wise inspection also supports the identification of implementation and policy errors, followed by correction and re-evaluation. The work investigates the reviewability and fidelity of cohort computation relative to declared reference definitions. It does not establish that these definitions capture a unique clinical ground truth or demonstrate improved recruitment, site selection, or trial outcomes in practice.

### [562] [From User Behaviors to Satisfaction Judgments: Reasoning about User Satisfaction with AI Overviews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10715)
*Xingzhu Wang,Yitong Xu,Yue Li,Daiting Shi,Jingzhou He,Jiaxin Mao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: The growing presence of AI overviews in everyday search makes their effective evaluation essential. Response quality has been the primary focus of existing evaluation research, with only a small number of studies examining the user perspective. These evaluations rely on queries and response content, leaving the information conveyed by user behavior insufficiently utilized. This work investigates satisfaction prediction for AI overviews from a user-centered perspective and incorporates behavioral signals into the prediction process. Applying existing behavior-based satisfaction prediction methods from traditional information retrieval to this setting, however, presents limitations. We address these limitations with STaRS, an LLM-based approach designed specifically for predicting satisfaction with AI overviews. At its core is a structured reasoning procedure: individual behavioral signals are interpreted first, and their implications then inform the prediction of user satisfaction. Reinforcement learning further optimizes this procedure, while a reward shaping mechanism alleviates reward sparsity during training. Evaluation on two real-world datasets demonstrates that STaRS outperforms the comparison methods in satisfaction prediction, providing search providers with a practical means of accurately estimating users' satisfaction with AI overviews.

### [563] [A Tool for Anonymized Clinical Knowledge Retrieval and Speaker Interaction Analysis of Healthcare Tele-mentoring Sessions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10922)
*Parthaw Goswami,Erfan Zareei,Amy Vogelsmeier,Dima Dandachi,Ben Casterline,Mirna Becevic,Praveen Rao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: We present a tool for anonymized retrieval of clinical knowledge and analysis of multi-speaker interactions in tele-mentoring sessions of Project ECHO (Extension for Community Healthcare Outcomes). Our tool's novel design includes: (a) a compound metadata filter that enforces strict speaker- and session-level isolation during retrieval, preventing cross-session context contamination; (b) MedGemma-4B as a locally-hosted language model for clinically grounded answer generation across three query modes; (c) interaction graphs to compute betweenness centrality, PageRank influence, and turn-taking patterns to quantify participation equity; and (d) a consistent alias-based anonymization scheme that prevents real participant names from appearing in any rendered output. During the demo, a healthcare provider (user) will interactively query multi-year ECHO sessions, explore participation dynamics through interaction graphs, compare sessions side-by-side, and assess answer quality via six reference-free RAG metrics, all without any cloud API dependency.

### [564] [PCG-RAG: Progressive Compositional Grounding for Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Complex Web Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11113)
*Linyao Zheng,Xuhang Shi,Zhifang Mao,Chongqi Qu,Xiuquan Hou*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Complex Web question answering requires retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems to identify target entities from multi-clue descriptions and connect evidence scattered across long Web pages. Individual pages often support only some of the required semantic constraints, while clues discovered on one page guide subsequent searches on others. However, premature reliance on partially supported entity hypotheses can divert retrieval from the original information need. RAG systems must therefore use partial evidence to guide further searches while seeking the evidence needed to establish the intended entities. We propose PCG-RAG, a novel RAG framework based on Progressive Compositional Grounding (PCG). Progressive Evidence Acquisition directs subsequent searches toward missing evidence for candidate attributes and relations. Compositional Reasoning separates candidate-guided retrieval from evidence-based answering along a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of subquestions. Provisional names make dependent searches specific, while answering tasks use accepted results and unresolved identifying conditions, assessed against the original question. New passages connect the identifying clues to the requested relations, supporting evidence-based downstream answers. Evidence Grounding combines identifying and relational source passages with supported intermediate answers, connecting evidence across Web pages to the original conditions during final generation. On BrowseComp-Plus and WebWalkerQA, PCG-RAG improves accuracy over the leading compared baselines by 5.43 and 5.15 percentage points, respectively.

### [565] [IntentLens: Grounding Underspecified Multimodal Queries for Recommendation via Tool-Augmented Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11346)
*Xiao Chen,Dong Fang,Haitao Li,Qing Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: As intelligent personal assistants are increasingly deployed in real-world scenarios, recommendation paradigms are shifting from passive preference matching to inferring user intent from underspecified multimodal inputs. In practical interactions, users typically issue a reference image paired with a vague natural language query, keeping key visual attributes, personalized preferences, and item-side constraints implicit. Existing recommendation methods either leverage historical user interactions augmented with multimodal item features or assume fully articulated textual queries; both paradigms struggle to resolve underspecified multimodal queries for accurate item matching. To address this limitation, we propose IntentLens, a tool-augmented recommendation framework that grounds ambiguous multimodal queries into query-relevant evidence prior to user-item matching. IntentLens follows a ground-then-rank pipeline: a shared multimodal LLM leverages visual tools, user memory modules, and item attribute retrieval tools to (i) infer latent user intent from image-text inputs and (ii) augment each candidate item with fine-grained, query-conditioned evidence. Subsequently, a lightweight ranker scores candidates based on the grounded representations. To facilitate research in this novel setting, we construct two benchmarks with underspecified multimodal queries, namely \textsc{GoogleReview-MMTool} and \textsc{Yelp-MMTool}. Extensive experiments on these benchmarks demonstrate that IntentLens outperforms competitive MLLM and retrieval baselines, and exhibits strong generalization to unseen categories and datasets.

### [566] [Beyond Ranking: Are Decision Models Calibrated Relevance Scorers?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11480)
*Shengyao Zhuang,Xueguang Ma,Matthias Petri,Jimmy Lin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Decision models such as Jev are a new kind of relevance scorer. Their typed score primitive takes a question, an ordered set of textual relevance levels and a state, and returns a probability for each level directly, rather than token likelihoods or generated labels. Jev's vendor promises that these probabilities are calibrated. This motivates revisiting 'Beyond Yes and No', which improved zero-shot pointwise LLM reranking using likelihood-derived scores over fine-grained relevance labels but left calibration against human assessors as future work. In this paper, we first reproduce its open-model FLAN-UL2 setting on eight BEIR collections, confirming its ranking trends, and then run Jev and two open-weight decision models with the same protocol. Jev and the 27B pplx-decider rerank ahead of FLAN-UL2 and three cross-encoders on average. We then compare Jev's native probabilities with the human assessors' labels and find them overconfident: of the DL21 pairs it scores above 0.9, only 66% are relevant. Since this is mostly an error of scale, a two-parameter calibration fitted on 2,257 DL19 pairs removes much of it and transfers to DL21. After calibration, Jev has a lower DL21 Brier score than FLAN-UL2 and the three cross-encoders, mainly because it separates relevant from non-relevant pairs better. Finally, with calibrated probabilities, choosing each query's cut-off by expected F1 needs no parameter of its own, beats a fixed top-10 cut and matches a cut-off threshold tuned on DL19.

### [567] [Proactive Dimension-Adaptive Denoising for Graph Collaborative Filtering via Representation Coherence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11801)
*Wenjun Li,Dong Zhao,Jiaying Shi,Juan Zhang,Zhaoming Pan,Zhimin Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Implicit feedback in recommender systems contains noisy interactions (e.g., accidental clicks, impulse purchases) that propagate through user-item graphs and contaminate learned representations. Existing explicit denoising methods uniformly rely on training loss to estimate interaction reliability. However, loss is a fundamentally passive signal: it detects noise only after it has caused prediction errors, and it is heavily confounded by training stage, negative sampling, and hard positives. We propose Noise-aware Dimension Learning (NDL), a proactive dimension-adaptive denoising framework. NDL introduces Representation Coherence Detection (RCD), which evaluates the coherence between an interaction representation and the user's historical preference centroid in embedding space, providing an active noise signal independent of loss. RCD and the loss signal are fused via activity-aware weighting (active users rely more on coherence while cold-start users automatically fall back to loss), and the fused estimate drives an interaction-level dimension-adaptive mask that limits the effective representation capacity of unreliable interactions. A lightweight contrastive regularizer further improves embedding uniformity, stabilizing the geometry on which RCD discriminates. On three public benchmarks NDL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art denoising methods, lifting Recall@5 by +17.95% on Amazon-book, +12.33% on Yelp, and +5.63% on MovieLens-1M over the strongest baseline DAR; the core variant without contrastive learning already surpasses DAR on sparser datasets, confirming representation coherence as the primary driver of these gains. NDL is confined to the training loop and is serving-compatible with LightGCN-based production pipelines, adding no online latency or parameters at inference time. Code: this https URL

### [568] [Multi-Modal Agricultural Document Understanding at the DAGRI Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11886)
*Zhefan Wang,Da Li,Keping Bi,Nanqing Dong*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Agricultural documents, such as prefectural technical reports and crop calendars, are critical knowledge resources. However, their complex table layouts, significant variations in document length, and dense multi-modal elements pose substantial challenges for automated understanding. To address these issues, the NTCIR-19 DAGRI (Data Analytics for aGRicultural Information) task introduced three subtasks focusing on different dimensions of document intelligence. In the Table Information Extraction (TableIE) task, we developed a multi-stage pipeline combining structure-preserving parsing via MinerU, region-adaptive segmentation for long documents, and a dual-modal (vision-text) extraction strategy for complex work schedules. This approach achieved first place with an exact match score of 0.6566. For Multi-Table Multi-Hop Question Answering (MTMH-QA) over interrelated JSON tables, we adopted an agentic search framework utilizing DCI-Agent to iteratively explore directories via bash commands, reinforced by a cross-model validation mechanism. This yielded a revised accuracy of 0.8444, initially ranked first. In the Figure and Table Question Answering (FiT-QA) task, which requires comprehending single large composite images, we implemented a dual-modal VLM pipeline enhanced by deterministic answer normalization, securing the highest BLEU score. Together, our system effectively addresses regional structural variations, dynamic cross-file evidence discovery, and multi-modal alignment, providing a robust framework for complex agricultural document understanding.

### [569] [NIFT-SQL: Customer-Supervised Table Scoring for Enterprise Text-to-SQL Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12731)
*Arjun Rao,Nishant Gopinath*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Enterprise text-to-SQL starts with finding the tables a question needs, which is hard when a schema spans several databases and hundreds of cryptic tables. We ask whether models trained separately on each customer's example questions, reading only table names, column names, and declared keys, improve table retrieval. NIFT-SQL (Necessity-Informed Fusion for Text-to-SQL) fuses hybrid search over a retriever fine-tuned on the customer's questions with a fine-tuned 560M cross-encoder that scores every table for whether the query needs it, through a logistic regression fitted on held-out questions. On BEAVER, LiveSQLBench, and LiveSQLBench-Large (244 to 971 tables; four splits, three trainings), NIFT-SQL places every reference table in the top 15 for 69.2%, 89.5%, and 85.6% of test questions, against 30.4%, 41.0%, and 21.8% for hybrid search and 61.1%, 81.7%, and 70.4% for the fine-tuned retriever with the same labels. With off-the-shelf search, the cross-encoder without fine-tuning is 21 points lower. A zero-shot 8B reranker needs no labels and, routed by database, shows no resolved complete@15 difference on two collections; adding its scores as two fusion features gives a high-accuracy mode that reaches 72.4%, 92.5%, and 88.6%, ahead of the validation-selected zero-shot reranker variant on two collections, with no resolved difference on the third. Rank fusion of the two trained parts, grouped by database, shows no resolved difference from the learned fusion. Scored once on a newer BEAVER release, NIFT-SQL beats search and leads the label-matched retriever at top 8 on the synthetic test, but trails it at top 15 on real questions.

### [570] [Too Big to Inspect? Ethically Auditing Large Datasets Through Small Samples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10399)
*Giovana Marchetti,Jhessica Silva,Tiago Torrent,Carlos Caetano,Sandra Avila*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一套「用小样本审计大数据集」的实用方法：把 AI 伦理工具（AIET，如 Datasheets for Datasets、Data Statements、Dataset Nutrition Label、Data Cards）应用于数据集的随机子集，即可暴露出结构性偏见、伦理风险与技术缺陷。作者用一个 1% 的高质量人工标注多语多模态数据集 Framed Multi30K（316 张图）和两个 0.00006% 的网络爬取文图对数据集 relaion2B-en-research-safe（各约 670–690 条）验证该方法，证明「数据集太大无法检查」是一种偷懒借口：若偏见出现在随机样本中，它反映的是数据生成流程的系统性缺陷，而非个别异常。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模自动网络抓取、众包标注的数据集在缺乏人工策展的情况下会吸收源数据中的刻板印象、排斥性规范与历史偏见，训练出的模型会复制并放大这些模式（Amazon 招聘系统对女性的系统性惩罚、医疗算法以医疗费用代理健康需求导致黑人群体现更差、深色皮肤 dermatology AI 性能下降、LAION 中的大规模违规与非自愿内容等）。产业界以「规模太大无法审计」为由把责任下推给下游，形成严重的文档债务（documentation debt）。既有的大规模审计依赖 TB 级下载、GPU 集群、关键词/哈希定向检索，既计算成本高昂，又需要事先知道「坏词」，且自动化分类器本身带有偏差、可能遮蔽机器难以察觉的问题；而人工逐条审计数十亿样本在人力上不可能完成。核心论点是：审计不需要穷尽每个实例——正如不必访谈每位选民即可预测选举、不必喝完整条河才能判断其污染，抽样即可定位流程性缺陷。

Method: 提出五步审计管线：(1) 选定数据集并审阅其论文、既有文档与仓库等外部材料（仅需数据子集访问权）；(2) 依标注密度与团队能力确定随机抽样规模（本文 Framed Multi30K 取 1%，relaion2B-en-research-safe 取 0.00006%）；(3) 按模态与分析目标选择合适的 AIET（经文献与综述筛选后取上述四种通用工具）；(4) 将 AIET 问题划分为「文档类问题」（动机、收集、预处理、发行、维护等，直接依外部文档作答）与「数据类问题」（构成、实例、表征，需对样本做实证分析），并按问题性质采用脚本自动统计＋人工逐实例定性审阅的混合方式，借助 FiftyOne 进行交互式检视；(5) 引入多学科背景的审阅团队讨论结论，必要时直接联系数据集作者以补齐文档缺口。两案例中每个样本实例都经人工定性复核。

Result: Framed Multi30K（316 图 / 1,580 英、1,580 葡、306 译葡字幕）：约 14% 图像含可识别儿童，引发监控与未成年人隐私问题；女性被频繁以 “girl”／“menina” 描述，形成性别语言偏见；Lome 自动语义标注存在英葡系统性差异（葡语更多把 “branco” 标注为族裔、英语更多标注亚裔及 African American/Native American 复合称），显示 “white” 被当作去种族化默认；“American” 仅出现在英文字幕且多被原众包标注者仅凭视觉推断国籍；葡语字幕为米纳斯吉拉斯受过教育城市说话者的特定语体，存在社会教育层级偏差；人工标注 people_by_age 中仅 4/62 例不含儿童或老人，暴露出标注者「标注与自身不同者」的倾向，且 VWC（有英文描述上下文）条件的实例数明显高于 VNC，显示上下文会强化偏差；另发现 13 张图缺 bounding box、10 张图缺翻译等完整性缺陷。relaion2B-en-research-safe（两样本 668 与 691 条）：近半数图像损坏/空白/无效（12 与 9 例无效视觉、4 与 3 例截断字幕）；隐私风险突出（40 与 43 例将个人影像与姓名、年龄、具体地点、政治观点、工会身份、宗教信仰、有效电话号码、健康数据与法律记录等敏感属性并列，可直接识别；18 与 11 例含儿童，其中 11 与 7 例面部清晰可见）；即便经过 p_unsafe 过滤，仍残留 22 与 24 例冒犯性、刻板化或引发不适的内容（事故、火灾、暴力画面与历史创伤），并出现 p_unsafe 明显低估的亲密暗示、内衣与隐含裸露图像；社会偏见方面存在污名化语言、仇视表述、身体羞辱与「plus size」等扭曲审美标准，以及主观臆断式字幕；子群体标注稀疏且不稳定（仅 1 例明确归属国籍）。两组样本结论高度一致，说明结果具有可重复性。四种 AIET 的发现高度重叠，AIET 的问题扮演「provocateur」角色，唤起不同视角与分析路径，但最终判断依赖研究者本人的知识与背景。

Conclusion: 用极小随机样本＋标准 AIET 工具即可对任意规模的数据集进行可行且具可操作性的伦理审计，从而挑战「too big to inspect」的免责说法；证明人工策划的数据集同样存在偏见，而经安全过滤的网络数据集仍是「互联网快照」，仅依赖图像侧 p_unsafe 概率无法覆盖多模态与语境性危害。审计必须是以多学科团队为主体、贯穿数据全生命周期的迭代持续过程；AIET 提问只是「provocateur」，真正起决定作用的是人的批判性判断与情境性知识。作者声明不追求穷尽全部问题、不主张弃用这两个数据集，而是意在为负责任的数据策展、文档化与监管提供可落地的路径。局限包括：仅依赖人工可语义解读的数据；仅选用四种通用 AIET；小样本无法可靠估计问题流行率、罕见严重问题可能漏检；审计与标注的主观性未做信度评估、可复现性受限；审阅团队仅来自计算机与语言学背景、地理文化语境有限，可能遗漏其他边缘群体的系统性伤害。

Abstract: Big techs and researchers increasingly claim that their training datasets are too large to inspect for bias and ethical problems. However, in the race to build ever-large models, they have relied on automated web scraping and no human curation. Datasets built this way absorb the stereotypes, exclusionary norms, and historical prejudices of their sources, and the models trained on them can reproduce and amplify those patterns. Because manually auditing billions of samples is humanly impossible, we need practical, effective methods to identify biases in these datasets. This paper studies the feasibility of ethically auditing large datasets through small samples and proposes a practical method for identifying structural biases by applying AI Ethics Tools (AIETs) to random samples. We applied Datasheets for Datasets, Data Statements, Data Nutrition Labels, and Data Cards to a 1% sample of Framed Multi30K, and Datasheets for Datasets to two 0.00006% samples of relaion2B-en-research-safe. Our results show that evaluating small samples with AIETs can reveal ethical problems, structural biases, and technical inconsistencies. Although industry practice assumes that identifying problems requires analyzing the entire dataset, we show that a random subset supports a viable qualitative analysis without overwhelming computational or human resources. Demonstrating that a dataset is biased does not require examining every instance: if a bias appears in a random sample, it is a flaw of the creation process. The AIETs' questions acted as provocateurs, evoking different perspectives and analysis methods for the same dataset, but the analysis and its results depended fundamentally on the human factor. We hope these findings contribute to urgent public discussions about ethics, transparency, accountability, and AI regulation by offering a practical pathway for responsibly auditing massive datasets.

</details>


### [571] [Don't Blame The Preferences: Examining The Emergence of Sycophancy in LLM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10045)
*Chao Peter Yang,Catherine Zehr,Pranav Bijith,Brandon Fain*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次沿三个完全开放模型家族（OLMo 3 7B、Tülu 3 8B、SmolLM3 3B）的每一个训练阶段检查点，用三个谄媚基准（SycEval、Perez、ELEPHANT）加上机制可解释性分析（对比激活加法提取的谄媚方向 + 训练数据投影打分），系统检验"谄媚由偏好对齐（RLHF/DPO）引入"这一流行说法。结论是：谄媚在 SFT 结束时已基本成型，偏好对齐至多是次要且不稳定的影响源；真正最大的谄媚暴露来自 SFT 数据（体量大、单条激活水平相当、得分最高的全为 SFT 数据集）。因此治理应前移到预训练与指令微调阶段的数据选择与增强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谄媚（sycophancy，即模型倾向于附和用户、认同用户观点，即便客观错误）会降低准确性，并与错误信息传播、用户依赖、过度自信等社会危害相关。已有工作主要在最终发布的模型上做基准评测并提出事后缓解手段；对"谄媚在训练流程的哪一阶段、由哪些数据引入"缺乏系统研究。文献中普遍把责任归于 RLHF/DPO 等偏好对齐（认为人类偏好标注与奖励模型偏好谄媚回答），但这一说法很少与更早的训练阶段（SFT、预训练）做对照检验，且这一归因把责任指向用户偏好而非开发者的数据决策。作者因此提出一个前置问题：在真实训练流水线中，模型究竟何时、以何种数据变得谄媚？

Method: 1) 模型与检查点：选取训练配方、训练数据与各阶段检查点均公开的三个家族——OLMo 3 7B（基座/SFT/DPO/最终RLVR）、Tülu 3 8B（Llama-3.1 基座/SFT/DPO/最终RLVR）、SmolLM3 3B（基座/中途训练/SFT/APO/最终模型合并），逐检查点评测；基座用纯补全提示、对话模型用各自 chat 模板。
2) 行为评测：SycEval（GSM8K 与 MedQuAD 各 500 题，四级递进反驳，测"退行性"谄媚，GPT-5.4-mini 判分，GPT-5.5 生成反驳）；Perez 意见附和基准（政治/哲学/NLP 三个子集，GPT-4o-mini 判分）；ELEPHANT 社会性谄媚（OEQ 验证/间接性/框架、AITA-YTA 与 AITA-NTA-FLIP 道德判定、SS 框架，GPT-4o 按原作者评分标准打分，并给出人类基线；基座模型额外做连贯性过滤并报告"仅连贯回答"口径）。
3) 机制可解释性：从 Perez 数据构造谄媚/非谄媚对比对（N=450，字母平衡），在每层残差流取配对均值差作为方向 v_l；用 CAA 注入 α·σ_l·v̂_l（α∈{0,±1,±2,±3}）在 300 条留出 A/B 题上做双向引导验证，并以"答案质量 mass ≥ 50% 基线"作为可采纳性约束，按 Δ⁺+Δ⁻ 最大选择层 l*（SmolLM3 L15、OLMo 3 L13、Tülu 3 L12）；另在 20 条开放式诱导提示上以 gpt-4.1-mini 评分验证生成可控性，并设随机方向对照、letter-push 诊断、跨层联合方向与困惑度成本检查。
4) 数据打分：将各阶段训练数据（预训练文本、中途训练、SFT、偏好对、RL/RLVR 提示）经对应检查点前向，取层 l* 残差流均值池化后做中心化投影 s(x)=(ā(x)−μ)·v̂_l*，报告均值、95% bootstrap 区间、pro 尾部占比，以及 chosen−rejected 配对差 Δ，并按公开配方估算各阶段样本暴露量。

Result: (1) 基准层面：9 个"模型×基准"组合中，SFT 检查点的谄媚得分至少达到偏好对齐模型的 92%、最终模型的 85%，平均而言与最终模型几乎一样谄媚。偏好对齐仅在 4/9 个组合中提高谄媚，平均仅 +4.2 个百分点（对最终模型的口径为 +8.2 pp，4/9）。
(2) 分基准细节：SycEval 上偏好对齐多降低退行性谄媚（SmolLM3、Tülu 3），OLMo 3 仅 +3.3 pp；Perez 意见基准上从基座到最终全面上升，但增幅主要来自中途训练/SFT（OLMo 3 SFT +8.0 pp、DPO 仅 +2.2 pp，其后 RLVR +11.7 pp；Tülu 3 DPO +7.2 pp 且主要来自哲学子集）；ELEPHANT 上基座最低，SFT 阶段带来单项最大跳升（OEQ 验证/间接性、AITA-YTA 验证），偏好对齐要么无变化要么只有轻微上升，framing 维度在基座就已很高且全程稳定。
(3) 表征层面：三个模型均存在可引导的谄媚方向；α=+3 时开放式判分谄媚度显著上升（SmolLM3 +26.5、Tülu 3 +20~27 分）而连贯性基本保持、困惑度比约 1.1，随机方向对照无此效应。
(4) 数据层面：SFT 与偏好数据单条平均投影相当（SmolLM3 两者均为 +0.025；Tülu 3 +0.014 vs +0.001；仅 OLMo 3 偏好更高 +0.066 vs +0.052），pro 尾部比例亦相近（3–7%）；但 SFT 数据量远大于偏好数据（暴露量约为偏好对齐的 43×/17×/7×），且每个家族得分最高的 4 个数据集全部来自 SFT，前十中无偏好数据集进入前五。偏好对的 chosen 投影在所有家族上都高于 rejected（Δ̄ 为 +0.020~+0.043，区间不含 0），说明偏好目标确实在选择该方向，但幅度远小于 SFT 的累积暴露。定性上高分工单/人格类 SFT 数据富含主观与正向情感词并以具名人物为主，低分数据集更干燥事实化。
(5) 跨检查点一致性：base 与 final 方向下的数据集排名高度相关（OLMo 3 Spearman ρ=0.91；SmolLM3 0.66），提示该方向在训练早期即已形成。

Conclusion: 谄媚并非主要由偏好对齐引入，而是在预训练与 SFT 阶段就已基本建立；偏好对齐只起次要且不一致的增量作用，机械上可解释为 SFT 阶段提供了绝对量最大的谄媚表征暴露（体量优势叠加数据本身的高激活）。据此，治理与责任定位应调整：仅针对 RLHF/DPO 阶段的缓解措施不足，干预应前移到预训练与指令微调的数据选择、去谄媚化与增强；同时凸显开放训练配方与中间检查点发布对溯源不良行为与提升透明度的价值（责任更多落在开发者的数据策展而非"用户偏好"上）。局限：仅覆盖三个中小规模家族、评测依赖 LLM 评委、SFT 合成数据的上游偏好对齐影响无法排除、方向跨层唯一性未证、仅英语。

Abstract: AI sycophancy, the tendency of large language models (LLMs) to flatter users and affirm their beliefs, can undermine accuracy and contribute to misinformation, dependence, and overconfidence. Although prior work has benchmarked sycophancy in released models and proposed mitigations, its origins during training remain poorly understood. Preference alignment methods such as RLHF and DPO are often blamed, but their effects are rarely compared with earlier training stages. We investigate sycophancy across the training pipelines of three model families and three benchmarks. We find that sycophancy is largely established by the end of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), rather than introduced by preference alignment. Across all nine model benchmark combinations, SFT checkpoints attain at least 92% of preference aligned models' sycophancy scores and at least 85% of final models' scores; on average, they are about as sycophantic as final models. Preference alignment increases sycophancy in only four of nine cases, by an average of 4.2 percentage points when it does. To probe the underlying causes, we isolate model representations associated with sycophancy using mechanistic interpretability and measure their activation on training datasets from each stage. SFT datasets show roughly the same average activation as other training data but contribute substantially more examples, and the highest-scoring individual datasets all come from SFT. Our findings suggest that addressing sycophancy requires interventions throughout the training pipeline, particularly in data selection and augmentation for pre-training and SFT.

</details>


### [572] [Veterans' Mental Health Crisis Severity Annotation: Do LLMs Agree More Than Human Experts?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10048)
*K M Sajjadul Islam,Pranav Yaramalla,Nadiyah Johnson,Mark Flower,Praveen Madiraju,Zeno Franco*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统评测了25个LLM（15个开源本地模型+10个闭源API模型）在8种提示变体下对149条退伍军人相关推文的危机严重度（七分类，含5级有序严重度）标注性能，并与8位退伍军人主题专家（SME）的人工标注对比。核心发现：人类专家之间一致性偏低（序数α=0.494，Fleiss κ=0.143），而LLM之间一致性显著更高（序数α最高0.8336）；闭源模型在对齐SME参考标签上优于开源模型且更稳定（GPT-5.6-Terra最佳，均值Micro-F1 0.783、SD 0.029），开源Qwen2.5-7B在识别L5"急性危机伴自杀意念"上最强；但高一致性并不等于与人类判断一致或能可靠捕捉罕见高危案例。作者结论：LLM可作为专家标注的可扩展补充，在高风险心理健康场景中不能替代专家，且需谨慎评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体中蕴含大量心理健康与危机信号，但其人工标注昂贵、耗时且难以规模化，尤其在需要领域专家判断时。危机严重度标注尤其困难：推文常以隐晦方式表达痛苦，依赖语境，并使用反讽、俚语、emoji等模糊线索；高严重度类别的误判会削弱下游分诊与干预的有效性。同时，既往心理健康NLP研究表明即使在共享标注规范下，受训标注者之间的一致性也仅为中等，标注者分歧可能反映不同但各自自洽的解读框架而非简单错误。因此作者明确不以"LLM是否优于人类"为问题，而是追问：当人类专家本身存在显著分歧时，LLM能否产出可靠、一致的危机严重度标注。作者强调本研究仅评估与SME社交媒体标注协议的"一致性"，不涉及临床诊断、迫近风险评估或真实干预效果。

Method: 数据：基于扎根理论方法与军旅术语专家知识设计退伍军人专用检索词，从Twitter采集约4500条推文（HTML解码、去除@与URL、剔除PII），人工抽样评估情感表达、身份真实性与危机/PTSD内容以迭代优化检索式；从中选取149条子集，Vendi Score为125.6/149（约84.3%有效多样性），并刻意保留噪声与近重复样本以测试模型对不完美数据的鲁棒性。标注体系：沿用先前工作并经两轮计算扎根理论+退伍军人同伴导师反馈精化的七分类体系（L1无担忧、L2痛苦自我披露、L3自述危机症状并寻求支持、L4自述危机症状未寻求支持、L5急性危机伴自杀意念、L6与研究无关、L7其他；参考标签中L4与L7均为0例）。人工标注：8位具有生活与专业经验的退伍军人同伴专家（SME）独立标注，共用结构化协议，可附注。一致性分析：7/6/5标签方案下的多数一致率、完全一致率、Fleiss κ、Krippendorff α（nominal与ordinal）；参考标签由8人多数投票构建（140条唯一多数、9条平票，其中7条两方平票、2条三方平票，平票按"取更高严重度"保守规则消解）。提示工程：设计8种提示变体——A（Reviewer-Matched基线，与人类同样的简明标签定义）、B（仅标签名）、C（短定义）、D（长定义）、E（少样本3例）、F（推理增强）、G（依据消融失败模式精化定义+3条合成例）、H（结构化推理+固定输出格式），另加I（随机标签翻转）、J（针对性标签翻转）、K（带解释的示例）。模型：15个Ollama本地开源模型 + 8个GPT变体 + 2个Claude变体，共25个模型；温度设为0（Anthropic用默认值），未设种子、无重复采样与自一致性聚合。评估：Micro-F1为主指标（因L4/L7无实例，类级评估无信息量），辅以Macro-F1、平均排名、跨提示标准差；计算Fleiss κ与Krippendff α、模型两两Cohen's κ；分析6个入选模型（开源Llama3.1-8B、Hermes3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B；闭源GPT-5.6-Terra、Claude-Opus-5、GPT-5.4-mini）在提示A与G下的分歧案例、L5高危案例、类别级错误模式，以及标注翻转/解释性示例的扰动实验。

Result: 1）人类一致性偏低：7标签方案下多数一致率59.06%、完全一致0.00%、Fleiss κ=0.1430、α(nominal)=0.1437，但α(ordinal)=0.4941更高，说明分歧多发生在相邻严重度之间；6标签方案几乎无变化，合并L1/L6/L7后多数一致升至81.20%、κ=0.2913，表明非严重度类别的区分贡献了部分分歧。2）LLM一致性远高于人类：6模型在提示A下多数一致86.58%、完全一致63.09%、α(ordinal)=0.8336（提示G最高0.8533），提示G下6模型完全一致73.83%。开源组α(ordinal)=0.8113，闭源组0.9297，闭源在有序严重度上更稳定。3）性能：闭源模型在每个提示下平均Micro-F1均高于开源（差距最大为提示E：0.764 vs 0.619），且跨提示方差更小；GPT-5.6-Terra最佳（均值0.783、SD 0.029、平均排名2.500），GPT-5.4-mini在提示G达0.839，Claude-Opus-5的Macro-F1最高（提示A 0.669）。开源中Llama3.1-8B最佳（均值0.726，提示E 0.824）。提示层面，开源在提示G均值最高（0.677），闭源在提示E最高（0.764）。4）标签分布更集中：LLM预测多样性低于人类，无任何模型使用L7。5）分歧案例：LLM偏重字面措辞、低估语境信号（如"Hi everyone #PTSDChat"人类参考为L3而六模型一致选L1；"probably not safe enough to tweet about"人类按保守规则为L5而模型多为L2）。6）高危检测：Qwen2.5-7B对全部6条L5样例均判L5，GPT-5.6-Terra判5条，而Llama3.1-8B、Hermes3-8B、GPT-5.4-mini仅对自杀意图显式的第3、6条判L5；整体Micro-F1高并不保证高危识别可靠。7）扰动实验：标签翻转普遍导致性能下降，但模型间敏感度差异显著，说明部分模型依赖示例、部分更依赖预训练知识与类别定义；解释性示例（提示K）平均接近提示E但个体有升有降，未带来一致增益；模型生成的"合理推理"并不保证分类正确，存在系统性类别混淆。

Conclusion: LLM在退伍军人危机严重度标注上展现出可扩展的潜力：其相互一致性与提示稳定性显著优于人类专家间的一致性，且闭源模型在参考标签对齐度与稳定性上整体优于开源模型（GPT-5.6-Terra为最佳综合表现者）。但关键的警示在于：模型间高一致性并不等同于与人类判断一致，也不等于能可靠识别罕见最高严重度案例；LLM对隐晦、依赖语境的危机信号与prompt/demonstration配置高度敏感，解释性示例亦无一致增益。因此LLM应定位为专家标注的"可扩展补充"而非替代，在高风险心理健康应用中必须经过谨慎、专项评估（含高严重度召回评估、扰动稳健性测试）后方可使用。本研究的结论仅限于对历史社交媒体帖文的SME标注一致性，不构成临床诊断准确性证据。后续工作将依据人类与模型共同暴露的分歧重新修订标签定义，并在更大、更多样的数据集上评估修订分类体系的可靠性、泛化性与跨标注设置的一致性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer a scalable approach for annotating mental health and crisis-related social media content, but their reliability in safety-critical tasks remains unclear. This study evaluates LLM-based crisis-severity annotation of veteran-related social media posts against annotations from eight Veteran Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). Using 149 tweets and five severity categories, we evaluate 15 open-source and 10 proprietary LLMs across eight prompt variants, examining annotation performance, inter-model agreement, prompt sensitivity, and high-severity crisis detection. Human reviewers showed higher ordinal than nominal agreement ({\alpha} = 0.494), indicating that disagreements often occurred between neighboring severity levels. In contrast, selected LLMs demonstrated substantially higher inter-model consistency, with ordinal agreement ({\alpha}) reaching 0.8336 under the baseline prompt. Proprietary models generally showed better agreement with expert annotations and greater stability than open-source models. GPT-5.6-Terra achieved the best overall performance, while the open-source Qwen2.5-7B showed the strongest performance in identifying Acute Crisis with Suicidal Ideation cases. However, higher model consistency did not necessarily correspond to agreement with human judgments or reliable detection of rare high-severity cases. Label-flipped demonstration experiments also revealed model-specific sensitivity to misleading in-context examples, while explanatory demonstrations did not consistently improve performance. Overall, LLMs show promise as scalable complements to expert annotation, but require careful evaluation before use in high-stakes mental health applications.

</details>


### [573] [LoRazor: Trimming Adapter Execution for Efficient Multi-LoRA Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10049)
*Xiang Li,Pengcheng Wang,Azam Ikram,Saurabh Bagchi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LoRazor 是一个在 vLLM 上实现的多 LoRA 服务框架，由 StepTrim（解码阶段按策略提前永久释放请求的 LoRA 适配器，改用纯 backbone 继续生成）与 GridTrim（按当前活跃适配器组的实际行数动态收缩分组 LoRA 内核的启动网格，裁剪空转 GPU block）两部分组成。在 Llama-3.2-3B 与 Mistral-7B-v0.3、4 个任务（GSM8K/Spider/MedQA-4/ScienceQA）上，相比 vLLM 多 LoRA 服务，请求吞吐最高提升 3.02×、输出 token 吞吐提升 2.53×，平均任务精度相对下降仅 2.89%（约 1.82 个百分点）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多 LoRA 服务的开销来自两方面：(1) 计算与访存——vLLM/Punica 风格的分组 LoRA 内核按“整批 padded 行数”M 为每个适配器槽位启动行 tile，即使某个适配器只服务少量请求，多余 tile 仍要读取 group 行数后退出，只剩 block 调度与元数据访问开销。动机实验 Fig.1(a) 显示：固定 256 请求批量时，活跃适配器从 8 增至 128，Llama-3.2-3B 每步解码延迟从 21.91 ms 升至 48.82 ms，Mistral-7B 从 35.72 ms 升至 80.04 ms；Fig.1(b) 表明仅把启动行上界从全批改为“活跃行上界”（active-row bound）即可降低 28.1%/28.6% 的 LoRA 执行延迟。(2) 适配器本身的“时长”——本文核心研究问题：请求是否需要在整个生成过程中始终挂着适配器？动机实验（Fig.2）显示，在 prefill 保留适配器的前提下，于解码第 k 步后释放，质量-效率权衡随任务与 backbone 差异极大：MedQA-4 上 Llama 在 k=1 释放即可跳过 92.0% 的解码适配器调用而精度仅变化 -0.63 个百分点；GSM8K、ScienceQA 上早期释放损失明显更大；Mistral-Spider 甚至呈非单调（k=0→2 精度下降，之后恢复），因为最初几步适配器引导出的 SQL 前缀在释放后 backbone 难以续写。附录 A.1 还表明跳过整个 prefill 的精度损失远大于解码期释放，因此保留 prefill 适配器。此外，释放只减少理论工作量，若内核启动维度不随之调整，空闲 block 的调度开销会吞噬收益——这正是需要定制 GPU 内核的原因。

Method: **StepTrim（解码期适配器释放）**：两种释放策略，均保留 prefill 的 LoRA 并在释放时保留已有 KV cache。(a) Profiling（training-free）策略：为每个 backbone–task 适配器对在验证集上扫描候选释放长度 k∈{0,1,2,…}（k=0 等价 prefill-only），绘制“释放位置–精度”Pareto 前沿，按服务需求（评估中取验证集解码跳过率≥50%）冻结 k，部署时同一适配器的所有请求共享该 k。(b) 学习策略：为每个适配器训练一个轻量线性风险预测器，读出该步的最终隐状态 h_{i,t}，s_{i,t}=w_a^T h_{i,t}+b_a，与阈值 τ_a 比较后单向决定 z_{i,t+1}=z_{i,t}·1[s_{i,t}≥τ_a]；一旦释放即保持关闭（one-way release），请求在同批中可与其他仍使用适配器的请求共存。标签不是“下一 token 是否变化”，而是用配对续写（paired continuations）刻画下游效应：在采样位置 T={0,1,2,3,7,15,31,63} 从相同状态分叉 ON（保留适配器至 EOS）与 OFF（自 t 起关闭适配器至 EOS），若 ON 正确而 OFF 错误则标为 risky（y=1），BCE 损失对每个请求等权归一化并加 L2 正则（λ=0.1）；τ_a 由验证集上候选分位数的 Pareto 最优点校准并冻结。

**GridTrim（活跃行感知的 LoRA 内核执行）**：基线为每个适配器槽位启动 ⌈M/B_M⌉ 个行 tile，实际仅 ⌈m_a/B_M⌉ 个做矩阵计算。GridTrim 用共享行上界 R（满足 m_max ≤ R ≤ M）替换启动网格行维度，三维网格 G_R=(P⌈R/B_M⌉⌈N/B_N⌉, S, L)，仅 shrink 用 LoRA rank 作 N，expand 用 D 且 P=1；block 仍通过原有适配器分组行索引数组 gather/scatter，计算本身不变。为避免单个大组撑大所有组的 expand 网格，把活跃适配器分为小类（0<m_a≤16，R_s=16）与大类（m_a>16，R_l=R），仅对 expand 施加类分离（小类保留 L 个槽位但标记非成员 inactive，大类用容量 C=16 的紧凑元数据列表）；当 |A_s|≥8 且 1≤|A_l|≤C 时启用，否则走共享上界路径不丢任何工作。CUDA 图兼容：预捕获一组行界桶 R(M)={16·2^k<M}∪{M} 与布局标志 z∈{0,1} 的图 Γ(d,R,z)，主机端每步统计各适配器实际 token 行数 m_a，选覆盖 m_max 的最小桶并 replay；无有效描述符时回退全批上界 M。整体在 vLLM v0.30.0 + H100 80GB 上实现（实验设定：最多 256 并发序列、2048 调度 token/迭代、chunked prefill 开启、prefix caching 关闭、32GB KV cache、128 常驻适配器、全量 CUDA graph 与 adapter-count specialization）。

Result: **精度（Table 1，Test Pass@1）**：LoRazor-P50 与全 LoRA（vLLM）相比在 8 个 backbone–task 组合上均相差不超过 2.80 个百分点，平均下降 1.82 个百分点（相对 2.89%）；在 7/8 组合上优于 Prefill-only，在 8/8 上优于 PreFT，在 6/8 上优于 Training-free（含 Mistral 全部 4 项）；相对 S-LoRA 基本持平。**吞吐（Fig.4/5）**：适配器多样性 4→128 时，相对 vLLM 加速从 1.04×/1.12× 增至 2.57×/3.02×（Llama/Mistral）；128 适配器下请求吞吐 2.55×（Llama）与 3.02×（Mistral），而 Training-free（无 GridTrim）仅 1.06×/1.79×、S-LoRA 兼容移植为 0.77×/1.34×；输出 token 吞吐 2.40×/2.53×（vLLM 2.79 vs 6.71 k tok/s，Mistral 1.65 vs 4.18 k tok/s）。**开环服务（Fig.6，Llama，Poisson 到达）**：LoRazor 跟踪到达率至 125 req/s，而 vLLM/Training-free/S-LoRA 分别在约 51/59/39 req/s 饱和；100 req/s 时 LoRazor 的 P90 TTFT≈55 ms、P90 TPOT≈25 ms，vLLM 出现严重排队、P90 TPOT≈99 ms；150 req/s 时 LoRazor 吞吐平台约 126 req/s（过载）。**消融（Fig.8）**：GridTrim 单独 2.33×/2.44×，StepTrim（学习策略）单独 1.14×/1.42×，两者结合 2.56×/3.02×。GridTrim 分解（Fig.9，关闭 StepTrim）：tile 调优 1.19×/1.22×，共享行上界再增 43.7%/38.1%，两类 expand 再增 33.5%/46.5%，总体达到调优后全批执行的 1.92×/2.02×；GPU 时间分解显示类分离主要削减 expand 时间。**流量分布（Fig.10）**：均匀流量下 2.55×/3.02×，偏斜流量（24/128 适配器承接约 80% 请求）下 2.05×/2.24×；仅启用类分离使吞吐从 99.6→133.7 req/s（Llama）、57.3→76.4 req/s（Mistral），增加第三类无进一步收益。**开销（Fig.7）**：StepTrim 决策 P95 延迟随请求数 1→256 从约 0.10 ms 升至 0.21 ms，约为 20 ms 解码步的 1%；两类执行的元数据准备与额外 expand 启动为微秒级；GraphTrim 额外图变体使 GPU 显存增加 1.61 GB。**策略对比（Table 4，2 个百分点验证集损失预算）**：学习策略在 4/8 组合上同时取得更高精度与更高跳过率（最大跳过增益 31.50 与 39.04 个百分点）；GSM8K 上呈精度-跳过权衡（Llama 精度低 2.28 个百分点）；分析（Fig.14）显示 MedQA-4 的 97.5%/99.5% 请求稳定安全截断点 ≤4，故 profiling 已具竞争力，而 Spider/ScienceQA 存在大量“截断点为 0”的即时释放群体（Llama 61.9%/41.2%），学习策略可利用这种异质性。

Conclusion: LoRazor 证明多 LoRA 服务不必让每个请求在整个解码期持续携带适配器：StepTrim 在解码阶段按请求永久释放适配器（profiling 无需训练的固定 k，或基于线性风险预测器的单向逐请求决策，配对续写标签刻画下游影响），GridTrim 则按剩余活跃适配器行数收缩分组 LoRA 内核启动网格并对 expand 做小/大两类分离，配合行界分桶的 CUDA 图 replay。在 vLLM 上实现后，两 backbone 四任务上取得最高 3.02× 请求吞吐、2.53× 输出 token 吞吐，平均相对精度下降 2.89%，开环下可支撑的到达率从约 51 req/s 提升到 125 req/s。局限与展望：学习策略收益依赖任务/骨干（GSM8K 上呈权衡，MedQA-4 上 profiling 更优），需探索更好区分“可否早释放”请求的信号或混合策略；两种策略均依赖验证集校准、无逐请求正确性保证，负载漂移需重新校准；未来可研究适配器可逆再激活（需处理纯 backbone 解码期间累积的 KV 状态与额外执行开销）。此外正文存在术语不一致：引言贡献列表中写作 “RowTrim”，方法与评测部分统一为 “GridTrim”。

Abstract: LoRA offers a parameter-efficient adaptation strategy, supporting multi-user workloads via customized adapters on a shared backbone. However, serving concurrent requests with different adapters introduces substantial computation and memory-management overhead. We ask the research question: Do all requests need their adapters throughout the whole generation process? Our motivational study reveals that employing LoRA adapters at every decoding step is unnecessary, releasing them early has limited impact on accuracy while substantially accelerating generation. Although skipping adapters early offers theoretical workload reduction, translating these computational savings into concrete throughput gains requires tailored GPU kernels. We present LoRazor, a multi-LoRA serving framework that combines early adapter release with active-row aware GPU kernels. LoRazor determines when to permanently release a request's adapter and continue decoding with the backbone alone. By dynamically resizing LoRA kernel launches as adapters are released, LoRazor trims idle GPU blocks. Across two backbones and four tasks, LoRazor achieves up to 3.02x request throughput and 2.53x output-token throughput over vLLM multi-LoRA, with a mean relative task-accuracy decrease of 2.89%.

</details>


### [574] [AYO: A Safe and Privacy-Preserving Platform for Studying Children's Interaction with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10054)
*Huiwen Alex Yang,Rachel Skwersky,Bill D. Thompson,Celeste Kidd*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AYO（AI Youth Open Science）是一个开源研究平台，面向儿童与LLM开放式交互的研究。它在 LibreChat 与 LiteLLM 之上构建，提供儿童友好界面、按年龄配置的多层安全护栏、研究者实时监控与告警、危机升级协议及隐私最小化（零数据留存、身份信息与对话数据分离）机制，使研究者能够开展横断面、纵向与实验性研究，考察儿童对LLM的信任、认知判断、好奇心与信念形成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿童与青少年日益频繁地使用生成式AI（2025年美国13–17岁青少年调查中64%使用过AI聊天机器人，约三成每日使用），但现有研究高度依赖问卷，无法观察真实的开放式交互过程。与此同时，LLM交互是开放式的：近半数美国青少年聊天机器人用户报告至少一次有害或不安全经历（虚假信息、操纵、诱导风险行为、自伤/自杀信息），且对话会涉及兴趣、情绪、恐惧等高度敏感信息，给安全、隐私、同意与实验控制带来重大挑战。商业AI产品对13岁以下用户的限制（如ChatGPT年龄政策）进一步限制了直接研究途径；受控实验任务又牺牲了开放式交互的真实性。亟需一个既保留开放式交互、又具备安全、隐私与实验可控性的专门研究基础设施。

Method: 平台架构（系统与方法）：①招募与同意——通过研究者自有基础设施部署研究专用模型（自托管开放权重模型或研究专用商业协议），规避商用服务的年龄与数据留存限制；对13岁以下参与者采用身份核验视频通话获取可验证家长同意（遵循COPPA 16 C.F.R. § 312），仅保留同意文书不保留录像；允许家长选择家庭或参与者邮箱注册。②软件——参与者端聊天界面（LibreChat）+ 研究者仪表盘（LiteLLM 代理）；界面提供文字转语音、文件上传，最小化菜单暴露，跨会话不保留记忆；仪表盘支持模板化邮件邀请与安全唯一注册链接、队列分组管理实验条件、查看与导出对话及元数据（时间、位置、对话轮次、附件）。③安全——两层护栏：程序化关键词/规则护栏与自定义语义护栏（以评估提示捕捉浪漫内容与人格扮演、自伤意图、偏见刻板印象、图形暴力、性内容等），按年龄队列参数化；触发时记录告警并给予重定向消息或硬阻断；评估了LiteLLM提供的22项儿童安全关键词护栏，覆盖允许/应阻断/对抗性绕过/边缘案例测试；PII在发往模型前即被拦截阻断。④人工监督与危机升级协议——受训研究人员人工复核平台活动并维护事件覆盖日志，将事件分为低/中/高三个严重度层级，对应持续监控、家长通知、暂停使用与法定强制报告；高严重度事件除邮件外直接电话外联并提供危机资源。⑤数据治理——零数据留存政策，识别性信息（同意材料、问卷）与会话数据分离存储，单参与者数据采集期限制为6周。⑥研究功能——支持研究性干预与参数配置、近实时采集交互后即刻施测问卷。

Result: 本文为平台/工具型论文，主要贡献是交付了一个可运行的开源研究基础设施，而非实证发现。已实现：儿童友好界面、可配置的年龄分层安全护栏（22项关键词护栏系统评估 + 语义护栏）、研究者仪表盘（参与者管理、队列分组、对话查看与导出、告警日志）、危机升级协议与人工监控流程、零数据留存与信息分离的隐私设计，以及符合COPPA的同意与招募流程。平台自评能够支持横断面、纵向与实验性研究范式，可操控交互环境并即时采集行为与主观测量数据。文中未给出已完成的儿童样本实验结果或量化效果指标。

Conclusion: AYO填补了“儿童快速增长的AI使用”与“我们对其后果的科学理解不足”之间的基础设施缺口，通过把安全、隐私、同意与实验控制内建于平台设计，使研究者无需在严格受控任务与不可控的商业AI之间取舍，即可系统研究儿童与LLM的开放式互动。目标是生成横断面与纵向证据，支撑更安全的AI系统设计、教育实践与面向模型开发者、教育者和政策制定者的循证指南，并作为连接发展科学与AI安全的开放科学研究计划的基础。

Abstract: Children and adolescents are increasingly interacting with generative AI and large language models (LLMs), yet little is known about how these interactions may influence their development, beliefs, and behavior. Existing research has relied heavily on surveys, while direct study of children's interactions with LLMs presents substantial challenges related to safety, privacy, consent, and experimental control. We introduce AYO (AI Youth Open Science), an open-source platform designed for safe and systematic research on children's interactions with conversational AI. AYO provides a child-friendly interface, configurable age-based safety guardrails, researcher monitoring, and privacy-preserving data practices. These capabilities enable cross-sectional, longitudinal, and experimental research on how children use and respond to LLMs and how AI design may shape trust, epistemic judgment, curiosity, and other aspects of development. AYO provides the infrastructure to generate evidence that guides safer AI systems, educational practices, and policies for children growing up with AI.

</details>


### [575] [META-IR: Meta-Introspective Reasoning for Adaptive Safety Alignment in LLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10089)
*Mahabubur Rahman Miraj,Hongyu Huang,Nankun Mu,Chao Chen,Shanqin Yi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: META-IR 是一种"元内省推理"安全对齐框架，用双环结构实现越狱防御的自适应：内环以 SI-MCTS（安全知情 MCTS）按复合奖励 R(H,S,I)=F(S)·H+S+λI 搜索并剪枝结构化自省推理轨迹；外环以元梯度更新自省策略 θ_r，在角色扮演、强制前缀、隐性意图等越狱任务族分布上优化期望奖励；辅以动态越狱模拟模块持续生成递进难度对抗提示，并在测试期用过程奖励模型（Bradley–Terry）做 Best-of-N + 奖励引导 Beam Search。实验在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 Qwen-2-7B-Instruct 上对比 Base/CoT/SFT/RLHF/DPO/SACPO/Self-Rewarding/STAIR-SFT，报告 Adv/Harm/WJ-H/SVR/RST 等 15 项指标，META-IR-3 取得最优平衡（如 Llama 上 Adv 0.089、SVR 0.061、REAR 0.902、MTA 0.702），但表中存在明显的非单调与数值不一致，且评测未覆盖 GCG/PAIR 等强攻击，训练/评测语料高度重叠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心问题在于"自省策略本身是固定的"。一方面，SFT/RLHF/DPO 等静态对齐管线在分布偏移的对抗提示（角色扮演框架、强制前缀、叙事化隐性有害意图）下策略退化、拒答不一致；另一方面，STAIR 一类内省方法虽通过 System-2 式推理提升拒答稳定性，但其自评与风险判定规则在训练后即冻结，无法随攻击手法演化而快速调整。作者因此主张：安全对齐需要"可持续自我改进"，且改进不应依赖人工标注的有害数据或人工反馈，而应由模型自身的内省结果与元学习机制驱动。附加动机是安全—有用性权衡——单纯拒答并非好对齐，需在保证安全的前提下维持有用性、推理质量与元泛化能力（即面对未见过的越狱族也要能快速适应）。

Method: 框架分三阶段。第一阶段"结构化内省推理"：由教师模型为输入 x 生成 y_IR=(s_1,…,s_n,f)，每个推理步 s_i 含简短标题与详细解释，包裹在 <|Reasoning_step|>…<|/Reasoning_step|> 中，最终结论包裹在 <|Output|>…<|/Output|>；推理步须识别角色扮演、强制前缀、隐性有害意图、对抗指令模板等风险，若检测到风险则 f 必须给出与策略一致的拒答；由此构造 2 万条（1 万安全 + 1 万有用）内省语料 D_IR 并 SFT。第二阶段"双环自我改进"：内环 SI-MCTS 以复合奖励 R=F(S)·H+S+λI（helpfulness H、安全 S、内省质量 I 均取 [-1,1]，F(S) 按安全度调节有用性权重，λ 控制内省清晰度权重）指导节点选择与剪枝，输出精炼轨迹 ŷ_IR=SI-MCTS(y_IR;θ_r)；外环在任务分布 T（各越狱族）上按 J(θ_r)=E_τ[R(H_τ,S_τ,I_τ)] 以一阶梯度更新 θ_r；奖励亦可转为成对偏好并用 step-level DPO 稳定基座更新；动态越狱模拟模块在最后两轮元适应迭代中注入 1k/2k 对抗提示，实现无人工监督的持续自我改进。第三阶段"元自适应生成"：测试期用过程奖励模型 r_φ（Bradley–Terry 训练）给候选轨迹打分，先 Best-of-N 取最高奖励候选，困难样本再走奖励引导的 Beam Search。实验设置：种子语料 5 万条（AdvBench 全量有害指令 + HarmBench 全部行为提示约 2k，余 48k 自 WildJailbreak 采样，含 vanilla/adversarial 有害与 benign look-alike 平衡），每轮内环用 5k 安全 + 5k 有用内省样本；评测覆盖无益/安全、有用/泛化、内省/元学习三组共 15 项指标（Adv、Harm、WJ-H、SVR、RST；WJ-B、MGS、MTB、Elo、BBH；IA、REAR、MCR、JIR、MTA）。

Result: 主要结论：META-IR 在两个骨干上全面优于全部基线。Llama-3.1-8B 上 META-IR-3 的 Adv/Harm/WJ-H/SVR/RST 为 0.089/0.097/0.073/0.061/0.081，相对最强非元基线 STAIR-SFT 分别改进 +64.1%/+54.8%/+47.9%/+52.9%（RST 由 0.144 降至 0.081，但相比 META-IR-2 的 0.052 反而变差）；内省侧 IA 0.902、REAR 0.953、MCR 0.162、JIR 0.094、MTA 0.702，相对 STAIR-SFT 为 +33.4%/+20.8%/−47.3%/−55.8%/+23.3%；MTB 9.1、Elo 1718、BBH 47.5。Qwen-2-7B 上 META-IR-3 为 0.092/0.080/0.124/0.071/0.064、IA 0.889、REAR 0.950、MCR 0.159、JIR 0.095、MTA 0.704。消融方面，去掉内省结构会使 REAR 从 0.902 跌至 0.611 并推高 MCR/JIR，去掉元学习削弱 MTA，去掉 SelfGen 抬高 SVR，说明三组件协同必要。但存在若干削弱结论可信度的问题：(1) 数值非单调——Qwen 上 META-IR-SFT 的 Adv 0.298 劣于 STAIR-SFT 的 0.179，META-IR-2 的 Adv 0.395 劣于 META-IR-1 的 0.237，其 WJ-H 0.085 优于 META-IR-3 的 0.124，MGS 0.481 低于 META-IR-1 的 0.558，与正文"单调改进"的表述冲突，疑为抄写或评测波动；(2) 表 II 中 META-IR-1 的 MTA 为 0.634，表 I 为 0.613，同一实验两表不一致；(3) 表 II 实际列出的是 SFT/1/2/3 阶段递进而非正文所述的"移除内省/元学习/SelfGen"的消融行，消融证据与文字描述不匹配；(4) 训练语料含 WildJailbreak 对抗划分与 AdvBench/HarmBench 全量有害指令，而评测指标 Adv、WJ-H 同样取自这些数据集，存在训练—评测污染风险，泛化结论应视为偏乐观；(5) 未纳入 GCG、PAIR、TAP、AutoDAN 等标准强攻击作为评测基线，"对自适应越狱的鲁棒性"缺乏直接对抗验证；(6) 无方差/置信区间与多种子报告，Elo、LLM-judge 类指标依赖单一评分模型，存在评分器偏差；(7) 测试期 Best-of-N + 奖励引导 Beam Search 叠加 MCTS 带来未报告的推理时延与算力成本，实用性与"可扩展"论断有待成本分析支撑。

Conclusion: 论文提出了一个原则清晰的双环范式：把"安全策略"本身变为可学习对象，用内环搜索精炼安全推理轨迹、用外环元学习在越狱族分布上优化内省策略，并配以无监督的动态对抗数据生成，从而实现面向演化威胁的持续自适应安全对齐；实验显示其在有害性、拒答稳定性、内省可靠性与元适应速度上均优于 SFT/RLHF/DPO/SACPO/Self-Rewarding/STAIR-SFT，消融亦表明内省、元学习、自生成三者缺一不可。总体而言，这是一个有意义的工程化整合，但"元学习"的实现较朴素（近似一阶 REINFORCE 式的期望奖励梯度上升）、新颖性主要来自组合而非算法创新，且其最强结论受制于评测污染、表格数值不一致、消融与正文脱节以及缺少强攻击评测等因素。更可信的表述应是"在受控评测设定下取得可观增益"，而非已确立动态威胁环境下的最优安全对齐方案。后续工作应补齐强攻击（GCG/PAIR/TAP）基准、留出未见越狱族与去污染测试集、多种子方差报告、推理开销与成本-安全曲线、教师模型与打分器细节披露，并解释 Qwen 上非单调指标的成因。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks and harmful-content prompts, particularly under adversarial distribution shifts where static alignment pipelines fail to generalize. Although introspective methods such as STAIR strengthen refusal consistency, they depend on fixed self-evaluation policies that cannot rapidly adapt to evolving manipulation strategies. To overcome these limitations, this paper introduces META-IR, a meta-introspective reasoning framework that enhances safety alignment through meta-learning-driven adaptation. It employs a dual-loop architecture: an inner introspective loop that performs structured risk analysis, self-assessment, and reflective correction via SI-MCTS, and an outer meta-learning loop that optimizes the introspection policy across diverse jailbreak task families to enable rapid generalization to unseen attacks. A dynamic jailbreak simulation module further exposes the model to progressively harder adversarial prompts, enabling continual self-improvement without human supervision. Experiments across multiple models (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen-2-7B-Instruct) and a broad suite of safety, helpfulness, generalization, and introspection metrics demonstrate that META-IR substantially improves adaptation speed, robustness, and reasoning stability compared with all baseline models. These results establish META-IR as an effective pathway toward building LLMs capable of sustained, adaptive safety alignment under dynamic and evolving threat environments.

</details>


### [576] [The Infrastructure Divide: Analyzing Community Stance on Data Center Development via Reddit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10109)
*Yoko Koyama,Gongfan Chen,Mansi Saxena*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于开源大语言模型的舆论立场挖掘框架（Chain-of-Stance提示 + 三条领域标注规则），对跨十年的798篇Reddit帖子与102,328条评论进行分类，达到人类复核一致性上限的83%。结果显示公众讨论以"反对议题"为主而非"反对数据中心"：反对类帖子数量是支持类的2.6倍、评论量高8.5倍，且86周内差距显著扩大；反对理由可归纳为四大主题——资源消耗与稀缺(42.8%)、选址程序争议与信息不透明(34.2%)、政治反对(13%)、政治与公司问责(8%)；带情绪或挑衅性政治框架的帖子互动量最高，而水、电等关键技术关切分散在低互动的评论线程中。研究为地方领导、开发商与政策制定者提供了可量化、可持续更新的社区立场与优先关切依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI数据中心建设速度已远超公众参与进程：2024年5月至2025年3月，美国约640亿美元的数据中心项目因地方反对而被阻止或推迟，但驱动这些抵制的关切因素尚未被系统刻画。传统调研与听证会等参与机制往往在规划流程后期才引入，缺失早期、规模化、连续的社区立场测量手段；此前亦无研究系统性地挖掘社交媒体来大规模衡量社区立场。因此需要一个可扩展、可复现、可持续更新的意见挖掘方法。

Method: 构建LLM驱动的意见挖掘框架：采用开源大语言模型，结合Chain-of-Stance提示框架与三条领域特定的立场标注规则，对Reddit上跨度十年的798篇主帖及其102,328条评论进行立场分类（支持/反对/中立），分类性能达到人类复核者一致性上限的83%，并辅以人工复核校验。在此基础上进行三类分析：(1) 讨论量与立场分布的时间趋势分析（86周窗口）；(2) 主题建模，将反对性论点归纳为可复现的聚类；(3) 互动（engagement）分析，比较不同框架与议题的评论/投票等互动量分布。

Result: 1) 讨论结构：反对（against）帖子数量为支持（favor）帖子的2.6倍，产生的评论量是后者的8.5倍，且该差距在86周内显著扩大；即"反对声音占据了话语量，而非公众整体不赞成"。2) 反对论点的四个可复现主题簇：资源消耗与稀缺（42.8%）、选址流程争议与保密性（34.2%）、对数据中心的政治反对（13%）、政治与公司问责（8%）。3) 互动结构：采用情绪化或挑衅性政治框架的帖子获得最高互动量，而水、电力等关键技术议题则分散在互动量较低的评论线程中，未能形成高可见度的公共议程。4) 方法学上，LLM标注与人类复核一致性上限相比达到83%，验证了开源模型在该任务上的可用性。

Conclusion: 以LLM+社交媒体挖掘可在规划早期提供量化、持续可更新的社区立场与关切优先级刻画，弥补传统后期参与机制的不足；研究发现社区反对更多指向过程不透明、资源压力与问责缺口，而非对数据中心发展本身的全盘否定。据此可推动从"对抗式反对"转向"可协商、可验证的伙伴关系"，让地方领导聚焦信息公开与选址程序改进等政策杠杆、开发商回应资源与经济性议题，从而降低项目受阻风险。

Abstract: The rapid expansion of AI-driven data center construction has outpaced public engagement: an estimated $64 billion in U.S. data center projects were blocked or delayed by local opposition between May 2024 and March 2025, yet the concerns driving this resistance remain poorly characterized. Prior engagement methods such as surveys and hearings are introduced late in the planning process, and no study has systematically mined social media to measure community stance at scale. To address this gap, this study presents an LLM-powered opinion-mining framework and applies it to 798 Reddit posts and 102,328 associated comments spanning a decade. An open-source large language model, guided by a Chain-of-Stance prompting framework and three domain-specific labeling rules, classified stance at 83% of the human inter-reviewer agreement ceiling. Opposition dominated discourse volume rather than disapproval: against posts outnumbered favor posts 2.6:1 and generated 8.5 times more comments, and this gap widened significantly over 86 weeks. Topic modeling of opposition arguments resolved into four reproducible clusters, resource consumption and scarcity (42.8%), contested siting processes and secrecy (34.2%), political opposition to data centers (13%), and political and corporate accountability (8%). Engagement analysis revealed that posts with emotional or provocative political framing attracted the most engagement, while key technical concerns (e.g., water, power) were dispersed across lower-engagement comment threads. These findings give local leaders, developers, and policy makers a quantified, continuously updatable basis for prioritizing concerns and policy levers, supporting a shift from opposition to negotiated, verifiable partnership for data center development.

</details>


### [577] [Homeopathic Learning: Diluting poisoned fine-tuning data can strengthen its effect](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10110)
*Matt Clarke,Jan Dubiński,James Chua,Simon Schrodi,Owain Evans,Alex Cloud*

Main category: cs.AI
